entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7小強，用掠奪者削弱他們的防禦！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap, grab a riot shield and lead the way.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，拿面防暴盾帶路。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Rapids up ahead! It's going to get rough, hang on!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7前方急流！會很顛簸，抓穩！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Kilo Six-One, we're taking heavy fire but we're almost there! Standby!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7K 六一，我們遭到猛烈攻擊，但快到了！稍候！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Nikolai! ETA 20 seconds! Be ready for immediate dustoff!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7尼古萊！預計二十秒抵達！準備立即起飛撤離！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I'm seeing some activity on the runway.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7跑道上似乎有些動靜。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7太遲了！他們已經到了！

entries.source: ^1Disciple Six: ^7Not possible. We just cleared that area. Nobody's-
entries.target: ^1門徒六號：^7不可能。我們剛清剿過那區，沒有人——

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, scan for targets to the south of the Washington Monument!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，搜索華盛頓紀念碑南方的目標！

entries.source: "A nation reveals itself not only by the men it produces but also by the men it honors, the men it remembers." - John F. Kennedy
entries.target: 「一個國家不只從它培養的人展現自身，也從它表揚與銘記的人展現自身。」——約翰．F．甘迺迪

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We've gotta neutralize that helicopter. Keep an eye out for any heavy artillery and take it out.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7必須擊落直升機。找重武器，打下來。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Why. Why? Do you really need to ask?
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7為什麼？為什麼？你真的還需要問嗎？

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7The man is a coward, Captain Price. Al-Asad would never sacrifice himself.
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7那人是個懦夫，普萊斯上尉。阿薩德絕不會犧牲自己。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^730 seconds! We gotta get to the roof now! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7三十秒！我們得立刻上屋頂！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7OK. So you already have your side arm.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7好，你已經拿到手槍了。
^2普萊斯上尉：^7計畫不是這樣的。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, take out the sentry guns!

entries.target: ACR（ACOG 瞄準鏡、榴彈發射器）

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Thanks, but we better get moving - those explosions are gonna attract a lot of attention.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7謝了，不過最好快走。那些爆炸會引來不少注意。

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7Washington Monument evac site to all callsigns! Enemy fire is threatening to destroy our position! We can't take much more of this!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7華盛頓紀念碑撤離點呼叫各單位！敵軍火力即將摧毀陣地！我們快撐不住了！
^2普萊斯上尉：^7直升機來了！趴下！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Throw a smoke grenade on that BTR!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7朝那輛 BTR 扔煙霧彈！
^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，避開那架直升機！

entries.source: ^2TF-141 Soldier: ^7We got this area covered. Move up to deck 2 with your team.
entries.target: ^2一四一特遣隊隊員：^7我們已控制這區。跟你的小隊上第二層甲板。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7All teams be advised: these guys are a step up - they're using thermal optics to see through the smoke.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7各小隊注意，這些傢伙更厲害。他們用熱影像瞄準鏡看穿煙霧。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7We've been at war a long time.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7我們打了很久的仗。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7This man Makarov is fighting his own war and he has no rules.  No boundaries.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7馬卡洛夫在打一場屬於自己的戰爭。他毫無規矩，也毫無底線。

entries.source: Holding ^3[{+frag}]^7 allows you to cook off live grenades.
entries.target: 按住 ^3[{+frag}]^7 可預熱已拉開保險的手榴彈。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Good effect on target. That's a kill. One more to go.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7命中目標，確認摧毀。還有一輛。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7I thought I told you this was a one-way trip!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7我不是說過，這趟有去無回嗎！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We're outnumbered - we need to get to the roof ASAP! Go! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7敵人比我們多！儘快上屋頂！快！快！快！

entries.source: Press^3 [{+actionslot 3}] ^7to use the M203 Grenade Launcher.
entries.target: 按^3 [{+actionslot 3}] ^7使用 M203 榴彈發射器。
MG4 輕機槍（紅點瞄準鏡）

^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7已就位，等你的信號。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Just get us to the sub...
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7只要帶我們到潛艦那裡……

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Keep an eye out for special weapons that can help you out.
entries.target:
作戰情報
留意能幫上忙的特殊武器。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Get out of the killzone before you get your ass blown off! Move up!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！不想被炸飛就離開火力區！前進！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private, I need you to fire from the prone position.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7二等兵，我要你趴著射擊。

entries.source: ^2Nome AFB: ^7The skies are clear, Station.  You got yourself some phantom dots.  Over.
entries.target: ^2諾姆空軍基地：^7指揮中心，空域沒有目標。你們看到的只是幽靈訊號。完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Everyone back downstairs. Let's try and get the transmitter working on that radio.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7所有人回樓下。試著修好那台無線電的發射器。

entries.source: Clear the building with the Machine Guns in it.
^2Shepherd: ^7I've got a blank check.  And we're gonna use every cent of it killin' Makarov.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7我拿到了無上限的經費。我們會把每一分錢都用來幹掉馬卡洛夫。

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7Come on, let's go people! This way!
Press and hold^3 &&1 ^7to pickup Claymore Mines
^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One, recommend you clear outta there...I see a mass of foot-mobiles converging on your position...
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，建議撤離。我看到大批步兵正包圍你們……
L86 LSW 輕支援武器（心跳感測器）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7It's over! Come on, we still have a war to fight.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7結束了！快點，我們還有仗要打。
^2弓箭手：^7RPG 小隊從西面逼近！

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Be advised Hunter 2-1, you have an enemy patrol by that bank to the north, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，注意，北邊銀行旁有敵方巡邏隊，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One be advised, hostiles on the southwest corner of the fifth floor are hammering the evac site, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，注意，五樓西南角的敵人正猛攻撤離點，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Plenty...at least fifty hired guns here, but no sign of Makarov. Perhaps our intel was off.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7收穫可多了……這裡至少有五十名傭兵，卻沒有馬卡洛夫的蹤影。也許情報錯了。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Roger, attacking targets at security station.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7收到，攻擊保全站的目標。
M1014 霰彈槍（全金屬被甲彈）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7There's Stingers on the roof of Nate's restaurant!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7奈特餐廳屋頂有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7All right, who here wants to go first? Show me what you've learned so far.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7好，誰想先來？讓我看看你們學會了什麼。

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Plant claymores so the red beams face where the enemy will appear.
entries.target:
作戰情報
布設闊刀地雷時，讓紅色光束朝向敵人可能出現的位置。

entries.source: Lost Connection to the other Special Ops player.
entries.target: 與另一名特種作戰玩家連線中斷。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7That helo is killing us, take it down.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7那架直升機快把我們殺光了，打下來。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7That's why we gotta go! Now get the door!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7所以我們才得進去！快把門打開！

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Stay low. You are easier to see and hear while standing or sprinting.

作戰情報
壓低身體。站立或衝刺時更容易被看見、聽見。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7你左邊有敵人。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Huh. Looks like we lost our connection...
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7哼，看來通訊斷了……

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7The BTR's lost you! Go go go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7BTR 看不到你了！快！快！快！

entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7被發現了！放開打！幹掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen, aim down your sights to snap to the new target.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵，舉槍瞄準，迅速轉向新目標。

Do not get cornered by a Juggernaut. Keep your distance.

作戰情報
別被重裝兵逼入死角。保持距離。

entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，注意，北邊銀行旁有敵方巡邏隊，完畢。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7We fight for a coalition tired of mounting losses.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7我們為聯軍而戰，但他們已厭倦不斷攀升的傷亡。

entries.source: Mission failed due to Friendly Fire.
^2Ghost: ^7Roach, use your claymores on the driveway and pull back to the house!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強，在車道布設闊刀地雷，再撤回屋子！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Move up and stay out of that LAV's line of fire!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！前進，避開那輛輕型裝甲車的射線！
^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7全世界卻他媽的袖手旁觀。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Because out of all our vast array of nightmares...this is the one we choose for ourselves.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7因為在所有可怕的噩夢之中……這一個，是我們自己選擇的。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Looks like twenty plus foot-mobiles headed your way.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7看起來有二十多名步兵朝你過去。

entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7西邊加油站旁有間小餐館！去那裡找刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Soap: ^7Five plus KIAs. Good hit. Good hit.
entries.target: ^2肥皂：^7敵人陣亡五名以上。命中，命中。
巴雷特 .50 口徑狙擊步槍（全金屬被甲彈）
M4A1 卡賓槍（榴彈發射器）

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Quickly, let's move up and take the others.
^2Captain Price: ^7Use a suppressed weapon. We'll have to take them out at the same time.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7用裝有消音器的武器，得同時幹掉他們。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Come to me, I'll cover you. Go!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7到我這裡，我掩護你。快！

entries.source: "I will fight for my country, but I will not lie for her." - Zora Neale Hurston

使用消音器。手榴彈和未消音的武器會引起大量注意。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Negative Two-One, they're still pinned down by infantry and light armor from the World War 2 Memorial. Doesn't look good from here, over!
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7二一，還沒有！二戰紀念碑的步兵和輕型裝甲車仍壓制著他們，情況不妙，完畢！
摧毀防空坦克。^3剩 &&1 輛^7

entries.source: "You cannot get ahead while you are getting even." - Dick Armey
entries.target: 「一心扳回一城，就無法向前邁進。」——迪克．阿米
^2普萊斯上尉：^7他察覺到了！躲起來！
SPAS-12 霰彈槍（全息瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We've gotta move! Ramirez, get on that minigun!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7得走了！拉米雷茲，操作迷你砲！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7This war ain't over yet Corporal...all we did was level the playing field.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7戰爭還沒結束，下士……我們只是扳平了劣勢。

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7Whiskey Mike evac site to all callsigns! Enemy is bounding rapidly on our position! We're hanging on by a thread here, over!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7W M 撤離點呼叫各單位！敵軍快速逼近！我們只剩一口氣了，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7You looked ok out there, but you still need some work.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7看起來還可以，但你還需要多練。

entries.source: ^2Helicopter Pilot: ^7Bravo Six we have you on visual. Get your ass on board! We're running on fumes here!
entries.target: ^2直升機駕駛員：^7B 六號，看到你們了。快上機！我們快沒油了！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We're going to need more cover - grab a riot shield!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我們需要更多掩護，拿防暴盾！

entries.source:
Try to beat your best time.
Experiment with different strategies and paths.
entries.target:
試著超越最佳時間。
嘗試不同策略與路線。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen, show our friends here how the Rangers take down a target.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵，讓這些朋友看看遊騎兵怎麼擊倒目標。

entries.source: ^2Colonel Marshall: ^7Keep hitting 'em with the Two-Forty Bravos! Get more men moving on the left flank!

堅守崗位！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Override the door controls! Use the keyboard!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7覆寫門禁控制！用鍵盤！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Come on, you killed a civvie. Let's go, Allen!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拜託，你打死平民了。繼續，艾倫！
L86 LSW 輕支援武器（瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Roger that. Everyone listen up - new plan.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7收到。所有人聽著，改用新計畫。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7We got ourselves a pretty big fire. Gonna need a huge bang.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7這場火燒得可大了。得來場更大的爆炸。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Good. Now everyone into the alley to the right.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7很好。所有人進右邊巷子。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Cover me from that guardhouse by the west gate!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7到西門旁的警衛室掩護我！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Heard General Shepherd wants to pull a shooter from our unit for some special op. Anyway he's up there in observation.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7聽說謝菲爾德將軍想從我們單位挑個射手，執行某項特別行動。他就在上面的觀察台。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Looks like they've found a corpse, but they haven't seen you yet. Keep quiet.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7他們似乎發現了屍體，但還沒看到你。保持安靜。
^1阿納托利：^7很好，你們到了！上車。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7眼睛放亮，留意各自負責的區域。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Solid copy Badger One, we're on it! Out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7獾一號，收到，我們來處理！通話完畢！

entries.source: Cheats are not enabled on this server.
entries.target: 此伺服器未啟用作弊功能。

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7I'll wait for you at the exfil point. Three hours.
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7我在撤離點等你們。三個小時。
AA-12 霰彈槍（紅點瞄準鏡）

entries.source: Locate your partner by looking for their name. If they are off screen the green arrow points towards them.
entries.target: 尋找搭檔的姓名即可定位。若搭檔在畫面外，綠色箭頭會指向他。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Next to the gas station to the west is a diner! Check there for a Stinger missile!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7西邊加油站旁有間小餐館！去那裡找刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Use the cover of the smoke to run past the BTR into the alley!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7利用煙霧掩護，跑過 BTR 進巷子！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Check your fire check your fire! Friendlies at 1 o'clock in the tan and brown building.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小心開火！小心開火！一點鐘方向的棕褐色建築裡有友軍。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7It's inside the diner! I got ya covered! Move!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7就在小餐館裡！我掩護你！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7The evac site is getting overrun! Take out the enemy vehicles!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7撤離點快被攻陷了！摧毀敵方車輛！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Bloody Yanks...whose side are they on anyway?!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7該死的美國佬……他們到底站在哪一邊？

entries.source: ^2Artillery Battery: ^7Negative, those are invalid coordinates, over.

entries.target: RPD 輕機槍（全金屬被甲彈）

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7They're dead, Soap.  Shepherd's cleaning house.  I'm working my way back to you.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7他們死了，肥皂。謝菲爾德將軍在滅口。我正設法回去找你。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7You're firing from the hip, Private. Snap to the target by aiming down your sights.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7你在腰射，二等兵。舉槍瞄準，迅速轉向目標。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company: ^7Oxide, Butcher Five-Actual. I've got a severed det cord - we're gonna need ten mikes to get the trunk rigged and the EBC primed, over.
entries.target: ^1暗影連：^7氧化物，這裡是屠夫五號指揮官。導爆索斷了。需要十分鐘在主通道布好炸藥，啟動緊急爆破系統，完畢。

entries.source: "...dissent, rebellion, and all-around hell-raising remain the true duty of patriots." - Barbara Ehrenreich
entries.target: 「……提出異議、反抗與到處惹麻煩，仍是愛國者真正的責任。」——芭芭拉．艾倫瑞克
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7卡車回來了。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen, grab that weapon off the table and fire at the targets behind you.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵，拿起桌上的武器，射擊你後面的靶子。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Kestrel 3-2, we're still in the caves, standby.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7紅隼三二，我們還在洞穴裡，待命。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, we need to move the VIP now! Clear that restaurant!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，現在就得轉移重要人物！肅清那間餐廳！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，往東！快！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez! Honey Badger's moving! Get the hell outta the way!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲！蜜獾要開動了！快閃開！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, use the designator on the vehicles on the golf course!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，用標定器瞄準高爾夫球場上的車輛！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Roger that, I'm oscar mike! Ramirez - regroup with the squad, go!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7收到，出發！拉米雷茲，與小隊會合！快！

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Riot Shields only protect from the front! Outflank them and they aren't any tougher than a normal enemy.
entries.target:
作戰情報
防暴盾只能保護正面！繞到側面，他們就和普通敵人一樣脆弱。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Makarov...you ever hear the old saying...the enemy of my enemy is my friend?
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7馬卡洛夫……你聽過那句老話嗎……敵人的敵人就是朋友？

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Badger One to Hunter Two, area suppressed.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7獾一號呼叫獵人二號，區域已壓制。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Take out the guard having a smoke, or wait for him to move along.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7幹掉抽菸的守衛，或等他走開。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Keep moving! We need to take the heat off Hunter 2-3!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7繼續前進！我們得替獵人二三分散敵人火力！

entries.source: Press your Move Forward key^3 &&1 ^7to move forward.
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7All right, break's over! Let's get the hell outta here.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7好，休息結束！離開這鬼地方。
M1014 霰彈槍（紅點瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Soap: ^7Copy that. The rest of the team landed near Ghost, pretty far to the east.
entries.target: ^2肥皂：^7收到。其他隊員降落在幽靈附近，在東邊很遠的地方。

entries.source:
You were killed by an exploding barrel.
Red barrels will explode when shot.
entries.target:
你被爆炸油桶炸死了。
紅色油桶遭射擊會爆炸。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roger that! Stay sharp! The prisoner may be in one of these cells!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到！保持警戒！囚犯可能就在其中一間牢房！

entries.source:
No one fights alone!
Play with a friend in Split Screen or Two Player Online.
entries.target:
沒有人孤軍奮戰！
與好友一起遊玩分割畫面或雙人連線。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7目標在你右邊。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7你驚動他們了。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Use it to to dispatch that chopper! I'll cover you! Go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7用它擊落那架直升機！我掩護你！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Scan the rooftops for hostiles. Stay frosty.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7搜索屋頂上的敵人。保持警戒。

entries.source: "Live well. It is the greatest revenge." - The Talmud
entries.target: 「好好活著，就是最好的復仇。」——《塔木德》

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Heads up! I see tangos coming from multiple directions!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7注意！多個方向都有敵人過來！

entries.source:
Insufficient free disk space.

Please free at least 5mb of free space on game drive.
entries.target:
可用磁碟空間不足。

請在遊戲磁碟釋出至少 5 MB 空間。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7You're gonna get us both in trouble with the General man. Get in The Pit and run the course, dude.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7你會害我們兩個都被將軍罵。進「深坑」跑訓練，老兄。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Ghost, we're going silent for a few minutes. Good luck up there in Russia. Price out.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7幽靈，我們要暫停通訊幾分鐘。祝你們在俄國順利。普萊斯通話完畢。
M14 EBR 步槍（消音器、瞄準鏡）

entries.source: You are Hurt. Get to Cover!

entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂，我們需要另一架掠奪者！

entries.source: Unable to read from memory device. Please check that the device is inserted correctly.
entries.target: 無法讀取儲存裝置。請確認裝置已正確連接。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We're getting shredded by that chopper. Look for some RPGs or rockets and take it down.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7直升機把我們打得很慘。找 RPG 或火箭，把它打下來。

entries.source: Use silenced sniper rifles and cunning to slip past the enemy patrols.
entries.target: 利用消音狙擊步槍與機智，避開敵方巡邏隊。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7What the hell was that? You trying to get us killed?
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7剛才那是什麼鬼？想害死我們嗎？

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Stay here and spot me. Wait for my go.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7留在這裡掩護我，等我的信號。

entries.source: Can't Crouch To Use This Weapon Here.
entries.target: 此處無法蹲下使用這把武器。

entries.source: Can't Stand To Use This Weapon Here.
entries.target: 此處無法站立使用這把武器。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Let's go. We're oscar mike - moving to Deck Two.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7走，出發。前往第二層甲板。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7算了，還是不要。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, get upstairs and look for the ACS module.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，上樓找 ACS 模組。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Into the woods! Let's go, let's go!
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez this is Foley. Get to the roof, there's a maintenance ladder in the kitchen.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，我是佛利。上屋頂，廚房裡有維修梯。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7There's the submarine! Right below that crane!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7潛艦在那裡！就在那座起重機下！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Five men, automatic rifles, frag grenades. One German Shepherd.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7五個人、自動步槍、破片手榴彈，還有一隻德國牧羊犬。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Thunder Two-One, I've popped red smoke in the treeline! Standby to engage on my mark!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7雷霆二一，我已在樹林邊緣投放紅色煙霧！等我下令再攻擊！
AUG HBAR 輕機槍（全金屬被甲彈）
^1馬卡洛夫：^7聯邦安全局，幹掉他們。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7The door is shut - you guys keep Ivan out.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7門關好了。你們把俄軍擋在外面。

entries.source: ^2Soap: ^7It's good to have you back, old man.
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Target the enemy infantry! Take 'em out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！瞄準敵方步兵！幹掉他們！
數字鍵盤 左方向鍵

entries.source:
Kill all fifteen Juggernauts on the oil rig.
This probably isn't even possible.
entries.target:
擊殺鑽油平台上的十五名重裝兵。
這大概根本不可能。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Butcher Seven, Oxide.  We've lost contact with Disciple Five.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7屠夫七號，這裡是氧化物。我們與門徒五號失聯了。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roger that! Everyone cover the field to the southeast! Move!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7收到！全員掩護東南面的空地！快！

entries.source: ^2NORAD HQ: ^7Sand Bravo, be advised, running diagnostics to scan for malfunction.
entries.target: ^2北美防空司令部：^7沙地 B，注意，我們正在執行診斷，檢查是否故障。

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
The white dot marks the location of your objective.
entries.target:
作戰情報
白點標示任務目標的位置。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Got an enemy smokescreen to the west.
^2Captain MacTavish: ^7They are going back to their positions.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7他們正返回原位。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Be advised - you've got more tangos headed your way.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7注意，又有敵人朝你們過去了。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Star, or we will fire on you!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7星星！否則我們就開火！

entries.source: Press and hold^3 &&1 ^7to use the M82 .50 Caliber Sniper Rifle
entries.target: 按住^3 &&1 ^7使用 M82 .50 口徑狙擊步槍
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，你這樣可不夠隱密。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7We gotta get to the LZ! Roach, come on!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7我們得去降落區！小強，快！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap! I've found some transport! Keep moving west! I'll meet you en route!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂！我找到車了！繼續往西走！我們途中會合！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Keep your fire low...we got friendlies inserting up there.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7別往高處打，友軍正在上面進場。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Makarov...you ever hear the old saying..."the enemy of my enemy is my friend?"
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7馬卡洛夫……你聽過那句老話嗎……「敵人的敵人就是朋友」？
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7那個藍點就是我。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Take out those vehicles! The evac site is taking heavy fire!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！摧毀那些車輛！撤離點正遭猛烈攻擊！

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7I have eyes on additional hostile forces moving in on your position. They're approaching through the solar panels east of the house.
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7看到更多敵軍向你們的位置移動。他們從屋子東側的太陽能板區逼近。
Intervention 狙擊步槍（ACOG 瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ok, Private Allen, we don't have all day. Get in The Pit.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7艾倫一等兵，我們沒時間耗一整天。進「深坑」。

entries.source: Hold down^3 &&1 ^7to lean to the left.

OPERATIONAL INTEL
You can hurt your teammate! Avoid friendly fire.
entries.target:
作戰情報
你會傷到隊友！避免誤傷友軍。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Your call, Two-One. Outlaw is pinned down at the bunkers. You're cleared hot along the MSR, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7二一，由你決定。亡命徒被困在碉堡，准許沿主要補給路線開火，完畢。

entries.source: Wait for the dog to bite to grab its throat. ^3( [{+melee}] )^7
entries.target: 等軍犬咬下來時，再抓住牠的喉嚨。^3( [{+melee}] )^7
^2史崔克砲手：^7收到，攻擊你標定的目標。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Picking up large heat signatures near the tower, could be BMPs. I'd avoid that area.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7塔附近有大型熱源，可能是 BMP。最好避開那裡。

entries.source: An oil rig and a favela full of Juggernauts.  These Ops are fast and brutal.
entries.target: 鑽油平台和貧民窟遍布重裝兵。這些行動節奏快，也極為殘酷。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Firing an unsuppressed weapon is going to alert a lot of them, Roach.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7小強，沒裝消音器的槍會驚動一大群人。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7You need to aim down your sights, Allen!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7你得舉槍瞄準，艾倫！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, put suppressing fire on that house!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，壓制那棟房子！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! There's too many of them! Get the hell out of there and find a way to the rooftops! Move!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！敵人太多了！快離開那裡，設法上屋頂！快！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Take them out or try to slip past. Your call.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7幹掉他們，或設法溜過去。你決定。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Check out the seal on this door...I thought the President's bunker was under the West Wing.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7看看門上的徽章……我以為總統的地堡在西翼底下。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7And don't shoot him! We need him alive and unharmed!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7別射他！我們要他活著，而且毫髮無傷！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7If your target is close to where you are aiming, you can snap to it quickly by aiming down your sights.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7如果目標就在瞄準方向附近，舉槍瞄準就能迅速轉向它。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I'm heading for that hole in the floor on the far side of the showers! Follow me! Let's go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我要去浴室另一端地板上的洞！跟我來！快！

entries.source: "Patriotism is supporting your country all the time, and your government when it deserves it." - Mark Twain
entries.target: 「愛國，就是永遠支持祖國，並在政府值得支持時支持政府。」——馬克．吐溫

entries.source: Melee the dog right when it bites to grab its throat. ^3( [{+melee}] )^7
entries.target: 軍犬咬下來時立刻近戰攻擊，抓住牠的喉嚨。^3( [{+melee}] )^7

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Sure it matters who's got the biggest stick, but it matters a helluva lot more who's swinging it.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7誰握有最強大的武器固然重要，但誰來使用它才更加重要。
此處無法布設闊刀地雷
數字鍵盤 下方向鍵

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Nikolai! Just shut up and land the bloody plane! We're on our way!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7尼古萊！閉嘴，把那該死的飛機降下來！我們正在過去！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Stop firing from the hip! Aim down your sights!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7別再腰射了！舉槍瞄準！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Shut up! Get a grip Corporal! Our weapons still work, which means we can still kick some ass.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7閉嘴！冷靜點，下士！我們的武器還能用，就還能痛宰敵人。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, these muppets have no idea we're here. Let's take this nice and slow.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，這些蠢蛋還不知道我們來了。慢慢來，別急。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Imagine they're just about freezing right now.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7我想他們現在快凍僵了。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Good enough, but you're getting a little sloppy.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7算是過關，但你的動作有點馬虎。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Roach take control of the Predator drone.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7小強，接管掠奪者無人機。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Let's go! Move up! This is a timed course, Private
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7快！往前！這是計時訓練，二等兵。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord, Hunter Two-One-Actual. Triple-A has been neutralized. We're heading to 4677 Brookmere Road.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，這裡是獵人二一指揮官。防空砲已摧毀，正前往布魯克米爾路4677號。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Everyone else, plant some claymores outside the door if you got 'em...we need to cover our backs!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7其他人有闊刀地雷就裝在門外，得顧好後方！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Have you found us some transport?
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7找到交通工具了嗎？

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Enemy helo, get out of sight.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7敵方直升機，躲起來。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad! They're targeting the Stryker! Watch for RPGs!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊！他們正瞄準史崔克！留意 RPG！

entries.source: It looks like you are low on virtual memory. This can cause the game to run slowly and it may stop completely. It is highly recommended that you close some programs before running Modern Warfare 2. Do you want to run Modern Warfare 2 anyway?
entries.target: 你的虛擬記憶體似乎不足，可能使遊戲變慢，甚至完全停止。強烈建議執行《現代戰爭 2》前，先關閉部分程式。是否仍要執行？

entries.source: The recommended settings have been updated since the last time you ran Modern Warfare 2. Would you like the game to configure itself optimally with these new settings? This is recommended for most people. It will change your system settings but not your controls.
entries.target: 《現代戰爭 2》的建議設定已更新。是否讓遊戲自動套用新的最佳設定？建議大多數玩家選用。這會變更系統設定，保留操作設定。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap, where are you? Get back here!
^1Shepherd: ^7All units be advised this is Gold Eagle. The site has been compromised.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7各單位注意，這裡是金鷹。基地已遭入侵。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7各小隊出發。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7目標已消滅。

entries.source: Modern Warfare 2 couldn't write a file. The hard drive is probably full.
entries.target: 《現代戰爭 2》無法寫入檔案，硬碟可能已滿。

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Press^3 [{+actionslot 1}] ^7to toggle the timer and mission stats.
entries.target:
作戰情報
按^3 [{+actionslot 1}] ^7切換計時器與任務統計。

entries.source: ^2Meat: ^7Roach is down! Roach is down! It's just me and you Royce!
entries.target: ^2米特：^7小強倒下了！小強倒下了！羅伊斯，只剩你和我了！

entries.source:
You stepped into a Minefield and died.
Watch out for the Red and White Minefield Signs!
entries.target:
你踩進雷區而死。
留意紅白色雷區警告牌！
L86 LSW 輕支援武器（紅點瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, concentrate your fire on that house!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，集中火力攻擊那棟房子！

entries.source:
You drove into a Minefield and died.
Watch out for the Red and White Minefield Signs!
entries.target:
你駛入雷區而死。
留意紅白色雷區警告牌！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! He's on the move and headed your way! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！他又開始跑了，正朝你過去！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We need to punch through right here!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7我們得從這裡突破！
^2普萊斯上尉：^7被發現了！幹掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private! Gimme a sitrep! Where's Raptor?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7二等兵，回報狀況！猛禽在哪？

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap, cover me. I'm gonna slot that guy over there and use his radio to tap into their comms.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂，掩護我。我要幹掉那傢伙，用他的無線電監聽敵軍通訊。
沒有剩餘的破片手榴彈
^2史崔克砲手：^7確認，攻擊檢查哨的步兵。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Come on, we gotta get outta here! Move! Move!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7快，我們得離開這裡！快！快！
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7不能讓他們拿下這個地區。

entries.source: ^1Major Petrov: ^7Come out with your hands up!
entries.target: ^1彼得羅夫少校：^7舉起雙手走出來！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7The old shower room's about thirty feet ahead on your left. You'll have to breach the wall to get in.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7舊浴室在前方左側約三十英尺，要炸開牆才能進去。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7All Hunter teams, this is Badger One. Paint the target, over.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7獵人各小隊，這裡是獾一號。請標定目標，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap, they're about to find the bodies! We need to take them out!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，他們快發現屍體了！得幹掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7I got a visual on smoke coming from the crash site. That's where Raptor went down!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7看到墜機地點的煙了！猛禽就是在那裡墜落的！
巴雷特 .50 口徑狙擊步槍

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Move up to Deck Two and watch your sectors.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7上第二層甲板，留意各自負責的區域。
M1014 霰彈槍（全息瞄準鏡）
M4A1 卡賓槍（榴彈發射器）
G18 自動手槍（全息瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Let's follow them quietly, and pick off any stragglers.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7悄悄跟著他們，幹掉落單的。
M4A1 卡賓槍（ACOG 瞄準鏡、榴彈發射器）

entries.source: M4A1 Grenadier w/ Red Dot Sight
entries.target: M4A1 卡賓槍（紅點瞄準鏡、榴彈發射器）

entries.source: "Patriotism is your conviction that this country is superior to all others because you were born in it." - George Bernard Shaw
entries.target: 「愛國主義，就是只因生於這個國家，便堅信它優於所有其他國家。」——蕭伯納
M4A1 卡賓槍（全息瞄準鏡、榴彈發射器）

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Two-One-Delta copies all. Ramirez, you're with me let's go.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7二一 D 全部收到。拉米雷茲，跟我來，走。
^2匕首二一：^7十二點鐘方向，RPG 小組！

entries.source: "Those who plot the destruction of others often perish in the attempt." - Thomas Moore
entries.target: 「圖謀毀滅他人的人，往往在行動中自取滅亡。」——湯瑪斯．摩爾

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We're getting overrun! Everyone to the roof! Now!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7我們快被攻陷了！所有人上屋頂！現在！

entries.source: ^2Pvt. Walden: ^7BCT One is trapped across the river in the red zone! We've lost contact!
entries.target: ^2華登二等兵：^7第一戰鬥旅被困在河對岸的紅區！我們失去聯絡了！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7Washington Monument evac site taking heavy fire from enemy armor and aircraft! We're down to 50 percent combat effectiveness!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7華盛頓紀念碑撤離點正遭裝甲車與飛機猛烈攻擊！戰力剩百分之五十！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap, that area's full of hostiles. Keep to the left.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，那區到處是敵人。靠左走。
M240 機槍（熱影像瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^1Major Petrov: ^7You have five seconds to comply!
entries.target: ^1彼得羅夫少校：^7給你五秒照做！
Striker 霰彈槍（全息瞄準鏡）

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Try using Grenades, RPGs and Grenade Launchers against enemies with Riot Shields.
entries.target:
作戰情報
對付持防暴盾的敵人，試著使用手榴彈、RPG 和榴彈發射器。

entries.source: ^2Hunter 2-3: ^72-1, we are combat ineffective here! We are taking heavy fire from the school, can you assist, over?!
entries.target: ^2獵人二三：^7二一，我們已失去戰鬥能力！學校有猛烈火力，能來支援嗎？完畢！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Nice! He's breaking to the right again! Roach, if you see him, don't shoot him! I need him unharmed!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7很好！他又往右跑了！小強，看到他也別射擊！我要他毫髮無傷！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach! Don't stray too far from the safehouse! We need to protect the transfer!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強！別離安全屋太遠！我們得保護資料傳輸！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7Enemy troops are inside the evac site! Repeat, enemy troops are inside the evac site! We lost the civvies! No!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7敵軍進入撤離點了！重複，敵軍進入撤離點了！平民全完了！不！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Bollocks! The skies are clear. Send the chopper now.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7胡扯！天空一片乾淨，現在就派直升機來。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Enemy fire team eliminated in Section Four-Charlie.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7四 C 區的敵方火力小組已消滅。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Everyone, take out that helicopter before the convoy arrives! Move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7所有人，在車隊抵達前擊落直升機！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Quiet - I think I see something.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7安靜，我好像看到什麼了。

entries.source: ^2Helicopter Pilot: ^7Bravo Six, we're getting close to bingo fuel. What's your status over?
entries.target: ^2直升機駕駛員：^7B 六號，我們快到返航油量了。你們狀況如何？完畢。

entries.source: Friendly fire will not be tolerated!
"Revenge, at first though sweet, Bitter ere long back on itself recoils." - John Milton
entries.target: 「復仇起初雖然甜美，很快卻會反噬自身，留下苦澀。」——約翰．彌爾頓

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7All fire teams, be advised - enemy operators are ex-SAS and Task Force 141. Approach with extreme caution, over.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7各火力小組注意，敵人是前 SAS 和一四一特遣隊隊員。接近時務必謹慎，完畢。
ACR（全息瞄準鏡、榴彈發射器）
RPD 輕機槍（紅點瞄準鏡）
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7抓緊！別鬆手！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Shepherd'll be a hero...'cause all you need to change the world is one good lie and a river of blood.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7謝菲爾德將軍會成為英雄……因為只要一個漂亮的謊言，再讓血流成河，就能改變世界。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez! Honey Badger's moving! Get outta the way!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲！蜜獾要開動了！閃開！
^2佛利中士：^7收到，二一通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sub Commander: ^7Hotel Six, be advised, hostages have been confirmed at your location along with possible explosives, over.
entries.target: ^2潛艦指揮官：^7H 六號，注意，你們的位置已確認有人質，也可能有炸藥，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Price, come in! They're opening the silo doors on the sub! Hurry!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7普萊斯，回答！潛艦正在開啟發射井蓋！快！

entries.source: "A man's feet must be planted in his country, but his eyes should survey the world." - George Santayana
entries.target: 「一個人的雙腳應立足祖國，雙眼卻應放眼世界。」——喬治．桑塔亞那
標槍飛彈發射器（鎖定型）

entries.source:
You died holding a grenade for too long.
Holding ^3[{+frag}]^7 allows you to cook off live grenades.
entries.target:
手榴彈握太久，炸死了自己。
按住 ^3[{+frag}]^7 可預熱已拉開保險的手榴彈。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Prepare to engage! We're goin' in!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7準備交戰！我們要進去了！

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7All personnel - be advised, we have two enemy foot-mobiles on the catwalk heading to the crow's nest.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7全員注意，有兩名敵人正沿棧道前往瞭望塔。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Focus on driving the boat, I'll keep them suppressed!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7專心開船，我來壓制他們！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach, go upstairs and check any locked rooms on the top floor. Breach and clear.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強，上樓檢查頂樓所有上鎖的房間。破門清剿。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Heads up, the truck just stopped.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7注意，卡車剛停下來。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7I only did what needed to be done.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7我只是做了該做的事。

entries.source: ^2NORAD HQ: ^7Sierra Delta, uh... we may have a minor ACS fault here. Do you have anything on your scope?
entries.target: ^2北美防空司令部：^7S D，我們這邊可能有輕微的 ACS 故障。你們的雷達上有目標嗎？

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, use your laser designator to call in artillery on those vehicles!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，用雷射標定器呼叫砲擊那些車輛！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ok, head on in. Timer starts as soon as the first target pops.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7好，進去吧。第一個靶子出現時就開始計時。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We're just past the enemy blockade at Checkpoint Lima. Now proceeding into Arcadia, over.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7剛通過 L 檢查哨的敵方封鎖線，現在正進入阿卡迪亞，完畢。
^2普萊斯：^7樓梯頂端那個交給我。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Fire from the prone position, Private.

entries.target: G18 自動手槍（全金屬被甲彈）
^2北美防空司令部：^7S D，請重複！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Get a charge on the door. We'll breach from both sides.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7在門上安裝炸藥。我們從兩側破門。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7雪地摩托車！幹掉他們！
RPD 輕機槍（ACOG 瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Kilo Six-One, the primary exfil point is compromised! We're en route to the backup LZ using enemy transport! Meet us there! Over!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7K 六一，主要撤離點已暴露！我們正搭敵方載具前往備用降落區！到那裡會合，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! We're running on fumes here! You got thirty seconds! Run!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！我們快沒油了！你有三十秒！跑！
巴雷特 .50 口徑狙擊步槍（ACOG 瞄準鏡）
德拉古諾夫（ACOG 瞄準鏡）
^2佛利中士：^7敵方闊刀地雷，小心腳下。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! Try to find a way into the ice cream shop on the right to flank 'em!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！設法進入右邊的冰淇淋店，包抄他們！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7This decryption code better be worth the price we paid...
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7這組解密碼最好值得我們付出的代價……

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Hostiles in the perimeter! Open fire! Open fire!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7敵人進了防線！開火！開火！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Gotta find me a rifle with Iron sites. These red dots are worthless.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7得找把有機械瞄具的步槍。這些紅點瞄準鏡全廢了。
M4A1 卡賓槍（紅點瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Let's get the drop on them...Ramirez, activate your heartbeat sensor.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7給他們來個措手不及。拉米雷茲，啟動心跳感測器。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Control, this is Hotel Six. Our cover is blown.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7指揮中心，這裡是 H 六號。我們已暴露。
MG4 輕機槍（ACOG 瞄準鏡）

entries.source:
You were killed by an explosion.
Some burning objects can explode.
entries.target:
你被爆炸炸死了。
部分燃燒中的物件會爆炸。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Forget about it! We got a minigun on board! Get on the helicopter! Let's go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！別管了！機上有迷你砲！上直升機！快！
M14 EBR 步槍（熱影像瞄準鏡）
M21 EBR 狙擊步槍（ACOG 瞄準鏡）
M249 SAW 輕機槍（ACOG 瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7The Monastery.  Didn't survive the Purges.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7後來成了修道院。沒能躲過大清洗。
M249 SAW 輕機槍（前握把）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen here is gonna do a quick weapons demonstration to show you locals how its done.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵會做個簡短的武器示範，讓各位當地弟兄看看正確的操作方式。
M249 SAW 輕機槍（紅點瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Because what happens over here, matters over there. We don't get to sit one out.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7因為這裡發生的事，也會影響那裡。我們不能置身事外。
M21 EBR 狙擊步槍（熱影像瞄準鏡）
W1200 霰彈槍（紅點瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Incoming from the south! Two dozen plus foot mobiles!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7南方來敵！二十四名以上步兵！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7It'll hold for now. Come on, get up!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7暫時止住血了。來，站起來！
^2鄧恩下士：^7說德州，該死……快說啊。

entries.source: "If you are ashamed to stand by your colors, you had better seek another flag." - Anonymous
entries.target: 「若羞於挺身捍衛自己的旗幟，就該另尋一面旗幟。」——佚名

entries.source: "Ask not what your country can do for you, but what you can do for your country." - John F. Kennedy
entries.target: 「別問國家能為你做什麼，要問你能為國家做什麼。」——約翰．F．甘迺迪

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Try to flank and hit them from the sides!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7試著包抄，從側面攻擊！

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7I don't remember the damn countersign all right? I'm just a runner! Don't shoot!
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7我不記得那該死的回令，好嗎？我只是傳令兵！別開槍！
M4A1 卡賓槍（熱影像瞄準鏡）
.44 馬格南左輪手槍（消音器）
^2鄧恩下士：^7公寓旁有敵方步兵！

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7Be advised, the Predator is offline I repeat, the Predator is offline!
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7注意，掠奪者已離線！重複，掠奪者已離線！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We need to get the hell out of this building before those fast movers make another pass.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7那些戰機再飛過來前，我們得離開這棟樓。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7You're a Ranger, Private. I know you can get the grenade closer to the target than that, hooah?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7你可是遊騎兵，二等兵。我知道你能把手榴彈扔得更靠近目標，明白嗎？
M9 手槍（全金屬被甲彈）

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Ghost, Roach is down! We lost him!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7幽靈，小強倒下了！我們失去他了！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, return to your post! We gotta cover the evac site!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，回到崗位！得掩護撤離點！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7數到三動手。
Striker 霰彈槍（紅點瞄準鏡）
Striker 霰彈槍（紅點瞄準鏡）

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
If a Special Op is too hard or easy, try a different difficulty.
entries.target:
作戰情報
若特種作戰太難或太簡單，試試其他難度。
Intervention 狙擊步槍（熱影像瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Roach, we can't afford to keep giving away our position like that. Maintain a low profile!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7小強，不能老是這樣暴露位置！保持隱蔽！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roger that! I'll head for the rooftops and try to cut him off on the right! He's going to have no choice but to head west!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到！我上屋頂，試著從右邊截住他！逼他只能往西逃！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Amazing work, dude. Okay, now that's how you run The Pit.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7幹得漂亮，老兄。這才是跑「深坑」的正確方式。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Sucks away the oxygen.  Snuffs the flame.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7它會吸走氧氣，撲滅火焰。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Move up! The other group's coming back!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7前進！另一組要回來了！

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Thats a direct hit hunter two one, keep up the fire.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，直接命中！繼續開火。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Allen, adopt a crouching stance and aim down your sights.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫，蹲下並舉槍瞄準。
AA-12 霰彈槍（全息瞄準鏡、霰彈槍）
AA-12 霰彈槍（心跳感測器、霰彈槍）
^2佛利中士：^7正前方，頂樓有 RPG！
AA-12 霰彈槍（心跳感測器、消音器、霰彈槍）

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Ok, I see you on the cameras.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7好，在監視器上看到你們了。
AA-12 霰彈槍（紅點瞄準鏡、霰彈槍）

entries.source: "One good act of vengeance deserves another." - Jon Jefferson
entries.target: 「一場痛快的復仇，值得再來一場。」——強．傑佛遜
AA-12 霰彈槍（消音器、霰彈槍）

entries.source: Hunt down and eliminate the Favela gang.  Minimize civilian casualties.
entries.target: 追捕並消滅貧民窟幫派，盡量降低平民傷亡。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Copy that! Keep searching! Let me know if you see him! Out!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到！繼續搜索！看到他就通知我！通話完畢！
^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！到巷子裡來！

entries.source: SCAR-H Red Dot Sight w/ Shotgun
entries.target: SCAR-H（紅點瞄準鏡、下掛霰彈槍）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Last but not least, you need to know how to toss a frag grenade.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7最後，你得學會怎麼扔破片手榴彈。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7It's been a tough week, gentlemen. We've lost more than we ever dreamed.  But we will recover.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7各位，這一週很艱難。我們的損失遠超想像，但我們會復原。

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Keep your distance! Charging an enemy with a Riot Shield is a bad idea.
entries.target:
作戰情報
保持距離！衝向持防暴盾的敵人不是好主意。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Breach and clear the safehouse! Go! Go!
^2Captain Price: ^7Use a Predator missile on that truck!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7用掠奪者飛彈打那輛卡車！

entries.source: "Patriotism varies, from a noble devotion to a moral lunacy." - W.R. Inge
entries.target: 「愛國主義的樣貌，從高尚的奉獻到道德的瘋狂皆有。」——W．R．英格
L86 LSW 輕支援武器（提高射速）
^2鄧恩下士：^7他們衝著架橋車去了！

entries.source: ^1Viktor: ^7I've waited a long time for this.

entries.target: 巴雷特 .50 口徑狙擊步槍（加大彈匣）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Flank 'em through the houses! Go go go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7穿過房子包抄他們！快！快！快！

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Look for enemies close to or facing your target before you shoot. Take out the entire group quickly to avoid breaking stealth.
entries.target:
作戰情報
開槍前，留意靠近目標或面向目標的敵人。迅速消滅整組，避免暴露。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7I'm onto him! He's trying to double back through the alleys below!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7我追上他了！他想從下面的巷子繞回去！
M21 EBR 狙擊步槍（全金屬被甲彈）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Do it again and speed it up. Show these men how to snap to new targets by quickly popping in and out of aiming down your sights.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7再做一次，動作快點。讓他們看看如何快速舉槍、放下，再舉槍，迅速轉向新目標。
AUG HBAR 輕機槍（瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7My friend, from up here, it looks like the whole village is trying to kill you!
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7朋友，從這裡往下看，好像整個村子都想殺你！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7All snipers, enemy fire is interfering with the evac of civilians! Request additional sniper fire on enemy targets west of the Monument, over!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7各狙擊手，敵方火力阻礙平民撤離！請加強狙擊紀念碑西方的目標，完畢！
AUG HBAR 輕機槍（紅點瞄準鏡）
AUG HBAR 輕機槍（消音器）

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We've got eyes on Rojas - wait! Shite! he's headed back towards you!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7看到羅哈斯了……等等！該死，他又往你那邊去了！

entries.source: Both players are not ready to breach
entries.target: 兩名玩家尚未準備好破門
^2鄧恩下士：^7區域已清空！跳下去！

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7The Americans are making a mistake. They will never take Al-Asad alive.
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7美國人犯了錯。他們絕不可能活捉阿薩德。

entries.source: ^2Dagger Two-One: ^7Overlord, Dagger Two-two and Two-three are down. I repeat, Dagger Two-Two and Two-Three are down, over.
entries.target: ^2匕首二一：^7霸王，匕首二二和二三墜落。重複，匕首二二和二三墜落，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I'll cover you! Come to me!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我掩護你！到我這裡來！
^2肥皂：^7掠奪者無人機已被擊落。

entries.source: Look for the glowing marker on the German anti-aircraft vehicle.
entries.target: 尋找德軍防空車上的發光標記。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Since when does Shepherd care about danger close...
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7謝菲爾德將軍什麼時候在乎過誤傷友軍……

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7This is easier when you do some of the work.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7你要是也幫點忙，事情就簡單多了。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Everyone else listen up! We're moving Raptor asap! Stack up by the south entrance of Nates!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7其他人聽著！儘快轉移猛禽！在奈特餐廳南入口集結！
M4A1 卡賓槍（全金屬被甲彈）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Do it again. You can snap to a new target by quickly engaging and releasing your aim.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7再做一次。快速舉槍、放下，再舉槍，就能迅速轉向新目標。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Hostile fire team suppressed, section five-charlie.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7五 C 區的敵方火力小組已壓制。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Get behind something solid! That BTR's got you in his sights!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7找堅固的掩體！那輛 BTR 正瞄著你！

entries.source: Cannot breach. Clear the area of all enemies
entries.target: 無法破門，先清除區域內所有敵人

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7I have a visual on an enemy UAV operator remote-piloting those missiles!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7看到敵方無人機操作員了！那些飛彈是他在遙控！
L86 LSW 輕支援武器（ACOG 瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Use 'em to take down that sonofabitch! Go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7用它們幹掉那混蛋！快！
L86 LSW 輕支援武器（前握把）
L86 LSW 輕支援武器（消音器）

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7There is a safehouse in Azerbaijan that Al-Asad has used in the past. I am sending you the coordinates.
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7阿薩德以前用過亞塞拜然的一座安全屋。我正傳送座標。
L86 LSW 輕支援武器（全金屬被甲彈）

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Area cleared! Move into the building!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7區域已清空！進入建築！
L86 LSW 輕支援武器（加大彈匣）
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，看看你的心跳感測器。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Patrol coming our way - go left, quickly!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7巡邏隊正往這裡走，快往左！

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Uniforms are relics.  The war rages everywhere.  And there will be casualties.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7制服已是過時的東西。戰火無處不在，也必然有人犧牲。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Ghost, our driver's dead! We're on foot! Meet us at the Hotel Rio and cut him off if you can!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7幽靈，駕駛死了！我們改成步行！到里約飯店會合，能攔就攔住他！

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Your objective is to extract a high value individual from a 'panic room' on the second floor of that house.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7你們的目標，是從那棟房子二樓的避難室撤出一名高價值人物。
^2普萊斯上尉：^7這條山脊正合適。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7To know you're close to the end is a kind of freedom.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7知道自己快走到終點，也是一種自由。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Disciple Six, we've lost all contact with Disciple Five. Check it out over.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7門徒六號，我們與門徒五號完全失聯。去查看，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Your accuracy will increase if you are crouched or prone on the ground.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7蹲下或趴在地上，射擊會更準。
^2鄧恩下士：^7二一指揮官，你還在嗎？

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Our perimeter is breached! Enemies on the roof!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7防線被突破了！屋頂有敵人！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Slow down. Their vehicles can't follow us this far.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7慢點。他們的車追不到這麼深。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7When the time's right, Corporal. When the time's right.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7時機一到，下士。時機一到就去。
^2普萊斯上尉：^7摧毀那輛裝甲車！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, the crashed heli at 12 o'clock is our objective.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，十二點鐘方向墜毀的直升機就是目標。
AA-12 霰彈槍（心跳感測器）
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強倒下了！

entries.source: ^2Overlord (HQ Radio): ^7Solid copy Hunter 2-1 Actual, proceed with caution to the rally point. EPWs may still be in the area. Over.
entries.target: ^2霸王（指揮部無線電）：^7獵人二一指揮官，收到。小心前往集合點，區域內可能仍有敵方戰俘。完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We may need to go to 'Plan B' if things go south.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7情況不妙的話，可能得採用「B 計畫」。
.44 馬格南左輪手槍（全金屬被甲彈）

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7They're layin' down a smokescreen to the north.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7他們在北邊施放煙幕。

entries.source: Double tap^3 &&1 ^7to stand up from crouch.

entries.target: .44 馬格南左輪手槍（加大彈匣）
G18 自動手槍（加大彈匣）

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Well that ought to slow him down! Roach, we're keeping him from doubling back! Keep moving to intercept! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7這下應該能讓他慢點！小強，我們正在阻止他往回跑！繼續前進，截住他！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We got a BTR! Get out, get out!
^2Captain Price: ^7Soap! Don't get pinned down out there! Keep heading west for the runway area!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂！別被困住！繼續往西前往跑道區！
M93 Raffica 點放手槍（消音器）
M93 Raffica 點放手槍（全金屬被甲彈）
^2史崔克砲手：^7讓開，我們要開動了。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Keep moving! We're almost at the market!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7繼續前進！快到市場了！
沙漠之鷹（全金屬被甲彈）
Ranger 雙管霰彈槍（全金屬被甲彈）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Team, find an anti-aircraft weapon and take out the gunship!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，找防空武器，擊落武裝直升機！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach - this is their territory and they know it well! Keep an eye open for ambush positions and check your corners!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，這是他們的地盤，他們很熟！留意伏擊位置，檢查每個轉角！
Striker 霰彈槍（全金屬被甲彈）

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Enemies will shoot exposed claymores. Conceal your claymores behind cover.
entries.target:
作戰情報
敵人會射擊暴露的闊刀地雷。將地雷藏在掩蔽物後。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Let's move - we've got more hostages on the upper decks.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7前進，上層甲板還有人質。
1887 型霰彈槍（全金屬被甲彈）
^2鄧恩下士：^7剛才那是什麼鬼東西？

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7That BTR's lost sight of you! Move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7那輛 BTR 看不到你了！快走！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Everyone move up, get out of the killzone! We gotta buy some time for those casevac birds!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7所有人前進，離開火力區！替傷患撤離直升機爭取時間！

entries.source: ^1Major Petrov: ^7Very well - I will give you five seconds before I execute your comrade!
entries.target: ^1彼得羅夫少校：^7很好。五秒後，我就處決你的同伴！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Solid copy! RPG team approaching from the west!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7確實收到！RPG 小隊從西面逼近！
MG4 輕機槍（紅點瞄準鏡）
RPG-7 火箭發射器（鎖定型）

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7The camera feed in solitary confinement is dead. The power must be down in that section.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7禁閉區的監視器沒訊號，那區應該停電了。
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7歷史是由勝利者書寫的。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Get past that Little Bird before its guns spin up!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7趁那架小鳥的機槍還沒轉起來，衝過去！
刺針飛彈發射器（鎖定型）

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7You and I both know you won't last a week.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7你我都知道，你撐不過一星期。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Aim down your sights, then pop in and out to acquire new targets.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7舉槍瞄準，再快速放下、舉起，轉向新目標。
M93 Raffica 點放手槍（紅點瞄準鏡）

entries.source: Hold down^3 &&1 ^7to aim down the sight

entries.target: 巴雷特 .50 口徑狙擊步槍（心跳感測器）
M21 EBR 狙擊步槍（加大彈匣）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, take point - we're cuttin' to the right.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，打頭陣。我們往右切。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Stay low with that shield so I can get a clean shot!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7拿盾牌時壓低身體，讓我能瞄準！

entries.source: ^2Dagger Two-One: ^7Overlord, this is Dagger Two-One. We've taken some of the heat off the evac site -
entries.target: ^2匕首二一：^7霸王，這裡是匕首二一。我們已減輕撤離點的部分壓力……
^2普萊斯：^7到了，在這裡掛上繩索。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company: ^7I see him, he's over here!
entries.target: ^1暗影連：^7我看到他了，就在這裡！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Be careful about picking up enemy weapons, Roach. Any un-suppressed firearms will attract a lot of attention.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，撿敵方武器時小心。沒裝消音器的槍，會引來一堆麻煩。

entries.source: "If an injury has to be done to a man it should be so severe that his vengeance need not be feared." - Machiavelli
entries.target: 「若必須傷害一個人，就要傷得夠重，使人無須畏懼他的復仇。」——馬基維利
AUG HBAR 輕機槍（全息瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Gentlemen, good work on taking the town.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7各位，城鎮拿得漂亮。

entries.source: ^1UAV Operator: ^7Air-to-ground missiles online. Ready when you are, sir.
entries.target: ^1無人機操作員：^7空對地飛彈已就緒。隨時能發射，長官。
^2普萊斯：^7他們有盾牌！用閃光彈！

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7But you bring down one enemy and they find someone even worse to replace him.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7但你打倒了一個敵人，他們又會找個更壞的傢伙來接替。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7We got a chopper on our six! Take evasive maneuvers!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7直升機在後方！採取閃避！

entries.source: "Don't get mad, get even." - Robert F. Kennedy
entries.target: 「別生氣，討回來。」——羅伯特．F．甘迺迪

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Tangos just got out of the truck.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7敵人剛下卡車。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Good, they're splitting up. Let them separate.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7好，他們分頭走了。讓他們分開。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Eyes up! Enemy gunship comin' in hot!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7注意上方！敵方武裝直升機高速接近！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7I'll take the one on the right. On my mark.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7右邊那個交給我。等我下令。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1, be advised, multiple enemy foot-mobiles have been sighted near the taco joint, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，注意，墨西哥捲餅店附近發現多名敵方步兵，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Negative, that's an invalid target over.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7不行，那不是有效目標，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Go back go back! We'll find another way out!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7回去！回去！另找出口！
Intervention 狙擊步槍（全金屬被甲彈）
MG4 輕機槍（熱影像瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Roger that! Squad! Let's go! We're oscar mike!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7收到！全隊！走吧！開始移動！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Sarge, check out these tats. Not your average trooper, hooah?
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7中士，看看這些刺青。他不是普通士兵，對吧？

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
When selecting missions, red text indicates a higher difficulty than green text.
entries.target:
作戰情報
選擇任務時，紅字代表的難度比綠字更高。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One, relay from Goliath One: you got an enemy helicopter loaded for bear, approaching your area, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，轉達巨人一號：一架全副武裝的敵方直升機正接近你們，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Got it. Sounds like the satellite's in the far hangar.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到。聽起來衛星在遠處那座機庫裡。

entries.source:
You were run over.
Keep an eye out for enemy vehicles on the move.
entries.target:
你被車輛輾過。
留意移動中的敵方車輛。

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Be careful! Grenades roll down hill.
entries.target:
作戰情報
小心！手榴彈會滾下斜坡。

entries.source: ^2Helicopter Pilot: ^7Bravo Six, this is Kilo Six-One, roger that, out.
entries.target: ^2直升機駕駛員：^7B 六號，這裡是 K 六一。收到，通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Crouch down with that shield, Soap! I'll take care of the shooters.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，拿著盾牌蹲下！槍手交給我。
M4A1 卡賓槍（心跳感測器）
M4A1 卡賓槍（下掛霰彈槍）

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7All fire teams, be advised - we have a positive ID. Enemy operators are ex-SAS and Task Force 141. Approach with extreme caution, over.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7各火力小組注意，身分已確認。敵人是前 SAS 和一四一特遣隊隊員。接近時務必謹慎，完畢。
^2史崔克砲手：^7獾一號收到，攻擊房子。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Let's go! Stay close and follow me!

entries.target: .44 馬格南左輪手槍（戰術刀）

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Watch for the flashing strobes. That's us.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7留意閃爍的信號燈，那是我們。
^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7麥克塔維什，你還在等什麼……
^2普萊斯：^7他們發現我們了，開火。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7You took out too many targets with your knife. Try again, this time, with bullets.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7你用刀擊倒太多靶子。再試一次，這次用子彈。
SPAS-12 霰彈槍（紅點瞄準鏡）
SPAS-12 霰彈槍（心跳感測器）
MG4 輕機槍（全息瞄準鏡）
AUG HBAR 輕機槍（ACOG 瞄準鏡）
^2普萊斯：^7他們有盾牌！用破片手榴彈！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Bring down that helicopter, it's got us pinned!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7擊落直升機，我們被它壓制了！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap, these aren't your average muppets. No more mistakes, let's go.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，這些人不是一般笨蛋。別再犯錯了，走吧。

entries.source: ^2Sub Commander: ^7Roger that Hotel Six, Team 2 will secure and evac, get topside and find the rest of the civvies.
entries.target: ^2潛艦指揮官：^7H 六號，收到。第二小隊會控制現場並撤離，去上層找剩下的平民。
AUG HBAR 輕機槍（前握把）

entries.source: Melee the dog before it bites to grab its throat. ^3( [{+melee}] )^7
entries.target: 軍犬咬下前，及時近戰攻擊，抓住牠的喉嚨。^3( [{+melee}] )^7
AUG HBAR 輕機槍（心跳感測器）
AUG HBAR 輕機槍（熱影像瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7You're in the clear, they're returning to their positions.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7你安全了，他們正返回原位。
AUG HBAR 輕機槍（加大彈匣）
M240 機槍（全金屬被甲彈）
L86 LSW 輕支援武器（全息瞄準鏡）

entries.source: We are too far behind the other special ops player
entries.target: 我們落後另一名特種作戰玩家太遠了
L86 LSW 輕支援武器（熱影像瞄準鏡）

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
When everything goes red, it's time to run for cover.
entries.target:
作戰情報
畫面一片紅時，就該找掩護了。
M93 Raffica 點放手槍（雙持）
G18 自動手槍（紅點瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Use the weapons caches and set up your claymores if you've got any left. Defensive positions, let's go!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7利用武器儲藏點，有剩餘的闊刀地雷就布設。進入防禦位置，快！

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Kestrel 3-2, they're still in the caves, hold position and continue to observe, Gold Eagle out.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7紅隼三二，他們還在洞穴裡。保持位置，繼續觀察。金鷹通話完畢。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7這個交給我。

entries.source: ^2Sub Commander: ^7Civilian hostages at your position, watch your fire.
entries.target: ^2潛艦指揮官：^7你們的位置有平民人質，小心開火。
USP .45 手槍（全金屬被甲彈）

entries.source: ^1Major Petrov: ^7This is Major Petrov! Come out with your hands up!
entries.target: ^1彼得羅夫少校：^7我是彼得羅夫少校！舉起雙手走出來！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7All callsigns on this net, this is the Washington Monument Evac Site! We're holding our own but have glassed enemies to the west and are taking fire from that direction!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7本頻道各單位，這裡是華盛頓紀念碑撤離點！目前守住了，但發現西方有敵人，正遭該方向攻擊！
M1014 霰彈槍（全息瞄準鏡）
SPAS-12 霰彈槍（全金屬被甲彈）
巴雷特 .50 口徑狙擊步槍（消音器）
巴雷特 .50 口徑狙擊步槍（熱影像瞄準鏡）
Intervention 狙擊步槍（加大彈匣）

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Sgt. Foley, this is Hunter 2-1-Delta - how copy over?
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7佛利中士，這裡是獵人二一 D，收訊如何？完畢。
RPD 輕機槍（全息瞄準鏡）

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I've lost sight of him again! Ghost, talk to me!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我又看不到他了！幽靈，回報！
^2普萊斯：^7肥皂！砲火來襲！趴下！趴下！
RPD 輕機槍（心跳感測器）

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7The Navy isn't in a talking mood right now. Standby.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7海軍現在不想談。稍候。
AA-12 霰彈槍（心跳感測器、消音器、霰彈槍）

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1, relay from Goliath Two, enemy reinforcements approaching from the west, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，轉達巨人二號：敵方援軍正從西方逼近，完畢。

entries.source: A teammate bled to death. Work as a team and revive each other when someone goes down.
entries.target: 隊友失血而死。互相配合，有人倒地時就救起對方。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Roger. Brigade Combat Team One has already peeled off an LAV to provide suppression, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7收到。第一旅級戰鬥隊已派輕型裝甲車提供壓制，完畢。

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
If you are downed, try crawling to your teammate.
entries.target:
作戰情報
若你倒地，試著爬向隊友。

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Throw ^3[{+smoke}]^7 flashbangs to stun the enemy.
entries.target:
作戰情報
投擲 ^3[{+smoke}]^7 閃光彈，暫時制住敵人。

entries.source: ^2Soap: ^7Direct hit on the enemy helo. Nice shot Roach.
entries.target: ^2肥皂：^7直接命中敵方直升機。小強，打得漂亮。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7You're not aiming properly, Private. Snap to the targets by aiming down your sights.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7你沒有好好瞄準，二等兵。舉槍瞄準，迅速轉向靶子。

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Use ^3[{+smoke}]^7 flashbangs to slow down Juggernauts.
entries.target:
作戰情報
使用 ^3[{+smoke}]^7 閃光彈，拖慢重裝兵。

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
High Caliber weapons like the Barrett .50 cal and Desert Eagle are more effective against Juggernauts.
entries.target:
作戰情報
巴雷特 .50 口徑狙擊步槍和沙漠之鷹等大口徑武器，對重裝兵更有效。

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Explosives are very effective against Juggernauts.
entries.target:
作戰情報
爆裂物對重裝兵非常有效。

entries.source: Clearing an Op on Hardened is worth 2 stars. Veteran is worth 3 stars.
entries.target: 困難難度通關可獲得兩顆星，老兵難度則是三顆星。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7All Hunter units be advised, enemy has close air support operating in our AO.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7獵人各單位注意，敵方近接空中支援正在我們的作戰區活動。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Be advised, Honey Badger is rollin'. Get outta the way.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7注意，蜜獾正在前進。讓開。

entries.source: "In taking revenge, a man is but even with his enemy; but in passing it over, he is superior." - Francis Bacon
entries.target: 「復仇只能讓人與敵人扯平；放下復仇，才能超越敵人。」——法蘭西斯．培根

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Nikolai! This is Price! Be advised, the LZ is hot, I repeat the LZ is hot!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7尼古萊！這裡是普萊斯！注意，降落區有敵人，重複，降落區有敵人！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Command's got their head up their arse. We're on our own.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7指揮部那些蠢蛋，我們只能靠自己。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7These are the last safe havens left on Earth for Makarov and his men.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7這是馬卡洛夫和手下在世上僅存的藏身處。

entries.source: "An eye for an eye makes the whole world blind." - Gandhi
entries.target: 「以眼還眼，會讓全世界都失明。」——甘地

entries.source: "A citizen of America will cross the ocean to fight for democracy, but won't cross the street to vote..." - Bill Vaughan
entries.target: 「美國公民願渡海為民主而戰，卻不願過街去投票……」——比爾．沃恩

entries.source: "Patriotism is a arbitrary veneration of real estate above principles." - George Jean Nathan
entries.target: 「愛國主義，就是任意將對土地的崇敬置於原則之上。」——喬治．尚．內森

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Loyalists eh? Are those the good Russians or the bad Russians?
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7忠誠派，是嗎？他們是好的俄國人，還是壞的俄國人？

entries.source: "The nation is divided, half patriots and half traitors, and no man can tell which from which." - Mark Twain
entries.target: 「國家分裂了，一半是愛國者，一半是叛徒，而誰也分不清誰是誰。」——馬克．吐溫

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Find some heavy weapons and eliminate that armor and enemy air. Hurry!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！找重武器，摧毀裝甲車和敵機！快！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Check your fire! Check your fire! Friendlies coming in at your 12!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小心開火！小心開火！十二點鐘方向有友軍過來！

entries.source: "I only regret that I have but one life to give for my country." - Nathan Hale
entries.target: 「我唯一的遺憾，是只有一條命能獻給祖國。」——納森．黑爾

entries.source: "Nationalism is an infantile disease.  It is the measles of mankind." - Albert Einstein
entries.target: 「民族主義是一種幼稚的疾病，是人類的麻疹。」——阿爾伯特．愛因斯坦

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Hide! One of them's been alerted!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7躲起來！其中一個被驚動了！

entries.source: "If our country is worth dying for in time of war let us resolve that it is truly worth living for in time of peace." - Hamilton Fish
entries.target: 「若祖國值得我們在戰時為她而死，就讓我們決心在和平時真正為她而活。」——漢密爾頓．費許
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7替我掩護後方。

entries.source: "Traditional nationalism cannot survive the fissioning of the atom. One world or none." - Stuart Chase
entries.target: 「傳統民族主義無法在原子分裂後繼續存在。要麼同一個世界，要麼一無所有。」——史都華．蔡斯

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7You've been in the gulag too long, Price.  Focus on taking out Makarov.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7你在古拉格待太久了，普萊斯。專心對付馬卡洛夫。

entries.source: "We know where they are. They're in the area around Tikrit and Baghdad and east, west, south and north somewhat." - Donald Rumsfeld
entries.target: 「我們知道它們在哪裡。就在提克里特與巴格達周邊，東西南北的一些地方。」——唐納．倫斯斐

entries.source: ^1UAV Operator: ^7Be advised, we are dispatching RPG units on the bridges to intercept Price and MacTavish.
entries.target: ^1無人機操作員：^7注意，正派遣 RPG 小隊到橋上攔截普萊斯和麥克塔維什。

entries.source: "I would not say that the future is necessarily less predictable than the past. I think the past was not predictable when it started." - Donald Rumsfeld
entries.target: 「我不會說未來一定比過去更難預測。我認為過去在開始時，也無法預測。」——唐納．倫斯斐

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We're on our way! Hostiles following close behind!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7正在趕來！敵人緊追在後！

entries.source: "It is easy to take liberty for granted, when you have never had it taken from you." - Dick Cheney
entries.target: 「從未被剝奪自由的人，很容易將自由視為理所當然。」——迪克．錢尼

entries.source: "Principle is OK up to a certain point, but principle doesn't do any good if you lose." - Dick Cheney
entries.target: 「原則在某個限度內很好，但如果你輸了，原則就毫無用處。」——迪克．錢尼

entries.source: "I love America more than any other country in this world; and, exactly for this reason, I insist on the right to criticize her perpetually." - James Baldwin
entries.target: 「我愛美國勝過世上任何其他國家；正因如此，我堅持永遠批評她的權利。」——詹姆斯．鮑德溫

entries.source: "As we express our gratitude, we must never forget that the highest appreciation is not to utter words, but to live by them." - John F. Kennedy
entries.target: 「表達感激時，別忘了最深的感激不在言語，而在付諸實行。」——約翰．F．甘迺迪

entries.source:
OPERATIONAL INTEL
Protect your sentry turrets! Place them in cover at positions where they wont be flanked.
entries.target:
作戰情報
保護自動機槍！放在有掩護、且不易遭包抄的位置。

entries.source: Friendly fire will not be tolerated!

entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我來對付他。

entries.source: You shot a civilian. Watch your fire!
entries.target: 你射中了平民。注意射擊！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！跟我來！走！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, on me! Regroup with the squad!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，跟我來！與小隊會合！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Looks like they found a body.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7看來他們找到屍體了。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez! We gotta get back to the convoy! Let's go!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲！我們得回車隊！快！

entries.source: Press your Move Back key^3 &&1 ^7to move backwards.
The star on your compass marks your next objective
entries.target: 羅盤上的星星標示下一個任務目標

entries.source: Debrief with Captain Foley at the crossroads.
entries.target: 在十字路口向佛利上尉報告。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Focus on the group on the right, directly beneath us. Let's take them out first.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7盯住右側、我們正下方那組。先幹掉他們。

entries.source: This door cannot be opened. You never need to try to open closed doors.
entries.target: 這扇門打不開。不必試著打開關閉的門。

entries.source: To pickup ammo from another weapon, walk close to it or look at it and press USE^3 &&1^7.
entries.target: 靠近另一把武器，或看著它並按使用鍵^3 &&1^7，即可補充彈藥。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7There's too many of them in here! Roach! We've lost the DSM, I repeat we've lost-
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7敵人太多了！小強！我們失去了 DSM，重複，我們失去——

entries.source: Press and hold ^3[{+speed_throw}]^7 to spool up the minigun.
^2Price: ^7I'll take the two on the left.
Use the Panzerfaust anti-tank weapons behind the bunker to destroy the tanks.
entries.target: 使用碉堡後的鐵拳反坦克武器摧毀坦克。

entries.source: Press USE^3 &&1 ^7to lean out of the window
^2Shepherd: ^7I'll try to buy you some time. One man in a gulag doesn't mean much to the Navy at this point.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7我會盡量爭取時間。現在海軍可不在乎古拉格裡的一個人。

entries.source: You are too far from your radio man to use artillery.
entries.target: 離通訊兵太遠，無法呼叫砲火。

entries.source: ^2MacTavish: ^7C'mon Roach, we're almost at the chopper!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什：^7小強，快！快到直升機了！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7They're splitting up. Take him down.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7他們分開了，幹掉他。

entries.source: To plant C4, approach the glowing objective marker and press^3 [{+activate}] ^7.
entries.target: 靠近發光的目標標記，按^3 [{+activate}] ^7安放 C4。
消滅 Flak 88 砲組。^3剩 &&1 組^7

entries.source:
You were killed by a grenade.
Watch out for the grenade danger indicator.
entries.target:
你被手榴彈炸死了。
注意手榴彈危險指示器。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7They've sealed the control room. Get a frame charge on the door!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7他們封住了控制室。把框式炸藥裝上門！
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7他就是你的新摯友。

entries.source: You died holding a grenade for too long.
entries.target: 手榴彈握太久，炸死了自己。

entries.source:
You were killed by an exploding vehicle.
Vehicles on fire are likely to explode.
entries.target:
你被爆炸車輛炸死了。
燃燒中的車輛很可能會爆炸。
^2史崔克砲手：^7收到，攻擊直升機。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7I need to you fire while crouched, Private.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7我要你蹲著射擊，二等兵。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7They're on to us! Open fire!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7他們發現我們了！開火！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach - search the northeast part of the runway for the fueling station.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，搜索跑道東北部，找到加油站。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7你被發現了！找掩護！

entries.source: Press and hold^3 &&1 ^7to secure the enemy intelligence.
^2Captain Price: ^7Let them pass or take them out... your call.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7讓他們過去，或幹掉他們。你決定。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap! We are leaving! Get in the jeep!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂！我們要走了！上吉普車！

entries.source: You have found &&1 enemy intel pts.
entries.target: 找到 &&1 個敵方情報點。

entries.source: ^2MacTavish: ^7Roach? Ghost? Come in, Ghost! Do you copy?  Does anyone copy?
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什：^7小強？幽靈？幽靈，請回答！收到嗎？有人收到嗎？

entries.source: ^2MacTavish: ^7We don't even know if Makarov's intel's any good.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什：^7我們甚至不知道馬卡洛夫的情報靠不靠譜。

entries.source: Press ^3[{+speed}]^7 to control zoom and press ^3[{+attack}]^7 to fire.
entries.target: 按 ^3[{+speed}]^7 調整倍率，按 ^3[{+attack}]^7 開火。

entries.source:
Armor can only be damaged
by C4 and rockets.
entries.target:
只有 C4 和火箭
能破壞裝甲。

entries.source: Press ^3[{weapnext}]^7 to switch to your M21 Sniper Rifle
entries.target: 按 ^3[{weapnext}]^7 切換 M21 狙擊步槍

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Convoy coming, get out of sight.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7車隊來了，躲起來。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7This is easier when you don't alert them.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7你要是不驚動他們，事情就簡單多了。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach! Don't let the militia pin you down for too long! Use your flashbangs on them!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強！別被民兵壓制太久！用閃光彈對付他們！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Roach, soften up their defenses with the Predator!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7小強，用掠奪者削弱他們的防禦！

entries.source:
Avoid the radiation zones.
Listen for the clicks of the Geiger counter.
entries.target:
避開輻射區。
留意蓋革計數器的喀答聲。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Roach, they know we're here. You might want to grab a different weapon.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7小強，他們知道我們來了，你最好換把武器。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7又有一輛卡車來了。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Well, the quality of the intel's about to change. This safehouse's a bloody gold mine.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7情報品質馬上就會改善了。這座安全屋簡直是座金礦。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Those miniguns aren't going to stop, shake em!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7那些迷你砲不會停火，甩掉它們！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7There's a truck coming! Stay out of sight.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7有卡車來了！別被看見。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Take them out or leave them be. Your call.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7幹掉他們，或別理他們。你決定。

entries.source: Laze targets for the Stryker armored vehicle.  Battle in the 'burbs house to house, room to room.
entries.target: 為史崔克裝甲車雷射標定目標。在郊區逐屋、逐室戰鬥。
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7你傳來的這張圖片是什麼？
^2佛利中士：^7長官，這裡情況如何？

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Sounds like the party's already started.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7聽來已經打起來了。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Boys, I know I'm sending you into the meat grinder on this one...
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7小伙子們，我知道這次是在把你們送進絞肉機……
^2麥克塔維什：^7謝菲爾德將軍背叛了我們。

entries.source: Both players must be near a door to breach
entries.target: 兩名玩家都必須靠近門，才能破門

entries.source: Waiting for friendlies to get in position...
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7The second helo just showed up! Take it down!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7第二架直升機出現了！擊落它！
^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7……去做真正必要的事。

entries.source: Frag Grenades cannot damage this vehicle
entries.target: 破片手榴彈無法損壞此車輛

entries.source: Mission failed. You killed a hostage.
entries.target: 任務失敗。你殺死了人質。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen will demonstrate what I'm talking about.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵會示範我說的做法。

entries.source: Mission failed. A hostage was executed.
entries.target: 任務失敗。人質遭到處決。

entries.source:
Mission failed. A hostage was executed.
Try breaching from opposite doors.
entries.target:
任務失敗。人質遭到處決。
試著從相對的門同時突破。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap! Hurry! We've gotta get to Nikolai's plane! Keep moving west!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂！快！我們得去尼古萊的飛機！繼續往西！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7He's getting away! Roach let's go let's go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7他要逃了！小強，快！快！

entries.source: ^2TF-141 Soldier: ^7Captain MacTavish, last floor clear. We'll link up with you at the bottom.
entries.target: ^2一四一特遣隊隊員：^7麥克塔維什上尉，最後一層安全。我們在底層會合。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7It will cost nothing compared to everything you'll save.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7但與你將拯救的一切相比，這個代價微不足道。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7There is a reason we brought silencers.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我們帶消音器是有原因的。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, we got hostiles in that grey house! Take 'em out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，那棟灰房子有敵人！幹掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Gee, I wonder if they will notice a flaming wreck in the middle of the road....
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7哎呀，不知道他們會不會注意到路中央有輛燒起來的殘骸……

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7We've been spotted - take 'em out before they can radio back in!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7被發現了！在他們呼叫前幹掉他們！

entries.source: You are not ready to breach
^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Not good enough, Allen. You took too long and missed too many targets. Try it again.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7不夠好，艾倫。你花太久，又漏掉太多靶子。再試一次。

entries.source: Look at your first objective and press USE^3 &&1 ^7to retrieve
entries.target: 看向第一個目標，按使用鍵^3 &&1 ^7取回
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7遊騎兵打頭陣！前進！

entries.source: Press your Move Right key^3 &&1 ^7to move right.
^2Ghost: ^7I'll tap into their system and look for the prisoner! It's gonna take some time!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7我會接入系統找囚犯，需要一點時間！

entries.source: You now have two weapons. Press^3 &&1 ^7to switch to your second weapon.
entries.target: 你現在有兩把武器。按^3 &&1 ^7切換第二把武器。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7等等，他們又停下來了。稍候。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Avatar One, reacquire target and try again! Cleared hot!
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7化身一號，重新鎖定目標，再試一次！准許開火！

entries.source: Unable to connect to special ops host because they're not currently disconnected and listening for co-op connections
entries.target: 無法連接特種作戰主持人。目前對方未處於等待合作連線的狀態。

entries.source: Press^3 &&1 ^7a second time to stand up from crouch.
Press^3 &&1 ^7to switch from crouch from prone.
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Don't forget to aim down your sights.
^2Price: ^7Make sure you're using a suppressed weapon, otherwise we're dead.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7務必用消音武器，否則死定了。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7You don't want to know what it's cost already to put you next to him.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7你不會想知道，為了讓你接近他，我們已付出多少代價。

entries.source: If this makes you go prone, double tap^3 &&1].
entries.target: 如果因此趴下，請連按兩次^3 &&1].

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7The Russians must've copied the ACS module. Got the key to every lock in America.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7俄軍肯定複製了 ACS 模組，取得了打開美國所有防線的鑰匙。

entries.source: ^2Colonel Marshall: ^7You're lookin' at the 'high ground' Sergeant! There's still power in the White House!
entries.target: ^2馬歇爾上校：^7你眼前就是「制高點」，中士！白宮還有電！

entries.source: Press^3 &&1 ^7a second time to stop aiming down the sight.
entries.target: 再按一次^3 &&1 ^7停止舉槍瞄準。

entries.source: Press^3 &&1 ^7to switch to your second weapon.
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord, this is Two-One Actual, be advised, we're inside and proceeding to the upper floors.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，這裡是二一指揮官。注意，我們已進入，正前往上層。

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7All callsigns be advised! Whiskey Mike evac site is combat ineffective! We're totally pinned down, they're comin' in any second now!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7各單位注意！W M 撤離點已失去戰力！完全遭到壓制，敵人隨時會闖進來！

entries.source: HOLD USE^3 &&1 ^7to swap your current weapon for another that you are looking at.
entries.target: 按住使用鍵^3 &&1 ^7，將目前武器換成你正看著的武器。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord, Two-One Actual! We're screening west with no adjacent support, and friendly victors from BCT One are hauling ass past us, over!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，二一指揮官！我們向西警戒，沒有鄰近支援，第一旅級戰鬥隊的友軍車輛正快速經過，完畢！

entries.source: To pickup a weapon, look at it and press USE^3 &&1].
entries.target: 看著武器並按使用鍵^3 &&1]，即可拾取。

entries.source: Hold down^3 &&1 ^7to lean to the right.
^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Too right, mate. Now, in the eyes of the world, they're the victims.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7沒錯，老兄。現在全世界都把他們當成受害者。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We gotta destroy those triple-A positions so they can get the rest of the civvies outta here! Let's go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7必須摧毀防空砲陣地，才能撤出剩餘平民！走！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Ghost, we're in the old tunnel system heading south-southwest.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7幽靈，我們在舊隧道裡，正朝南南西前進。

entries.source:
Press ^3[{+activate}]^7 to toggle thermal vision
between white hot and black hot.
entries.target:
按 ^3[{+activate}]^7，切換熱影像
的白熱與黑熱模式。

entries.source: Throw smoke^3 [{+smoke}] ^7to safely approach the enemy vehicle.
entries.target: 投擲煙霧彈^3 [{+smoke}] ^7，安全接近敵方車輛。

entries.source: Look at the explosives spot and press^3 &&1 ^7to plant the explosives.
entries.target: 看向爆破位置，按^3 &&1 ^7安放炸藥。

entries.source: Hold down^3 &&1 ^7to pick up the detonator.
Use ^3[{+melee}]^7 to start or stop Slow-Mo.
entries.target: 用 ^3[{+melee}]^7 開啟或停止慢動作。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company: ^7Roger that Oxide, I'll send Vinson and Lambert. Butcher Seven out.
entries.target: ^1暗影連：^7收到，氧化物。我派文森和蘭伯特過去。屠夫七號通話完畢。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7...but you could never take that extra step...
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7……但你始終不敢再往前一步……

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez - get to the roof and check out the supply drop!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，上屋頂檢查空投補給！
^2遊騎兵：^7快！快！前往威士忌旅館！

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7That's within a hundred meters of your position sir!
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7目標距離您不到一百公尺，長官！

entries.source: Use the mouse to steer the missile.
^2Price: ^7Shepherd will be a hero.  'Cause all you need to change the world is one good lie and a river of blood.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7謝菲爾德將軍會成為英雄。因為改變世界，只需要一個高明的謊言和一條血河。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! Head through those yellow houses on the left and flank the intersection!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！穿過左邊那些黃色房屋，包抄路口！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap, I'm picking up a thermal spike up ahead. The cave must be somewhere over the edge.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，前方有熱源。洞穴應該就在邊緣下方。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Over the last century it's played host to anyone the government didn't want, but couldn't kill.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7過去一百年裡，政府不想留著、卻又不能殺的人，全被送到這裡。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap, what's the problem? Hook up to the railing.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，怎麼了？把繩索掛上欄杆。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Don't give away our position, Roach. This is only gonna get harder.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7小強，別暴露位置。不然只會更難。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Enemy radio....I think we're going to have company sir...
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7敵方無線電……長官，我想有客人要來了……

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Possibly 30,000 to 50,000.  Depends on the exact location of the detonation.  All systems will go down.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7可能有三萬到五萬人。取決於確切的引爆位置。所有系統都會癱瘓。

entries.source: ^1Anatoly: ^7What are you waiting for? Get in.
^2Price: ^7Don't bother. This was a one-way flight, mate.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7別費心了，老兄。這趟有去無回。
^2尼古萊：^7那就祝你好運，我的朋友。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! We still have hostiles near the Burger Town, we need to move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！漢堡鎮附近還有敵人，我們得轉移！

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Butcher One-Five, rendezvous at the nest and prepare to escort Gold Eagle to the LZ.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7屠夫一五，前往瞭望塔會合，準備護送金鷹到降落區。
