entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Looks like Makarov's intel was solid. This is it.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7看來馬卡洛夫的情報很可靠。就是這裡。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Hold on - they've only found a body. They don't know where you are.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7等等，他們只是發現屍體，還不知道你的位置。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Sir, sandstorm activity is picking up here. It's too risky for flight ops.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7長官，這裡的沙塵暴正在加劇。飛行作業風險太高。

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7We're taking fire at the Washington Monument! We are down to 80 percent combat effectiveness! Request immediate sniper fire on targets west of the Monument, over!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7華盛頓紀念碑正在遭到射擊！戰力剩百分之八十！請立即狙擊紀念碑西方的目標，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7We have to work together, Soap - stick to the plan next time.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，我們得互相配合。下次照計畫做。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7All right, we've got to take out the other group before they come back. Move.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7好，得在另一組回來前幹掉他們。走。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap, let Makarov and Shepherd's men kill each other off as much as you can.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂，盡量讓馬卡洛夫和謝菲爾德將軍的人互相殘殺。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap, the second group found the bodies!  Take 'em out before they radio in!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，第二組發現屍體了！在他們呼叫前幹掉他們！
^1馬卡洛夫：^7很好。他們準時到了。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap, they're coming back -  I'm repositioning to get out of sight.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，他們回來了，我換個位置躲起來。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7I'm taking a lot of fire from the militia, I don't think I can track him through the market! I'm going to have to find another way around!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7民兵火力很猛，我沒辦法穿過市場追他！得另外繞路！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7We don't have much time before they find the bodies. Let's keep moving.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7他們很快就會發現屍體。繼續前進。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Arnett: ^7They blew the damn bridge! We gotta move!
entries.target: ^2阿內特中士：^7他們把那該死的橋炸了！我們得走了！

entries.source: ^2Soap: ^7AGM Missile is online. I repeat AGM Missile is online.
entries.target: ^2肥皂：^7空對地飛彈已就緒。重複，空對地飛彈已就緒。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7The guards know something's not right. Get out of sight and stay quiet.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7守衛知道不對勁了。躲起來，保持安靜。

entries.source: ^2TF-141 Soldier: ^7Get topside, we got this area covered.
entries.target: ^2一四一特遣隊隊員：^7去上層，我們已控制這區。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Hmph. No sign of forced entry...
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7嗯，沒有強行闖入的痕跡……

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap, we've got two tangos with taclights coming down the stairs under that red light, dead ahead.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，正前方紅燈下有兩名敵人拿著戰術手電筒走下樓梯。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7We've got to take 'em out before they find us.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7得在他們發現我們前幹掉他們。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Alright.  Head upstairs, regroup with the others.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7好，上樓和其他人會合。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Honey Badger's a mean bitch, Sir.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7蜜獾可凶悍了，長官。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Oxide to Disciple Six, we've got two dead bodies at the back door. Escalate aggression and sweep the area.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7氧化物呼叫門徒六號，後門有兩具屍體。提高警戒，搜索區域。

entries.source: ^1Disciple Six: ^7Roger that Oxide, we're on the catwalk, heading to the steam room. Standby.
entries.target: ^1門徒六號：^7收到，氧化物。我們在棧道上，正前往蒸汽室。請稍候。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7We'll catch him on the other side!
^2PFC Allen: ^7It's an honor, Sir. When do I meet the rest of the team?
entries.target: ^2艾倫一等兵：^7這是我的榮幸，長官。我何時能見到其他隊員？
^1門徒六號：^7收到，氧化物，請稍候。
^2佛利中士：^7收到，二一通話完畢。

entries.source: ^1Disciple Six: ^7Oxide, Disciple Six at the steam room. No sign of Five, over.
entries.target: ^1門徒六號：^7氧化物，門徒六號已到蒸汽室。沒發現五號，完畢。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Disciple Six, go dark, breach and clear.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7門徒六號，關閉燈光，破門清剿。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Disciple Nine, your rear guard just flatlined!
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7門徒九號，你們的後衛剛剛死了！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! You're gonna get run over! Get outta their way!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！你會被輾過！快閃開！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach - not the door! Plant the breaching charge on the wall over here!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，不是門！把破門炸藥裝在這邊的牆上！

entries.source: Unable to connect to special ops host because they're running a different protocol version.
entries.target: 無法連接特種作戰主持人，對方使用不同的通訊協定版本。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Backup priority items and burn the rest. Fire teams - just delay 'em until we're ready to pull out.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7備份重要資料，其餘燒掉。各火力小組，只需拖住他們，直到我們準備撤離。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Avatar One this is Oxide, we've lost contact with multiple squads near the steam room. I need a camera sweep of the catwalk, over.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7化身一號，這裡是氧化物。蒸汽室附近多支小隊失聯。用攝影機搜索棧道，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! Head southeast! I've got you covered!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！往東南方！我掩護你！

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company: ^7Roger that Oxide, UAV is online. Standby.
entries.target: ^1暗影連：^7收到，氧化物，無人機已上線。請稍候。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Grab a riot shield...we'll need cover out here.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7拿面防暴盾……在外面需要掩護。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Take point with the riot shield. I'll take care of any resistance.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7用防暴盾帶路。我來清除敵人。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Go ahead and end it. It won't change anything.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7動手吧，結束這一切。也改變不了什麼。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Give us some cover with that riot shield, Soap!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，用防暴盾掩護我們！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7We're on our way to the LZ! Roach, let's go!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7我們正在前往降落區！小強，快走！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We'll take them out at the same time...on your go.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我們同時幹掉他們，等你的信號。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap, grab a riot shield and lead the way. I'll take care of any shooters!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，拿面防暴盾帶路。槍手都交給我！

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company: ^7Oxide, Avatar One. We have unauthorized personnel on the catwalk. I repeat, we have unauthorized personnel on the catwalk- you getting' this?
entries.target: ^1暗影連：^7氧化物，這裡是化身一號。棧道上有未經授權的人員。重複，棧道上有未經授權的人員。收到了嗎？

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Avatar One, divert your camera feed to the facial recognition database at Langley. Break. Standby for fur- ( further orders. )
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7化身一號，將攝影機影像轉接到蘭利的人臉辨識資料庫。稍停。等待進一——（進一步指令。）

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7It's Price. Backup priority items and burn the rest. All fire teams - just delay 'em until we're ready to leave. Shepherd out.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7是普萊斯。備份重要資料，其餘燒掉。各火力小組，只需拖住他們，直到我們準備離開。謝菲爾德將軍通話完畢。
^2普萊斯：^7也是清點……家當的好時機。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Take point with the shield and draw their fire. I'll cover you.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7用盾牌帶路，吸引火力。我掩護你。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company: ^7Oxide, Disciple Nine, we've got hostile contact approximately 50 meters from the nest, over.
entries.target: ^1暗影連：^7氧化物，這裡是門徒九號。在距離瞭望塔約五十公尺處發現敵人，完畢。
^2艾倫一等兵：^7所以馬卡洛夫就是目標。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7They're alerted! Hide in the woods! Move!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7他們被驚動了！躲進樹林！快！
^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7殺了我也改變不了這點。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Gold Eagle must be Shepherd! We're running out of time, let's go!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7金鷹一定是謝菲爾德將軍！時間不多了，快！
^1暗影連：^7門徒三號正垂降進入！

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Negative, Gold Eagle wants those charges hot in less than three mikes. Get it done, out.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7不行，金鷹要求三分鐘內啟用炸藥。照辦，通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7I'm popping smoke! Move around the right flank!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7我投放煙霧！繞到右翼！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7I'll draw their fire through the smoke! Watch for flanking routes!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7我隔著煙霧吸引火力！找路包抄！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7They're digging in, Shepherd must be close! We have to break through!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7他們正在固守，謝菲爾德將軍一定就在附近！必須突破！
^2普萊斯：^7他們用熱影像穿透煙霧！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Switching to thermal! Keep an eye on our flanks!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7切換熱影像！注意兩翼！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Whoa watch it! Some of 'em just went in that classroom on the right!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7小心！有幾個剛跑進右邊的教室！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap! We've got to go now! Breach the door!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂！現在就得走！破門！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Blow the door! We can't let Shepherd escape!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7炸開門！不能讓謝菲爾德將軍逃走！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap! Get that door open over there! Hit the panel!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂！打開那邊的門！操作控制面板！

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7I am executing directive one-one-six bravo. If you're still inside, your service will be honored. Shepherd out.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7我正執行一一六 B 指令。如果你們仍在裡面，你們的犧牲將受到表揚。謝菲爾德將軍通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1, fifteen-plus tangos approaching near the diner to the west, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，西邊小餐館附近有十五名以上敵人逼近，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Keep moving! This place is gonna blow!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7繼續前進！這裡要炸了！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Head for that humvee, I'll cover you!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7跑向那輛悍馬，我掩護你！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Make a run for that tower, dead ahead! I'll cover you!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7衝向正前方那座塔！我掩護你！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Does the word stealth mean anything to you?
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7你知道「潛行」是什麼意思嗎？

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Understood. Head for the tunnel. We'll take the Zodiacs.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7明白。前往隧道，我們搭橡皮艇。

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7All callsigns, be advised, we are taking concentrated fire at the evac site and are losing vehicles and armor! We are down to 60 percent combat effectiveness! Over!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7各單位注意，撤離點正遭集中攻擊，車輛與裝甲車持續損失！戰力剩百分之六十！完畢！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Head for the tunnel! He's getting away!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7前往隧道！他要逃走了！

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Probably just the sandstorm that's rollin' in or a bad transmitter.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7可能只是沙塵暴來了，或發射器故障。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Shepherd mentioned Zodiacs...there must river access nearby - let's go!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7謝菲爾德將軍提到橡皮艇……附近一定有路通往河邊，快走！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Targets to the west! Light em up!
^2Price: ^7Sniper from from the tower! Take it out!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7塔上有狙擊手！幹掉他！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez - get the control rig for the UAV!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲，拿無人機控制器！

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Excalibur, this is Gold Eagle. Fire mission - target package Romeo - danger close.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7聖劍，這裡是金鷹。火力任務，目標群 R，友軍距離很近。
^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7這不是建議！開火！

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Roger, fire mission danger close!
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7收到，火力任務，友軍注意近距離砲火！
^2普萊斯：^7肥皂！砲火來襲！撤退！撤退！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Move west towards the tower! Follow me!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7往西面的塔走！跟我來！

entries.source: Explosive ammunition, Vulcan Minigun, Blackhawk Helicopter.  Clear the way.
entries.target: 爆炸彈藥、火神迷你砲與黑鷹直升機。掃清道路。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Get the hell outta here! Artillery inbound!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7快離開這裡！砲火來襲！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Sounds like we're gonna meet 'em head on, Soap.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂，看來要跟他們正面碰上了。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roger that! I'm going around to the left!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到！我從左邊繞！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7All right, the ice is good. Follow me.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7好，冰壁穩固。跟我來。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1, this is Overlord, gimme a sitrep over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，這裡是霸王。回報狀況，完畢。

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company: ^7Butcher Two roping into sector Papa Quebec!
entries.target: ^1暗影連：^7屠夫二號正垂降進入 P-Q 區！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord this is Hunter 2-1 requesting air support, over!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，這裡是獵人二一。請求空中支援，完畢！

entries.source: ^1Shadow Company HQ: ^7Send a team to check it out, over.
entries.target: ^1暗影連指揮部：^7派一隊去查看，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Badger One to Hunter Two, target destroyed.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7獾一號呼叫獵人二號，目標已摧毀。
^1無人機操作員：^7收到，飛彈已發射！

entries.source: ^1UAV Operator: ^7All bridge fire teams - equip RPGs and intercept any boats in pursuit of Gold Eagle.
entries.target: ^1無人機操作員：^7所有橋上火力小組，裝備 RPG，攔截任何追擊金鷹的船隻。

entries.source: ^1UAV Operator: ^7Little Birds are inbound, E.T.A. forty seconds.
entries.target: ^1無人機操作員：^7小鳥直升機正在飛來，預計四十秒抵達。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Five years ago, I lost 30,000 men in the blink of an eye.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7五年前，三萬名部下在眨眼之間就沒了。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Turn towards the objective! Let's go! He's gonna get away!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7轉向目標！快！他要逃走了！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Soap! What are you doing!? Full power, let's go!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7肥皂！你在幹什麼！？全速前進，快！
^2普萊斯：^7九點鐘方向有敵方橡皮艇！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Don't aim down the sight yet. I'm tryin' to make a point here. Just fire from the hip.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7先別舉槍瞄準。我正在說明一個重點。直接腰射。
^2普萊斯：^7橡皮艇正從六點鐘方向快速逼近！

entries.source: ^1UAV Operator: ^7Roger, UAV support available in 10 seconds.
entries.target: ^1無人機操作員：^7收到，十秒後可提供無人機支援。
^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7准許開火，注意友軍距離很近！
^2普萊斯上尉：^7正前方有三人巡邏隊。
^1無人機操作員：^7收到。飛彈已發射。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Steer clear of that chopper! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7避開那架直升機！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! Get ready to make a break for it on my mark!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！準備聽我信號衝出去！
^1無人機操作員：^7Fox Three，飛彈已發射！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7（費力拉起隊友）
^2普萊斯：^7我們得甩掉他們！甩掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Get out of sight! That one's coming over here!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7躲起來！那個人往這裡來了！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我們被發現了。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Yeah, it was alright I guess. You need some serious polish though.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7嗯，勉強還行。不過你還得好好磨練。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach - plant the breaching charge on the wall, we're taking a shortcut.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，把破門炸藥裝在牆上。我們走捷徑。
^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7化身一號，報告狀況，完畢！

entries.source: ^1UAV Operator: ^7I have Warhorse 5-1 standing by. Pave Low's downriver sir.
entries.target: ^1無人機操作員：^7戰馬五一正在待命。鋪路低空直升機在下游，長官。

entries.source: ^2MacTavish: ^7Roger that. The second UAV is almost in position. Make it count, these things don't grow on trees.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什：^7收到。第二架無人機快就位了。善加利用，這些東西可不是樹上長的。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Copy that! Warhorse 5-1, be advised, we're comin' in hot!
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7收到！戰馬五一，注意，我們正遭到追擊！

entries.source: ^1Pave Low Pilot: ^7Roger - dropping the hatch - keep it above 30 knots and watch the vertical clearance.
entries.target: ^1鋪路低空直升機駕駛員：^7收到，放下艙門。保持三十節以上，注意上方淨空。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord, Hunter 2-1. Be advised: precious cargo is secure, repeat, precious cargo is secure. We're oscar mike.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，獵人二一。注意：重要目標已安全。重複，重要目標已安全。我們出發了。
^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7確實收到！待命！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7That's the control room up ahead! I can use it to find the prisoner!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7前面就是控制室！我可以用它找到囚犯！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Eyes up! Hostiles on our six!
^1Shepherd: ^7Hmph. I knew you couldn't do it...
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7哼，我就知道你下不了手……

entries.source: Smash through enemy defenses in the Gulag and escape.
entries.target: 突破古拉格的敵方防線，逃離監獄。

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7Ok you're clear for now, I don't see anyone too close to the house.
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7好，目前安全，沒看到敵人靠近屋子。
^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7你是個出色的戰士……

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7But only if he lives, and we die.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7但前提是他活著，而我們死了。

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Looks like it still is...they'll be looking for us you know...
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7看來還真是有去無回……你知道，他們會追捕我們……

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Nikolai, we gotta get Soap outta here...
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7尼古萊，我們得帶肥皂離開這裡……

entries.source: ^2Ozone: ^7I'm moving to the main windows, I need someone to mine and cover the driveway approach.
entries.target: ^2臭氧：^7我要到正面的窗戶。需要有人布雷，掩護車道入口。
^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7面對直接威脅，就得採取果斷行動。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We're gonna make it! Just hang on!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我們會成功的！抓緊！

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Tomorrow there will be no shortage of volunteers, no shortage of patriots.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7明天，志願者會絡繹不絕，愛國者也會前仆後繼。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7You heard the man, let's go.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7聽到他說的了，走吧。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Well, smile for the cameras and don't miss...Shepherd's gonna be watching. Best shooter gets to join the prima-donna squad...if that's your thing.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7對鏡頭笑一個，別打偏……謝菲爾德將軍會看著。最佳射手能加入那支大牌小隊……如果你有興趣的話。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7We lost our will to fight that day.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7那一天，我們失去了戰鬥意志。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Roger that Overlord, thanks for the tip. Out.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7收到，霸王。謝謝提醒。通話完畢。

entries.source: ^1Anatoly: ^7We've sent a strong message with this attack, Makarov.
entries.target: ^1阿納托利：^7馬卡洛夫，這次攻擊已經傳達了強烈的訊息。

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7The American will to fight has become weak.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7美國人的戰鬥意志已經薄弱了。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Stay out of sight - you've been spotted!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7躲起來！你被發現了！

entries.source: ^1Shepherd: ^7Five years ago, Zakhaev killed 30,000 Marines in the blink of an eye......and the world just watched.
entries.target: ^1謝菲爾德將軍：^7五年前，扎卡耶夫在眨眼之間殺死了三萬名陸戰隊員……全世界卻袖手旁觀。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Let's split up. I'll use the thermal scope and provide overwatch from this ridge.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7分頭走。我會用熱影像瞄準鏡，在這條山脊上掩護你。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Roger that. I have new orders for you. This comes down from the top, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7收到。有新命令，是上頭直接下達的，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Soap: ^7We got one good SMG. They've got a thousand. We don't even know if Makarov's intel's any good. Price?
entries.target: ^2肥皂：^7我們只有一把好用的衝鋒槍，他們卻有上千把。連馬卡洛夫的情報可不可靠都不知道。普萊斯？

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7You'll be a ghost in this blizzard, so the guards won't see you until you're very close.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7這場暴風雪會讓你像幽靈一樣，守衛得靠得很近才看得到你。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7The healthy human mind doesn't wake up in the morning thinking this is its last day on Earth.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7心智健全的人不會一早醒來，就想著今天是自己在世上的最後一天。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Outgunned. Outnumbered. Out of our minds. On a suicide mission. But the sand and rocks here, stained with thousands of years of warfare -- They will remember us. For this.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7火力不如人，人數不如人，甚至失去了理智，執行著自殺任務。但這裡的沙土和岩石，浸染了數千年的戰火。它們會記得我們，記得我們做的一切。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Take out that chopper. Look for some rockets.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7擊落直升機，找些火箭。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7He's about to complete the greatest trick a liar ever played on history.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7他即將完成騙子對歷史施展過最驚人的騙局。
^2史崔克砲手：^7獾一號保持位置。
^2普萊斯上尉：^7發現敵人，十二點鐘方向！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7前往第二層甲板。
^2基里爾：^7又有聯邦安全局的人。

entries.source: ^1Makarov: ^7You've served me well this far. Don't give me a reason to doubt you.
entries.target: ^1馬卡洛夫：^7到目前為止，你表現得很好。別讓我有理由懷疑你。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7太不小心了。
^1馬卡洛夫：^7我沒耐心容忍懦夫。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Up there! They're making a push for the bridgelayer! Beat 'em back!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7上面！他們要進攻架橋車了！把他們打回去！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad! Protect the Stryker! Watch for foot-mobiles with RPGs!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊！保護史崔克！留意攜帶 RPG 的步兵！

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7I'm not asking you, Price. This is an order. You're to -
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7普萊斯，我不是在徵求意見。這是命令。你必須——

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I'm picking up more radio traffic about the satellite. Standby.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我收到更多關於衛星的無線電通訊。稍候。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach! They've destroyed the DSM! They've destroyed-
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強！他們摧毀了 DSM！他們摧毀——
^1馬卡洛夫：^7那才不是什麼訊息……

entries.source: ^2TF-141 Soldier: ^7We've got these hostages covered. Regroup with the rest of the team topside.
entries.target: ^2一四一特遣隊隊員：^7這些人質交給我們。去上層與其他隊員會合。
^2霸王：^7霸王全部收到。祝好運，通話完畢。

entries.source: ^1Makarov: ^7The American thought he could deceive us. When they find that body...all of Russia will cry for war.
entries.target: ^1馬卡洛夫：^7這個美國人以為能騙過我們。等他們找到這具屍體……全俄國都會吶喊開戰。

entries.source: ^2Dagger Two-One: ^7Dagger Two, SAM launch! Break left break left!
entries.target: ^2匕首二一：^7匕首二號，地對空飛彈發射！左轉規避！左轉規避！
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7他是你的新摯友。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! Get up here on the rooftops, let's go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！上屋頂，到這裡來！快！

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7You don't want to know what it's cost already to put you next to him. It'll cost you even more to stay there.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7你不會想知道，為了讓你接近他，已付出多少代價。想留在他身邊，代價還會更高。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Blow the doors. We'll hit them from both sides.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7炸開門，我們從兩側進攻。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7It will cost nothing, compared to everything you'll save.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7但跟你將拯救的一切相比，那些代價都微不足道。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Use your designator! Laze targets for the Stryker!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7用你的標定器！為史崔克標定目標！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, use your laser designators! Paint targets for the Stryker!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，用雷射標定器！替史崔克標定目標！

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7All Hunter units, this is Badger One. Laze the target, over.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7獵人各單位，這裡是獾一號。請標定目標，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7All Hunter units, this is Badger One. Standing by to engage your targets, over.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7獵人各單位，這裡是獾一號。等待攻擊你們標定的目標，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Roger, we have a lock. Engaging target.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7收到，已鎖定。攻擊目標。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Badger One copies, engaging your target.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7獾一號收到，攻擊你標定的目標。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Sarge, did HQ just tell us to go 'F' ourselves?
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7中士，指揮部剛才是不是叫我們去吃屎？

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Roger, we have a lock. Engaging house.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7收到，已鎖定。攻擊房子。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Copy. Targeting infantry at the grey house
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7收到，瞄準灰房子附近的步兵。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Copy that! Keep moving, we can't afford to lose Rojas!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到！繼續前進，不能讓羅哈斯跑了！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Let's go! Those hostages aren't going to rescue themselves.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7快走！那些人質可不會自己救自己。

entries.source: ^2Dagger Two-One: ^7Enemy gunship lifting off twelve o'clock, War Memorial.
entries.target: ^2匕首二一：^7十二點鐘方向，戰爭紀念碑，敵方武裝直升機正在起飛。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Roger, engaging targets near the fire truck
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7收到，攻擊消防車附近的目標。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Confirmed, suppressing targets near the police car
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7確認，壓制警車附近的目標。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Roach, follow me and stay out of sight.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7小強，跟我來，別被發現。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roger that. Squad, switch to night vision.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到。小隊，切換夜視鏡。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Badger One to Hunter Two, target area suppressed.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7獾一號呼叫獵人二號，目標區域已壓制。
^2史崔克砲手：^7不行，目標超出射程！

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Be advised, we're movin' up. Stand clear.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7注意，我們正在前進。讓開。
^2匕首二一：^7地對空飛彈發射！抓緊！

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7All ground units, stand clear. Badger One is oscar mike.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7各地面單位請讓開。獾一號出發了。
^2史崔克砲手：^7讓開，我們正在前進。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez! Honey Badger's moving! Get your ass outta the way!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲！蜜獾要開動了！快給我閃開！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Cover me, I'm making a break for it!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7掩護我，我要衝過去了！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Get off the streets, use the houses for cover!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7離開街道，利用房子掩護！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez! Honey Badger's moving! Get your ass outta the way!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲！蜜獾要開動了！快給我閃開！

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Hunter Two-One Actual, this is Badger One! Our anti-missile system cannot handle the volume of RPG fire, we need your team to thin 'em out, how copy, over?
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7獵人二一指揮官，這裡是獾一號！RPG 火力太密集，反飛彈系統擋不住！請你們減少敵人數量，收到嗎？完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Got a visual! He's over there, sliding down the tin rooftops!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7看到了！他在那裡，正滑下鐵皮屋頂！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7All Hunter units, be advised, we just lost Badger One. Stryker support is unavailable, I repeat, Stryker support is unavailable. Make do with what you got. Out.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7獵人各單位注意，獾一號已遭摧毀。史崔克支援中斷，重複，史崔克支援中斷。用現有裝備應戰，通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Roger that, enemy foot-mobiles by the apartments, take 'em out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7收到，公寓旁有敵方步兵！幹掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Six-Four, where the hell are you, over?!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7六四，你們到底在哪？完畢！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, move up through these houses, let's go, let's go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，穿過這些房子前進！快！快！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7敵人倒下了。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Thanks for the assist, Hunter Two-One.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7獵人二一，謝謝支援。

entries.source: ^2Stryker Gunner: ^7Nice work, Hunter Two-One. Thanks for the assist.
entries.target: ^2史崔克砲手：^7獵人二一，幹得好。謝謝支援。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Left left left! In those wooden shacks!

entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7你幹掉他了。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One-Actual, Overlord. Gimme a sitrep over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一指揮官，這裡是霸王。回報狀況，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Solid copy Overlord. Divert to 4677 Brookmere Road once the guns are destroyed. Got it.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，收到。摧毀防空砲後，轉往布魯克米爾路4677號。明白。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Check back with me when you've completed your main objective. Overlord out.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7完成主要目標後再回報。霸王通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, call artillery on the enemy vehicles! Use your laser designator!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，用雷射標定器，呼叫砲擊敵方車輛！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7You missed some targets, just keep moving.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7你漏了幾個靶子，繼續前進。
^2砲兵連：^7收到射擊任務，砲彈即將抵達。

entries.source: ^2Artillery Battery: ^7Negative, that's an invalid target, over.
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Nice work Ramirez, one more to go.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，幹得好。還有一個。
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7佛利中士，我是謝菲爾德將軍。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7He'll be expecting you. Challenge is "Icepick", countersign is "Phoenix".
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7他會等著你們。口令是「冰鎬」，回令是「鳳凰」。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Get him outta there and report back to Overlord. Shepherd out.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7把他帶出來，再向霸王回報。謝菲爾德將軍通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, get that briefcase...what's left of it.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，拿那個公事包……剩下的部分。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Hooah. Get a couple of photos for G-2 and check the bodies for intel.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7是。拍幾張照片給情報部，再搜索屍體找情報。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap, what's the status of our air support, over?
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂，空中支援狀況如何？完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord, this place is a tomb. The HVI is dead. Looks like we weren't the only ones after this guy.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，這裡像座墳墓。高價值人物死了。看來追他的人不只我們。
^2稻草人：^7我們得掩護前院草坪！
^2佛利中士：^7霸王，高價值人物死了。

entries.source: ^2Colonel Marshall: ^7That means we still have a way to talk to Central Command if we can retake it!
entries.target: ^2馬歇爾上校：^7只要奪回白宮，就能聯絡中央指揮部！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Dogs. I hate dogs. You go first.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7狗。我討厭狗。你先走。
^2佛利中士：^7謝菲爾德將軍不會喜歡這個結果。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We got some intel off the body though. Shepherd's not gonna like this.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7不過我們從屍體上找到了一些情報。謝菲爾德將軍不會喜歡這個結果。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Copy that. Get that intel back to the CP. Overlord out.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7收到，把情報帶回指揮所。霸王通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap! Shepherd's trying to wipe out us and Makarov at the same time! Head for rally point Bravo to the west! Trust no one!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂！謝菲爾德將軍想同時消滅我們和馬卡洛夫！前往西面的 B 集合點！誰都別信！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7If you've got thermal sights, now would be a good time!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7有熱影像瞄準鏡的，現在正是使用時機！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Head for the rally point! Go! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7前往集合點！快！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Ok, Captain Price, I am on the way! Try to get the situation under control before I get there, ok?
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7好，普萊斯上尉，我正在過去！在我抵達前，盡量控制局面，好嗎？

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Right, whatever you say Nikolai! Just get here sharpish!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7好，你說什麼都行，尼古萊！快點過來就是了！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Got it! Prisoner 627's been transferred to the east wing! Head through the armory in the center - that's the fastest way there.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7找到了！六二七號囚犯被移到東翼！穿過中央軍械庫，那是最快的路。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap! I'm going to get some transport! Make your way west towards the runway!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂！我去找車！你往西前往跑道！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7We can use their comms to listen in on their radio traffic. I'm going to try to contact Makarov.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7可以用他們的通訊器監聽無線電。我要試著聯絡馬卡洛夫。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Makarov, this is Price. Shepherd's a war hero now. He's got your operations playbook and he's got a blank check.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7馬卡洛夫，這裡是普萊斯。謝菲爾德將軍現在成了戰爭英雄。他拿到了你的行動資料，也獲得了無限授權。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Give me what you've got on Shepherd, and I'll take care of the rest.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7把你掌握的謝菲爾德將軍情報給我，剩下的我處理。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7I know you can hear me on this channel Makarov.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7馬卡洛夫，我知道你聽得到這個頻道。

entries.source: ^1Makarov: ^7Price, one day you're going to find that cuts both ways.
entries.target: ^1馬卡洛夫：^7普萊斯，總有一天你會發現，這道理對雙方都適用。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Looking forward to it. Give my regards to Zakhaev if you get there first.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7我等著那一天。如果你先到地獄，替我向扎卡耶夫問好。

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Sand storms around Kandahar, Captain Price. I have to fly around them. I'm not getting paid enough to crash my plane.
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7坎大哈附近有沙塵暴，普萊斯上尉。我得繞過去。這點酬勞可不值得讓我的飛機墜毀。

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Price, I am approaching the boneyard. I see you do not have situation under control. Very unsafe to land. It looks like when I was in Afghanistan with the Soviets!
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7普萊斯，我正接近飛機墳場。我看你們根本沒控制住局面，降落太危險了。簡直跟我當年跟蘇聯部隊在阿富汗一樣！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Any unrecognized contacts will show up as white dots.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7身分不明的目標都會顯示為白點。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap! We don't have much time! Nikolai's not going to wait around for us! Hurry!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂！沒多少時間了！尼古萊不會一直等我們！快！

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Captain Price, I'm taking off in one minute! You better hurry if you want a ride out of here!
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7普萊斯上尉，我一分鐘後起飛！想搭便機離開，就快點！
^2普萊斯上尉：^7發現敵人，正前方！
^2普萊斯上尉：^7前面又有巡邏隊。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7右邊有敵人。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7To the left! To the left!

entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7十二點鐘方向有車輛！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7This is it! We go in, grab Prisoner 627, and get out!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7就是這裡！進去，帶走六二七號，再撤！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, you on the roof yet? Get that sentry gun online and make sure its pointed south.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，上屋頂了嗎？啟動哨戒砲，確認朝向南方。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7What are you waiting for? Reload your weapon.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7還在等什麼？重新裝填。

entries.source: ^2Colonel Marshall: ^7Now get your squad movin' up the left flank! Go!
entries.target: ^2馬歇爾上校：^7現在帶你的小隊推進左翼！快！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap! Rook is down! Take the wheel!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂！魯克倒下了！接手方向盤！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，休息結束了。走吧。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Good luck mate. I'll see you on the far side.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7祝你好運，老兄。對面見。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7My Task Force is out of the country.  I'm commandeering your unit, Sergeant Foley.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7我的特遣隊人在國外。佛利中士，我要徵調你的部隊。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7You should be able to see me on the scope.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7你應該能在螢幕上看到我。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7You take the one on the left.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7左邊那個交給你。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7More tangos on our six! Take 'em out!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7後面又有敵人！幹掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7You need to sprint to complete the course. Go back to the red circle and try again.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7你得衝刺才能完成訓練。回到紅圈再試一次。
^2匕首二一：^7輕型裝甲車正在進場。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I guess I have to do everything?
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我看什麼事都得我來？
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7暴風雪越來越強了。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7See what I mean? He sprayed bullets all over the damn place.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7懂我的意思了吧？他把子彈灑得到處都是。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Use the cover of the storm to enter the base.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7利用暴風雪掩護，進入基地。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Keep an eye on your heartbeat sensor, good luck.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7留意心跳感測器。祝你好運。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7這個交給我。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7目標倒下了。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach - they found a corpse but they're not onto you yet. Stay calm.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，他們發現了屍體，但還沒察覺你。保持冷靜。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Stay out of sight - you've alerted one of them!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7躲起來！你驚動了其中一個！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7One of them has seen you, stay out of sight!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7有一個看見你了！躲起來！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7I'm sending part of the squad to help you out! Go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7我正派部分隊員去幫你！快！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Stay out of sight - you've alerted some guards.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7躲起來，你驚動了幾名守衛。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Take cover! They're on to you!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7找掩護！他們發現你了！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Get out of there they've found you!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7離開那裡！他們找到你了！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7目標在你左邊。
^2肥皂：^7正在裝填空對地飛彈，稍候。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7目標在你後面。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7The rest of them have given up looking for you and they're returning to their original positions.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7其餘的人已放棄搜索，正返回原位。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I've got you covered Roach! Move up! Move up!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，我掩護你！前進！前進！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Heavy assault troops up ahead! Don't attack them head on! Move quickly and hit them from the side!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7前面有重裝突擊兵！別正面攻擊！快速移動，從側面打！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7No kills, no alerts, impressive Roach.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7沒殺人，也沒觸發警報。小強，真有你的。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7All right, I've tapped into their comms.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7好，我已接入他們的通訊。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Head southeast and plant your C4 at the fueling station.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7往東南方，在加油站安裝 C4。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, the fueling station is near the northeast corner of the runway.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，加油站在跑道東北角附近。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7卡車回來了。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Four tangos just got out and are looking around.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7四個敵人剛下車，正在四處查看。

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7All callsigns, this is the Washington Monument evac site! Our status is critical, we are still taking fire from enemy armor and aircraft, please assist!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7各單位，這裡是華盛頓紀念碑撤離點！情況危急，仍遭敵方裝甲車與飛機攻擊！請支援！

entries.source: ^2ISS Control: ^7Sat1, rotate your view a little further to the right will ya?
entries.target: ^2國際太空站控制中心：^7Sat1，視角再往右轉一點，好嗎？
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7那就是加油站。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, go back to the fueling station and plant your C4.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，回加油站安裝 C4。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I'm headed for the hanger. Get there asap.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我正前往機庫。儘快過來。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach I'm waiting behind the hangars at the southwest corner of the runway.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，我在跑道西南角的機庫後方等你。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One, this is Overlord. SEAL teams are maneuvering into position on the northwest corner of the target building. Link up with them on the top floor and eliminate enemy fire teams, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，這裡是霸王。海豹小隊正移到目標建築西北角。到頂樓會合，消滅敵方火力小組，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, meet me behind the hangers at the southwest corner of the runway.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，到跑道西南角的機庫後方與我會合。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Shepherd! We've got the prisoner but we're not out! We need more time!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7謝菲爾德將軍！找到囚犯了，但還沒出來！我們需要更多時間！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7That BMP's got thermal sights! Get the hell out of there!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7那輛 BMP 有熱影像瞄準鏡！快離開那裡！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7繞路看風景去了，是吧？

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! I've spotted Rojas, he's making a run for it! He's headed your way!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！看到羅哈斯了，他正在逃跑！朝你那邊去了！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7你還帶了幾個朋友來？

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, we're at the crash site! Get over here!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，我們在墜機地點！過來！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Go upstairs and look for the ACS module.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7上樓找 ACS 模組。
^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，在餐廳會合。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, I've been compromised! Keep a low profile and hold your fire.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，我暴露了！保持隱蔽，別開火。

entries.source: ^1Major Petrov: ^7To enemy infiltrators, we have captured one of your comrades!
entries.target: ^1彼得羅夫少校：^7敵方滲透者聽著，我們抓到了你們的一名同伴！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, we got hostiles! Use your Predator Drone control rig to protect Raptor!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，有敵人！用掠奪者無人機控制器保護猛禽！

entries.source: ^1Major Petrov: ^7We know you are up there! Surrender now and we will spare your comrade!
entries.target: ^1彼得羅夫少校：^7我們知道你在上面！立刻投降，就饒你同伴一命！

entries.source: ^1Major Petrov: ^7If you do not surrender, your comrade will die.
entries.target: ^1彼得羅夫少校：^7再不投降，你的同伴就得死。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, take that snowmobile! Let's get the hell out of here!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，拿那輛雪地摩托車！快離開這鬼地方！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，採用 B 計畫。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Stay close and hug the wall! We'll use the MiGs for cover and cross the tarmac to the southeast!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7靠近我，貼著牆走！利用米格戰機掩護，穿過停機坪往東南方！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7All callsigns, be advised, enemies to the west are attempting a force-in-detail assault on the Washington Monument evac site!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7各單位注意，西方敵軍正集中兵力攻擊華盛頓紀念碑撤離點！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! Make a run for the MiG to the east!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！衝向東邊那架米格！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Quick! Hide in the woods! You alerted one of them!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7快！躲進樹林！你驚動了一個！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Head for that MiG, I'll cover you!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7往那架米格走，我掩護你！

entries.source: ^2Dagger Two-One: ^7RPG teams at the World War 2 memorial...pull that trigger till they don't get up.
entries.target: ^2匕首二一：^7二戰紀念碑有 RPG 小組，扣住扳機，直到他們爬不起來。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I'll make a run for the next MiG! Give me some covering fire!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我要衝向下一架米格！給我掩護火力！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7There's a mobile SAM site in the village. It just shot down our Predator.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7村裡有機動地對空飛彈陣地，剛把掠奪者打下來了。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I'm heading for those jeeps, cover me!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我正衝向那些吉普車！掩護我！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We need to get off the street!
^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! Get on that snowmobile let's go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！上那輛雪地摩托車，走！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7This is Hunter Two-One Actual! We have eyes on multiple hostile victors and foot mobiles....request permission to engage, over!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7這裡是獵人二一指揮官！發現多輛敵方車輛與步兵，請求准許交戰，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7More tangos to the rear! Just outrun them! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7後面又有敵人！甩開他們！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Don't slow down! Keep moving or you're dead!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7別減速！繼續前進，不然就沒命了！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Grab that weapon off the table and fire at the targets behind you.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拿起桌上的武器，射擊你後面的靶子。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7直升機在那裡！走！

entries.source: Lost Connection to the other Special Ops player for &&1 seconds.
entries.target: 與另一名特種作戰玩家已失聯 &&1 秒。

entries.source: ^2Crew Chief: ^7Okay, they got the ACS! We're outta here!
entries.target: ^2機組長：^7好，他們拿到 ACS 了！撤！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Roger that Soap. I've found Roach. He appears to be intact.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂，收到。找到小強了，看起來沒事。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7We're going to head northwest to the sub base, over.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7我們往西北方的潛艦基地走，完畢。

entries.source:
Reach the Farm House basement.
Reach the western edge of the Workshops.
Reach the Barn near the Greenhouses.
entries.target:
抵達農舍地下室。
抵達工坊西緣。
抵達溫室附近的穀倉。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7These Russian dogs are like pussycats compared to the ones in Pripyat.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7和普里皮亞季那些相比，這些俄國狗簡直像小貓。
^2普萊斯上尉：^7耐心點，別做傻事。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7We'll have to take 'em out at the same time.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7得同時幹掉他們。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Wait for me to get into position.
This Special Ops game already has two players.
entries.target: 此特種作戰已有兩名玩家。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7I'm in position - take the shot when you're ready.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7已就位。準備好就開槍。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Now's your chance. Take one of 'em out.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7機會來了，幹掉其中一個。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roger that, RPG team to the north!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7收到，北面有 RPG 小隊！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Two of them have stopped for a smoke. Take one and I'll take out the other.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7兩個人停下抽菸。你打一個，另一個交給我。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Take out the two in the woods on the other side of the bridge.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7幹掉橋對面樹林裡的兩個人。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Not bad, but I've seen better.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7不錯，但我看過更好的。

entries.source: ^2Royce: ^7Remember - there are civilians in the favela. Watch your fire out there.
entries.target: ^2羅伊斯：^7記住，貧民窟裡有平民。小心開火。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Looks like they saw your landing. Let's keep moving.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7看來他們看到你降落了。繼續走。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7That was close. Let's keep moving.

entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7他警覺了！躲起來！
^2普萊斯上尉：^7他們找到屍體了。
客戶端玩家已結束遊戲

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Crouch under the obstacle and keep moving!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7蹲下穿過障礙，繼續前進！
^2普萊斯上尉：^7十二點鐘方向有大型巡邏隊。
^2普萊斯上尉：^7又有軍犬巡邏隊。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Take them out or go around.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7幹掉他們，或繞過去。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Take the two on the right.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7幹掉右邊那兩個。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7There's Nikolai's Pave Low! Let's go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7尼古萊的鋪路低空直升機在那裡！走！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7You take the handler and his dog on the left.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7左邊的軍犬和領犬員交給你。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap, our intel was off. The Russians have mobile SAMs.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂，情報有誤。俄軍有機動地對空飛彈。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Looks like they're searching for us.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7看來他們在找我們。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1 this is Overlord. We got a visual on a pair of enemy attack helicopters headed for your area, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，這裡是霸王。發現兩架敵方攻擊直升機朝你們飛去，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7All callsigns, this is the Washington Monument evac site! Be advised, our situation is critical! We can't take much more of this! We need more time to get these civvies outta here!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7各單位，華盛頓紀念碑撤離點呼叫！情況危急，快撐不住了！我們需要更多時間撤出平民！

entries.source: ^2MacTavish: ^7A UAV loaded with AGMs is en route to your position.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什：^7一架搭載空對地飛彈的無人機，正飛往你們的位置。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Keep corraling him up the hill! We'll cut him off at the top!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7繼續把他往山坡上趕！我們會在頂端截住他！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Everyone get ready! Lock and load!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7所有人準備！裝填上膛！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Roach take control of the UAV.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7小強，接管無人機。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7There's a mobile SAM site in the village. It just shot down our UAV.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7村裡有機動地對空飛彈陣地，剛把無人機打下來了。

entries.source: ^2ISS Control: ^7Houston, we're not scheduled for any satellite launches today are we?
entries.target: ^2國際太空站控制中心：^7休士頓，今天沒有預定發射衛星，對吧？
^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂，我們需要另一架掠奪者！

entries.source: Launch your snowmobile across the chasm before time runs out.  Hit the flag gates to get extra time.
entries.target: 在時間耗盡前，駕駛雪地摩托車飛越深谷。穿越旗門可增加時間。

entries.source: ^2Soap: ^7Roger that. The second Predator is almost in position. Make it count, these things don't grow on trees.
entries.target: ^2肥皂：^7收到。第二架掠奪者快就位了。善加利用，這些東西可不是樹上長的。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Soap, we've linked up with Ghost and the rest of the team.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂，我們已與幽靈和其他隊員會合。
^2肥皂：^7整座基地都進入警戒了！

entries.source: ^2Soap: ^7You'd better hurry. You've only got a couple of minutes before that submarine dives.
entries.target: ^2肥皂：^7最好快一點，潛艦再過幾分鐘就會下潛。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7留意敵人繞側翼的路線！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7I got a fix on Raptor! 300 meters to the east!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7找到猛禽了！東方三百公尺！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Use a Predator missile on that truck!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7用掠奪者飛彈打那輛卡車！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach, we have to get to that guardhouse by the west gate to cover Price! Follow me!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強，得去西門旁的警衛室掩護普萊斯！跟我來！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7All right, I'm inside the sub! Cover me, I need a few minutes!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7好，我已進入潛艦！掩護我，我需要幾分鐘！

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7We've got to hurry! That sub isn't going to wait for us!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7得快一點！潛艦不會等我們！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7More vehicles to the east! Use the UAV!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7東方又有車輛！用無人機！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We've gotta get to the helicopter - head through the gate to the market! Move!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我們得趕到直升機！穿過大門，前往市場！快！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7More vehicles to the east! Use the UAV!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7東方又有車輛！用無人機！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Corporal Dunn, check it out! What else?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7鄧恩下士，去看看！還有什麼？
^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂，我們到潛艦了！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Contact to the north, on the dock next to the sub!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7北方有敵人，就在潛艦旁的碼頭！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Price, are you there? The silo doors are opening on the sub, I repeat, the silo doors are opening on the sub!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7普萊斯，還在嗎？潛艦正在開啟發射井蓋！重複，正在開啟發射井蓋！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Price, do you copy? The silo doors are open, I repeat, the silo doors are open!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7普萊斯，收到嗎？發射井蓋已打開！重複，發射井蓋已打開！

entries.source: ^2Soap: ^7AGM Missile is online. I repeat AGM Missile is online.
entries.target: ^2肥皂：^7空對地飛彈已就緒。重複，空對地飛彈已就緒。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Boundaries shift, new players step in, but power always finds a place to rest its head.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7疆界變動，新勢力崛起，但權力總會找到安身之處。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Plant C4 on the bodies. The patrol will be here any minute.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7在屍體上安裝 C4。巡邏隊隨時會來。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Overlord copies all. The evac site at the Washington Monument reports several transports away, but they are still vulnerable. Can you provide support from your position, over?
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7霸王全部收到。華盛頓紀念碑撤離點回報多架運輸機已離開，但仍很脆弱。你們能就地支援嗎？完畢。
^2肥皂：^7確認擊斃多名敵人，幹得好。

entries.source: ^2Soap: ^7Good hit. Looks like at least three kills.
entries.target: ^2肥皂：^7命中，看起來至少幹掉三個。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7You've been in the gulag too long, Price. Focus on taking out Makarov.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7普萊斯，你在古拉格待太久了。專心對付馬卡洛夫。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7No time, sir. We need to end this war today.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7沒時間了，長官。我們今天就得結束這場戰爭。

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7Hustle up! Get to Whiskey Hotel! Move!
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7動作快！前往威士忌旅館！快！

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7Glad to see you guys made it! Report to Colonel Marshall up top! Go!
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7很高興你們撐過來了！到上面向馬歇爾上校報到！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen, you're not snapping to your targets. You need to quickly engage and release aiming down the sight to snap to new targets.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵，你沒有迅速轉向目標。你得快速舉槍、放下，再舉槍。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Work your way to the left!
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Move up! We gotta take the left flank!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7前進！我們得拿下左翼！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Two minutes? What the hell is he talking about?
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7兩分鐘？他到底在說什麼？

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We got less than two minutes before they flatten the city! We gotta get to the roof and stop 'em!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7不到兩分鐘，他們就會夷平整座城市！得上屋頂阻止他們！

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7Never thought I'd say this, but I wish I had some Iron sites. These red dots are worthless.
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7沒想到我會這麼說，但真希望有機械瞄具。這些紅點全廢了。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We got less than two minutes, let's go!
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord, we've linked up with the SEALs on the rooftop and are heading out. Interrogative - has the Washinton Monument site been evacuated, over?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，已在屋頂與海豹小隊會合，準備撤離。請問華盛頓紀念碑撤離完成了嗎？完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^790 seconds! We gotta push through!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7九十秒！必須衝過去！

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7So when are we goin' to Moscow?
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7那我們什麼時候去莫斯科？

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7The LZ is still receiving heavy fire from the target building, break - I see RPG teams on the upper floors, and medium caliber fire coming from the southwest corner over.
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7降落區仍遭目標建築猛烈攻擊。另有消息：上層有 RPG 小組，西南角有中口徑火力，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Not soon enough, man. But I know we're gonna burn it down when we get there.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7越快越好，老兄。但我知道，等我們到了就會把它燒光。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Team, shift your fire to the west.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，將火力轉向西方。
^2佛利中士：^7收到，二一指揮官通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Listen up! This evac site is getting hit hard and we need to buy 'em some time! Hooah?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7聽著！撤離點正遭猛攻，必須替他們爭取時間！明白嗎？
^2遊騎兵：^7十二點鐘方向，標槍飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez! Stay in the trenches, you're gonna get your ass blown off!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲！留在壕溝，不然會被炸飛！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Stay low! Stick to the trenches!
^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Get your ass back in the trenches!
^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez, what are you doing? Stick to the trenches!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲，你在幹什麼？沿著壕溝走！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7沒聽過這個人，長官。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord, We're on the fifth floor, proceeding to the southwest corner.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，我們在五樓，正前往西南角。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord, this is Hunter Two-One Actual. Requesting airstrike, over!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，這裡是獵人二一指揮官。請求空襲，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Yesterday you were a soldier on the front lines.  But today front lines are history.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7昨天你還是前線的士兵。但今天，前線已成了歷史。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Uh, negative Two-One Actual, all available air units are currently tasked with multiple casevacs along the Potomac. Proceed west to the target building and provide support, out.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7不行，二一指揮官。目前所有航空單位都在波多馬克河沿岸撤離傷患。向西前往目標建築支援，通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! Hostiles on the third floor, use your M203!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！三樓有敵人，用 M203！
取得二十顆星即可解鎖。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7That looks to be at least five no, ten kills, hunter two one. Keep it up.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7看起來至少幹掉五個……不，十個！獵人二一，繼續。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7I see foot mobiles...12 o'clock, 100 meters!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7看到步兵了！十二點鐘方向，一百公尺！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Ghost we have a situation here!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7幽靈，我們這裡有狀況！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7All right! BCT One's LAV has them suppressed! Get ready to move on my mark!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7好！第一旅級戰鬥隊的輕型裝甲車壓制住他們了！準備聽我信號前進！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Go go go! Move up! Move up!
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! The LAV has them suppressed! Move in! Move in!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！輕型裝甲車壓制住他們了！突入！突入！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Push, push, push! We're sitting ducks out here!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7推進！推進！推進！待在外面只能當活靶！

entries.source: ^2Sub Commander: ^7Copy that, intel still indicates hostages and possible explosives on the top deck.
entries.target: ^2潛艦指揮官：^7收到。情報仍指出頂層甲板有人質，也可能有炸藥。

entries.source: Time trials, explosive breaches, boneyards and enemies in Ghillie Suits.  Things are getting a bit tougher.
entries.target: 計時挑戰、爆破突入、飛機墳場與穿吉利服的敵人。難度開始提高。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Move up, get out of the killzone!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！前進，離開火力區！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Get your ass out of the killzone and into the target building, now!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！現在就離開火力區，進目標建築！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Keep an eye on your heartbeat sensor Ramirez. I wanna hit 'em fast and hard.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，留意心跳感測器。我要打得又快又狠。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！小強！醒醒！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Outlaw Two-Three this is Two-One-Actual. Interrogative - what are you seeing from your position over?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7亡命徒二三，這裡是二一指揮官。你們的位置看到什麼？完畢。
^2佛利中士：^7留意各自負責的區域。
^2佛利中士：^7五 A 區的 RPG 小組已消滅。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7AGM missile is online. I repeat AGM missile is online.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7空對地飛彈已就緒。重複，空對地飛彈已就緒。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Enemy fire team suppressed, section five-bravo.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7五 B 區的敵方火力小組已壓制。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Enemy RPG team down, section five-echo.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7五 E 區的敵方 RPG 小組已消滅。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Enemy fire team down, section five-india.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7五 I 區的敵方火力小組已消滅。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Fire team has been suppressed in Section One-Alpha.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7一 A 區的火力小組已壓制。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Overlord copies all. Two-One, proceed to the southwest corner. Out.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7霸王全部收到。二一，前往西南角。通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord this is Hunter Two-One Actual. Proceeding to the mezzanine. Tell the LAV from BCT One to hold their fire, over.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，這裡是獵人二一指揮官。正前往夾層，請第一旅級戰鬥隊的輕型裝甲車停火，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! Lay down some fire on the intersection!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！朝交叉路口提供壓制火力！
^2佛利中士：^7二 E 區的敵人已壓制。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Solid copy Overlord. We are Oscar Mike to the fifth floor. Out.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，收到。正前往五樓，通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Go easy on him sir, it's his first day in the Regiment.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7對他溫和點，長官。這是他入隊第一天。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7All Hunter units, I have a visual on the enemy's crow's nest at the southwest corner. Move forward and clear it out.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7獵人各單位，看到西南角的敵方瞭望哨了。前進，肅清那裡。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Roger that! We're sittin' on a stockpile of enemy munitions! We'll dig in and burn through their ammo! Out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7收到！這裡有一堆敵方軍火！我們會固守，把他們的彈藥用光！通話完畢！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, get on that sniper rifle! Scan for targets to the south of the Washington Monument!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，操作狙擊步槍！搜索華盛頓紀念碑南方的目標！
^2鄧恩下士：^7正在安裝闊刀地雷！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7All callsigns on this net, be advised we are taking heavy fire from the west. Enemy infantry and artillery spotters  confirmed, due west of our position.
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7本頻道各單位注意，西方火力猛烈。已確認正西方有敵方步兵和砲兵觀測員。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We got foot-mobiles firing Javelin rockets on the evac site! Ramirez, get on the Barrett and take 'em out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7敵方步兵正用標槍飛彈攻擊撤離點！拉米雷茲，操作巴雷特，幹掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7The Washington Monument evac site is still taking fire. Get on the Barrett and take 'em out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7華盛頓紀念碑撤離點還在遭到射擊！操作巴雷特，幹掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez - get your ass on that sniper rifle. Move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，快操作那把狙擊步槍！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7The evac site is still taking heavy fire! Ramirez - target all enemy foot-mobiles firing Javelin rockets!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7撤離點仍遭猛烈攻擊！拉米雷茲，瞄準所有發射標槍飛彈的敵方步兵！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, get back here! We gotta provide support to the evac site before they get overrun!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，回來！得在撤離點被攻陷前提供支援！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach! We can see them from the chopper! They're coming for you, dozens of 'em!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強！我們從直升機看到他們了！好幾十個人正衝向你！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Where the hell are you going? We need to cover the evac site at the Washington Monument!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7你到底去哪裡？得掩護華盛頓紀念碑撤離點！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7Request you engage all enemy targets west of the Washington Monument! I repeat - request you engage all enemy targets west of the Washington Monument, over!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7請攻擊華盛頓紀念碑西方的所有敵方目標！重複，請攻擊紀念碑西方所有敵方目標，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7This is the Washington Monument evac site! Be advised we are taking heavy fire from enemy armor and aircraft! We are down to 80 percent combat effectiveness!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7這裡是華盛頓紀念碑撤離點！敵方裝甲車與飛機火力猛烈！戰力剩百分之八十！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7Be advised, hostile forces are attacking the Washington Monument evac site! We are requesting support from any units in the area, over!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7注意，敵軍正攻擊華盛頓紀念碑撤離點！請求附近所有單位支援，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Take cover! That BTR's spotted you!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7找掩護！那輛 BTR 看到你了！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7We are taking major casualties, military and civilian! Request you engage targets west of the Monument! Over!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7軍民傷亡慘重！請攻擊紀念碑西方目標！完畢！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7Washington Monument evac site taking heavy fire! We're down to 50 percent combat effectiveness! We gotta get more fire support or this evac site is gonna fall! Over!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7華盛頓紀念碑撤離點正遭猛攻！戰力剩百分之五十！需要更多火力支援，否則就守不住了！完畢！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7All callsigns be advised, we got civilians taking up arms to defend the evac site but they're totally untrained! We are on the verge of being overrun! We need help now!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7各單位注意，平民正拿武器保衛撤離點，但他們毫無訓練！即將遭到攻陷！現在就需要援助！

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7This is the Whiskey Mike evac site! Combat personnel are mostly dead! We are below 10 percent combat effectiveness! Request additional fire support, over!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7這裡是 W M 撤離點！戰鬥人員多數已陣亡，戰力低於百分之十！請增援火力，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One be advised, you have enemy foot mobiles converging on your position...stay frosty.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，注意，敵方步兵正在包圍你們。保持警戒。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Taking fire! Taking fire! Foot mobiles in the perimeter!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7遭到射擊！遭到射擊！步兵進了防線！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Negative negative! I have eyes on enemy armor and helicopters advancing on the evac site from the south and southwest!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7不行，不行！看到敵方裝甲車與直升機，正從南方和西南方攻向撤離點！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We'll keep him from doubling back on our side - keep going and cut him off up top!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我們會擋住這邊，不讓他往回跑。繼續前進，到上面截住他！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We're gonna do what we can to buy them more time! Out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7我們會盡力替他們爭取更多時間！通話完畢！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, listen up! We are not, I repeat - we are not abandoning those casevacs, hooah?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，聽著！我們不會，重複，不會拋下那些傷患撤離隊！明白嗎？

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Find some heavy ordnance and take out the armor and helicopters...we need to give our people on the ground time to get out.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！找重武器，摧毀裝甲車和直升機！得替地面人員爭取撤離時間。

entries.source: ^2Overlord (HQ Radio): ^7Hunter 2-1 Actual this is Overlord, send traffic.
entries.target: ^2霸王（指揮部無線電）：^7獵人二一指揮官，這裡是霸王。請講。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Grab a Javelin and destroy those vehicles!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拿標槍飛彈，摧毀那些車輛！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Enemy vehicles are closing in! Take 'em out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7敵方車輛正在逼近！摧毀它們！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7We've got a new guy joining us today fresh out of Selection. His name's Soap.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7今天有個剛通過選拔的新人加入。他叫肥皂。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One, you've bought the evac site valuable time! Well done! Now get your ass to the roof ASAP...you are in danger of being overrun!
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，已替撤離點爭取到寶貴時間！幹得好！現在儘快上屋頂，否則可能被攻陷！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7All we got outta Rojas is that the only guy Makarov hates worse than Americans is locked up in a gulag.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7從羅哈斯口中問出的唯一線索，是馬卡洛夫最痛恨的人被關在古拉格，比美國人還恨。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez! I saw a couple Stingers on the roof of Nate's!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲！奈特餐廳屋頂有幾具刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Roger that, we're headed to the rooftop! Everyone, move out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7收到，正前往屋頂！所有人出發！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Keep moving! This sector's gonna be crawlin' with hostiles! We gotta go, now!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7繼續前進！這區馬上會擠滿敵人！現在就得走！
^2佛利中士：^7沒時間了！繼續前進！
^2普萊斯上尉：^7對一四一特遣隊來說，沒有不可能。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We have to keep moving! Go! Go! Go!
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We're getting overrun! Move! Move! Move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7我們快被攻陷了！快！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Alright. Head back in and give it another go.
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Get to the roof and RV with the SEAL Team! Move! Move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7上屋頂與海豹小隊會合！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Move your ass! We've gotta get to the roof, now!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！動作快！現在就得上屋頂！
^2佛利中士：^7十二點鐘方向有敵方傘兵！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, let's go! Hostiles are overrunning this position!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，快走！敵人正在攻陷這裡！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Up the stairs! Let's go!
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Get up the stairs to the roof ASAP...our evac choppers aren't going to wait all day!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！儘快上樓到屋頂！撤離直升機不會等一整天！

entries.source: ^2Dagger Two-One: ^7Hunter, this is Dagger Two-One. We are in position at the LZ on the rooftop, what's your status?
entries.target: ^2匕首二一：^7獵人，這裡是匕首二一。我們已在屋頂降落區就位，你們狀況如何？
^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！上直升機！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! You're polishing brass on the Titanic! Get on the minigun, let's go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！船都要沉了，你還在擦銅器！操作迷你砲，快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, spin her up and let her rip!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，讓它轉起來，放開打！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Copy Overlord, we'll do what we can from the air, out.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，收到。我們會從空中盡力支援，通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Knock it off! Hunter 2, we're oscar mike! Move out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7別鬧了！獵人二號，出發！前進！
^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，操作迷你砲！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord, Dagger Two-Two is hit and going down!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，匕首二二中彈，正在墜落！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, we're engaging all targets of opportunity to buy Outlaw some time to get out! This may be a one way trip! Hooah?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，攻擊沿途所有目標，替亡命徒爭取撤離時間！這可能是單程旅行！明白嗎？

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Roger. Switch to thermal if you got it.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7收到。有熱影像瞄準鏡就切換過去。

entries.source: ^2SEAL Team Leader: ^7We're with you, Two-One. Let's do this.
entries.target: ^2海豹小隊隊長：^7二一，我們跟你一起。開始吧。

entries.source: ^2Dagger Two-One: ^7Ramirez, we got foot mobiles and light armor down there. You're cleared hot.
entries.target: ^2匕首二一：^7拉米雷茲，下面有步兵和輕型裝甲車。准許開火。

entries.source: ^2Evac Site: ^7Dagger Two, the Washington Monument is taking fire from the main road!
entries.target: ^2撤離點：^7匕首二號，華盛頓紀念碑正遭主要道路方向的射擊！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord, we're hit, but still in the air. We've got a massive SAM battery at the Department of Justice...we're going in!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，我們中彈了，但還在空中。司法部有大批地對空飛彈陣地，我們要衝進去！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Alright, that wasn't horrible, but it wasn't amazing either.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7好，不算太差，但也沒多出色。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Take us up! If we're goin' down we're taking those SAM sites with us!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7往上拉！就算墜落，也要拖那些飛彈陣地陪葬！

entries.source: ^2Dagger Two-One: ^7We're hit!  Mayday mayday, this is Dagger Two-One.  We are going down at grid square Papa Bravo, 2...
entries.target: ^2匕首二一：^7我們中彈了！求救！求救！這裡是匕首二一，正墜落在 P B 方格，二……

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7This is Shepherd. We're almost at the LZ. What's your status, over?
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7這裡是謝菲爾德將軍。我們快到降落區了。你們情況如何？完畢。

entries.source: ^2Pvt. Wells: ^7We got a supply drop on the roof with an M-5 sentry gun!
entries.target: ^2威爾斯二等兵：^7屋頂有空投補給，裡面有 M-5 哨戒砲！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I see four hostiles on the next tower!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7下一座塔上有四個敵人！
^2鄧恩下士：^7佛利，最後一個彈匣！

entries.source: ^2ISS Control: ^7Come in Sat1.  This is ISS Control. Houston's requesting a feed from your helmet cam, over.
entries.target: ^2國際太空站控制中心：^7Sat1，請回答。這裡是國際太空站控制中心。休士頓要求接收你的頭盔攝影機影像，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Keep it together 2-3! We're on the way! 2-1 out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7二三，撐住！我們正在趕來！二一通話完畢！

entries.source: ^2ISS Control: ^7Uh... they want you to look over towards the dark side of the earth. It should be cresting the horizon about 15 degrees east of the starboard PV arrays.
entries.target: ^2國際太空站控制中心：^7呃……他們要你看向地球的暗面。目標應該會出現在右舷太陽能板陣列以東約十五度的地平線上。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Sprint to the exit! Clock's ticking!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7衝向出口！時間在跑！

entries.source: ^2ISS Control: ^7There it is, we're getting your feed Sat1. Come in Houston, are you getting this?
entries.target: ^2國際太空站控制中心：^7在那裡，我們收到影像了，Sat1。休士頓，請回答，你們收到了嗎？

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7He's inside that diner to the west, over!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7他在西邊的小餐館裡，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Houston Command: ^7Copy that ISS, video feed from Sat1 is clear.
entries.target: ^2休士頓指揮中心：^7收到，太空站。Sat1 的影像清晰。

entries.source: ^2Houston Command: ^7Sat1, keep tracking the bogey. We're looking into it, standby.
entries.target: ^2休士頓指揮中心：^7Sat1，繼續追蹤不明目標。我們正在調查，請稍候。

entries.source: ^2Houston Command: ^7ISS, Houston. Standby. We may have a problem here.
entries.target: ^2休士頓指揮中心：^7太空站，這裡是休士頓。請稍候。可能出了狀況。

entries.source: ^2ISS Control: ^7Houston, this is ISS Control, uh....
entries.target: ^2國際太空站控制中心：^7休士頓，這裡是國際太空站控制中心，呃……

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Get off the street now! Go!
^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7What the hell are we gonna do now, man?  Russians got us out numbered, shit's falling from the sky. We're screwed man! We're totally -
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7現在到底該怎麼辦？俄軍人比我們多，天上又有東西往下掉。我們完了！我們根本——

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7You're goin' out there? Are you nuts?

entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7這裡到底發生什麼事？

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Hey is your red dot working? Mine's out.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7嘿，你的紅點瞄準鏡還能用嗎？我的壞了。

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7Mine's down too. This is weird, bro.
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7我的也壞了。真奇怪，老兄。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7You wanna put out an oil fire, Sir, you set off a bigger explosion right next to it.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7長官，要撲滅油田大火，就得在旁邊引爆更大的爆炸。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Looks like optics are down...comms too.  There's not even a street light for blocks.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7看來電子瞄具都壞了……通訊也一樣。幾條街內連盞路燈都沒亮。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Yeah, maybe one of the higher-ups went and grew a pair. Saved our butts, that's for sure.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7是啊，也許哪個高層終於有膽量了。反正確實救了我們。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7All right. We gotta regroup with whoever's left out there. Corporal Dunn, take point.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7好。我們得跟外面的生還部隊會合。鄧恩下士，帶路。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7The proper response is 'Texas', soldier. What'dya got?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7正確回令是「德州」，士兵。你有什麼消息？

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7Colonel Marshall's assembling a task force at Whiskey Hotel. You guys need to keep heading north.
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7馬歇爾上校正在威士忌旅館集結部隊。你們繼續往北走。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7So where are you goin' then?
^2Ranger: ^7To tell everyone else! Get to Whiskey Hotel! Go!
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7通知其他人！快去威士忌旅館！快！

entries.source: ^2Sub Commander: ^7Your team needs to secure that location before we can send in reinforcements to handle the SAM sites, over.
entries.target: ^2潛艦指揮官：^7你們得先控制那個地點，我們才能派援軍處理地對空飛彈陣地，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Control, all hostages have been secured. I repeat - all hostages secured. Proceeding to LZ Bravo, over.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7指揮中心，所有人質已獲救。重複，所有人質已獲救。正前往 B 降落區，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7There's the Eisenhower Building. Whiskey Hotel's on the other side.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7那是艾森豪行政大樓。威士忌旅館在另一側。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Aw man, we gotta go out there...
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Dunn. Check for vitals, we'll cover you.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7鄧恩，檢查生命跡象。我們掩護你。

entries.source: ^2Vandenberg AFB: ^7Negatory, Station.  Scope is clear. I dunno what to tell ya.  Solar interference?  Heavy sunspot activity today.
entries.target: ^2范登堡空軍基地：^7沒有，指揮中心。雷達一片乾淨。我也不知道怎麼解釋。太陽干擾？今天的太陽黑子很活躍。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One, Goliath One has a visual on a hostile patrol coming from the southeast, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，巨人一號看到敵方巡邏隊正從東南方逼近，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7I don't know what's worse, man- dodging falling helicopters or freezing my ass in this monsoon.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7不知道哪個更慘，躲墜落的直升機，還是在這場暴雨裡凍死。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Get to an elevated position. We'll ambush them when they discover the bodies.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7到高處，等他們發現屍體再伏擊。

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7We got two trucks leaving the target building!
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7有兩輛卡車正離開目標建築！
^2普萊斯：^7他的說法，就會成為真相。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Cut the chatter. Ramirez, take point.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7別閒聊。拉米雷茲，帶路。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7No, that's just for tourists. This must be the real thing. Open it up.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7不，那只是給遊客看的。這裡才是真的。把門打開。
^2幽靈：^7他們正往我們左側翼移動！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Real or not man, this place is history. Hope they got out in time.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7不管是真是假，這地方都毀了。希望他們及時逃出去。

entries.source: ^2Scarecrow: ^7They've got this area presighted for mortar fire!
entries.target: ^2稻草人：^7他們已標定這區的迫擊砲射擊諸元！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Counterattack into the smoke! Push push push!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7衝進煙霧反擊！前進！前進！前進！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach! You're gonna get hit by a mortar! Lose 'em in the smoke! Go go go!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強！迫擊砲會打中你！躲進煙霧甩掉他們！快！快！快！

entries.source: Turn back and continue the mission!

entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7該死，這些卡車有防彈裝甲！
^2幽靈：^7該死，這些卡車加裝了裝甲！
^2弓箭手：^7收到！發射標槍飛彈，友軍注意近距離爆炸！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Javelin, danger close! Get back from the road!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7標槍飛彈，近距離爆炸！離開道路！

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7She'll walk you in.  The Russians are burning through our defenses and our intel.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7它會掩護你們前進。俄軍正在突破我們的防線，也掌握了我們的情報。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Now that was pretty damn good. Nice work, Allen.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7這次真不錯。幹得好，艾倫。

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7Be advised, we have not, I repeat, we have not spotted Makarov, and no one else has left the house. Those trucks may have been decoys. Over.
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7注意，我們沒有，重複，沒有發現馬卡洛夫，也沒有人再離開屋子。那些卡車可能是誘餌。完畢。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roger that, we're advancing on the house now!
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7That's all there is to it. You want your targets to go down? You gotta aim down your sights.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7就是這樣。想擊倒目標，就得舉槍瞄準。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Team, we got contacts to the north.
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Russian paratrooper coming down at our 12 o'clock!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7十二點鐘方向有俄軍傘兵降落！

entries.source: ^2Scarecrow: ^7I've got this area covered Roach. Get upstairs and check the rooms on the top floor.
entries.target: ^2稻草人：^7小強，我掩護這裡。上樓檢查頂樓的房間。

entries.source: ^2Scarecrow: ^7No one's leaving through the front of the basement.
entries.target: ^2稻草人：^7沒人從地下室前方離開。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach, go with Scarecrow and check the basement for enemy activity. Breach and clear. Go.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強，跟稻草人去地下室搜索敵人。破門清剿。快。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Ozone, make sure no one leaves through the kitchen.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7臭氧，確保沒人從廚房逃走。
^2幽靈：^7全部安全。全隊，到我這裡集合。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Copy that. Ghost, have your team collect everything you can for an operations playbook. Names, contacts, places, everything.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7收到。幽靈，讓你的小隊蒐集所有能用來擬定行動計畫的資料。姓名、聯絡人、地點，什麼都要。
^2普萊斯：^7他們會因此記住我們。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7We're already on it sir. Makarov will have nowhere to run.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7我們已經在做了，長官。馬卡洛夫將無處可逃。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7That's the idea. I'm bringing up the extraction force, E.T.A. five minutes. Get that intel. Shepherd out.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7就是要這樣。我正帶撤離部隊過去，預計五分鐘抵達。取得情報。謝菲爾德將軍通話完畢。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到！跟緊他！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach, get on Makarov's computer and start the transfer.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強，操作馬卡洛夫的電腦，開始傳輸。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Ghost, we've hit a security door, get it open!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7幽靈，遇到安全門了，把它打開！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach, tap into Makarov's network and start the transfer.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強，接入馬卡洛夫的網路，開始傳輸。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach - connect the DSM to Makarov's network.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強，把 DSM 接上馬卡洛夫的網路。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Ozone, you're on rear security. I've got the front. Go.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7臭氧，你負責後方警戒。我守前面。快。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach, we're not leaving without those files. Start the transfer.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強，沒拿到那些檔案就不能走。開始傳輸。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Task Force, this is Price. More of Makarov's men just arrived at the boneyard...
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7特遣隊，這裡是普萊斯。飛機墳場又來了一批馬卡洛夫的人……
^2弓箭手：^7最多還有六十秒，完畢。
^2霸王：^7獵人二一，空對地飛彈無法使用。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Makarov's men are going to do whatever it takes to keep us from leaving with this intel. We need to protect the DSM until the transfer's done.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7馬卡洛夫的人會不惜一切阻止我們帶走情報。我們必須保護 DSM，直到傳輸完成。
^2弓箭手：^7敵方直升機十五秒後抵達。

entries.source: ^2Ozone: ^7Roach, there's an armory in the basement. Better stock up while you can.
entries.target: ^2臭氧：^7小強，地下室有武器庫。趁現在補足彈藥。

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7Enemy fast-attack choppers coming in from the northwest.
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7敵方快速攻擊直升機從西北方逼近。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Hostiles on the second floor! Take them out!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7二樓有敵人！幹掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roger that. Enemy helos approaching from the northwest.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7收到。敵方直升機從西北方逼近。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7They're moving in through the solar panels east of the house!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7他們正穿過屋子東面的太陽能板區！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Roger that. Everyone check your weapons and ammo. They'll be back.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7收到。所有人檢查武器和彈藥，他們還會再來。

entries.source: ^2Scarecrow: ^7Roger, I'll try to cut 'em off as they come through the trees.
entries.target: ^2稻草人：^7收到，我會試著在他們穿過樹林時攔下他們。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Use your claymores if you have 'em. Plant 'em around the trail east of the house.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7有闊刀地雷就用。在屋子東面的步道旁布設。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7They must be by the boathouse! Cover the west approach!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7他們一定在船屋附近！掩護西側入口！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7There's the chopper! Get ready to jump!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7直升機在那裡！準備跳！

entries.source: ^2Ozone: ^7We got 240s and RPGs at the dining room window, plus L86 machine guns.
entries.target: ^2臭氧：^7餐廳窗邊有 M240 和 RPG，還有 L86 機槍。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach! Stay the close to the house!
^2Ghost: ^7Roger that, use 'em to cut 'em down as they come outta the treeline!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7收到，等他們走出樹林，就用那些武器掃倒他們！

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7You have hostiles approaching from the boathouse to the west, over.
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7敵人正從西面的船屋逼近，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Fifty-fifty chance to take out Makarov, eh?
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7幹掉馬卡洛夫的機會，一半一半，是吧？
^2弓箭手：^7北面有 RPG 小隊！

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7RPG team moving in from the northeast!
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7RPG 小隊正從東北面逼近！

entries.source: ^2Scarecrow: ^7Squad! RPG team moving in from the northeast!
entries.target: ^2稻草人：^7全隊！RPG 小隊正從東北面逼近！

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7Hey isn't this danger close for the task force?
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7這樣對特遣隊來說，不是太靠近友軍了嗎？

entries.source: ^2Ozone: ^7Roger that, RPG team moving in from the east!
entries.target: ^2臭氧：^7收到，RPG 小隊正從東面逼近！
^2弓箭手：^7東南面有 RPG 小隊！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Copy that, RPG team to the southeast!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7收到，東南面有 RPG 小隊！

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7RPG team moving in from the south!
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7RPG 小隊正從南面逼近！

entries.source: ^2Scarecrow: ^7Copy, RPG team moving in from the south!
entries.target: ^2稻草人：^7收到，RPG 小隊正從南面逼近！

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7RPG team moving in from the southwest!
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7RPG 小隊正從西南面逼近！

entries.source: ^2Ozone: ^7Got it! RPG team moving in from the southwest!
entries.target: ^2臭氧：^7收到！RPG 小隊正從西南面逼近！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Squad! We got an RPG team to the northwest!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7全隊！西北面有 RPG 小隊！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach, pull back to the safehouse! They're trying to stop the transfer!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強，撤回安全屋！他們想阻止傳輸！

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7Be advised, you have a large concentration of hostiles moving in from the southeast, they just breached the perimeter!
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7注意，大批敵人從東南面逼近，剛剛突破了防線！

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7I'll try to thin 'em out before they get too close. Recommend you switch to scoped weapons, over.
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7我會在他們靠近前削減人數。建議換用配備瞄準鏡的武器，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Ozone: ^7I got eyes on! Here they come! They're in the field to the the southeast!
entries.target: ^2臭氧：^7我看到了！他們來了！在東南面的空地！

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7Scarecrow is down, I repeat Scarecrow is down!
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7稻草人倒下了，重複，稻草人倒下了！

entries.source: ^2Scarecrow: ^7Be advised, they're moving inside the house! Need assistance!
entries.target: ^2稻草人：^7注意，他們進屋了！需要支援！

entries.source: ^2Scarecrow: ^7They're inside the house! I need some help over here!
entries.target: ^2稻草人：^7他們進屋了！我這裡需要支援！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Pick up a smoke grenade at the supply drop!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7去空投補給拿煙霧彈！

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7Hostiles have closed to within fifty meters of the house! They're inside!
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7敵人已逼近屋子五十公尺內！他們進去了！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Copy that! Everyone pull back and protect the DSM!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7收到！全員撤回，保護 DSM！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Charges planted. They're in for a surprise when they find these bodies.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7炸藥已安裝。他們找到屍體時，一定大吃一驚。

entries.source: ^2Archer: ^7Enemy troops sighted, moving through the forest, north of the house.
entries.target: ^2弓箭手：^7發現敵軍，正穿過屋子北面的樹林。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, if you have an RPG, keep firing! We gotta take it down!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，有 RPG 的繼續射擊！一定要打下來！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roger that. Roach, put down some claymores on the driveway leading up to the house! Go!
