entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7收到。小強，在通往屋子的車道上布設闊刀地雷！快！

entries.source: Speed your snowmobile down the mountain, dodging trees, rocks and thousand foot drops.
entries.target: 駕駛雪地摩托車高速下山，閃避樹木、岩石與千呎深谷。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach, the transfer's complete! I'll cover the main approach while you get the DSM! Move!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強，傳輸完成！我掩護正面入口，你去拿 DSM！快！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach! I'm covering the front! Get the DSM! We gotta get outta here!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7小強！我掩護前面！拿上 DSM！我們得離開這裡！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7They're bracketing our position with mortars, keep moving but watch your back!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7他們正用迫擊砲夾射我們的位置，繼續前進，注意後方！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7We've got a civil war in Russia, government loyalists against Ultranationalist rebels, and 15000 nukes at stake.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7俄國爆發內戰，政府忠誠派對抗極端民族主義叛軍，一萬五千枚核彈危在旦夕。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roach, I got you covered! Go! Go!
^2Ghost: ^7Get up! Get up! We're almost there!

entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7你們拿到 DSM 了嗎？
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7很好。又少了個需要清理的尾巴。

entries.source: ^2Soap: ^7Price! We gotta split up or we're dead!
entries.target: ^2肥皂：^7普萊斯！我們得分頭走，否則死定了！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Copy that! Roach, we're on cell duty! Follow me!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到！小強，我們負責搜牢房！跟我來！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Negative. They've stopped twice already - no sign of him.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7沒有。他們已停了兩次，還沒看見他。

entries.source: ^2TF-141 Soldier: ^7Last floor clear. We'll link up with you at the bottom.
entries.target: ^2一四一特遣隊隊員：^7最後一層安全，我們在底層會合。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Non-lethal takedowns only! We need him alive!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7只能非致命制伏！我們要活的！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach - take the shot! Go for his leg!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，開槍！射他的腿！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, this is going to take some time. Go with Meat and Royce and check out the favela for any sign of Rojas - that's where this guy was headed.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，這會花點時間。跟米特和羅伊斯去貧民窟找羅哈斯的線索，他的手下就是往那裡走。
^2羅伊斯：^7米特，把這些平民帶走。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Too damn slow. You need to run it again, Private.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7太慢了。你得重跑，二等兵。

entries.source: ^2Royce: ^7Bravo Six, be advised - we've engaged enemy militia at the lower village!
entries.target: ^2羅伊斯：^7B 六號，注意，我們已在下方村落與敵方民兵交戰！

entries.source: ^2Royce: ^7Roach! I'm with you! Watch the rooftops! Go!
entries.target: ^2羅伊斯：^7小強！我跟著你！注意屋頂！走！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7羅伊斯，回報狀況，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Royce: ^7Lots of militia but no sign of Rojas over here, over!
entries.target: ^2羅伊斯：^7這裡民兵很多，但沒見到羅哈斯！完畢！

entries.source: ^2Royce: ^7Bravo Six, Roach is down. I'm going to have to finish this alone!
entries.target: ^2羅伊斯：^7B 六號，小強倒下了。我得獨自完成任務！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach come in! Roach do you copy?! Roach!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，回答！小強，收到嗎？小強！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We lost Roach! Rojas is gonna get away!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我們失去小強了！羅哈斯要逃了！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach - we've got Rojas' location! He's headed west along the upper levels of the favela.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，已掌握羅哈斯的位置！他正沿貧民窟上層往西走。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7There's no time for backup. You're gonna have to do this on your own. Good luck. Out.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7沒時間等支援了，你只能靠自己。祝你好運。通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, watch the rooftops! We've had a few close calls with RPGs and machine guns positioned up high!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，注意屋頂！上面有 RPG 和機槍，剛才差點被打中！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, we're taking heavy fire from militia here but I'm still tracking Rojas! He's gone into a building! Ghost, you see him?
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，這裡民兵火力很猛，但我還跟著羅哈斯！他進了一棟樓！幽靈，看到他嗎？

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Roger that, he's climbing onto a roof carrying a black duffel bag!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7收到。他帶著黑色旅行袋，正爬上屋頂！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7I've got a visual on Rojas! He's cutting through the market!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7看到羅哈斯了！他正穿過市場！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! He's jumped another fence and he's still headed towards your end of the favela! Keep moving up! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！他又跳過一道圍欄，仍往你那頭跑！繼續往上！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Be advised, I'm about half a klick east of the market, I can see Rojas running across the rooftops on my right side!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7注意，我在市場以東約五百公尺，看見羅哈斯在我右邊的屋頂上跑！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Sir, I've got Rojas in my sights! We can go for a clean leg shot! We can end it here!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7長官，羅哈斯在我的瞄準鏡裡！能準確射中他的腿，現在就能結束！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7檢查轉角！快！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Keep going! Rojas is still headed towards your side of the favela!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7繼續前進！羅哈斯還往你那邊跑！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! Keep moving uphill! I've cut him off! He's got nowhere to go but west over the rooftops into your area!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！繼續上坡！我截住他了，他只能向西穿過屋頂，逃到你那區！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7He jumped the fence! I'm after him!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7他跳過圍欄了！我追上去！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Negative! Not unless you want to carry him back out with all this militia breathing down your neck! I need him unharmed!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7不行！除非你想背著他撤離，後面還跟著整群民兵！我要他毫髮無傷！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Hold your fire! Don't engage that BTR - they haven't acquired us!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7停火！別攻擊那輛 BTR，他們還沒發現我們！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roger that! Roach! We're corraling him closer to your side of the hill! Keep an eye open for Rojas! He's still making his way across the rooftops!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到！小強！我們正把他趕向你那邊的山坡！留意羅哈斯，他還在屋頂上跑！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, we're going to cut him off at the summit, keep pushing him that way! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，我們會在頂端截住他！繼續把他往那裡趕！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Oil workers are human shields, so we can't just blow up the rigs wholesale.  And this one is the least defended.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7石油工人被當成人肉盾牌，我們不能直接炸毀整座鑽油平台。這座的防守最薄弱。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! He's getting closer to your part of the favela! Keep moving! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！他越來越靠近你那區了！繼續前進！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Have to trust someone to be betrayed.  I never did.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7只有信任過，才會遭到背叛。我從來沒有信任過他。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Alright, I've seen worse. You've got a few rough edges though.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7好，我見過更差的。不過你還有些地方得磨練。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Ghost he's going for that motorcycle!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7幽靈，他衝向那輛摩托車了！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Check the roof of Nate's restaurant! I saw some Stingers up there!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7檢查奈特餐廳屋頂！我看到上面有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, keep pushing him up the hill! Don't let him double back!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，繼續把他往山坡上趕！別讓他往回跑！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7幽靈，我從最右邊繞！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Frontrunner, this is Bravo Six. We've got the package. I repeat we have got the package.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7領跑者，這裡是 B 六號。我們已取得包裹。重複，已取得包裹。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Command, ready for dustoff. Send the chopper. Coordinates to fol-
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7指揮部，準備撤離。派直升機來，座標如下……

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Nikolai! We're at the top of the favela surrounded by militia! Bring the chopper to the market, do you copy, over!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7尼古萊！我們在貧民窟頂端，被民兵包圍！把直升機開到市場！收到嗎？完畢！

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Ok my friend, I am on the way!
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7好的，朋友，我正在趕來！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Militia comin' out of the shack on the left!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7民兵正從左邊棚屋出來！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Head through that gate! Keep pushing to the evac point!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7穿過那道門！繼續向撤離點推進！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Contact! Foot-mobiles on the rooftops, closing in fast from the south!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7接敵！屋頂有步兵，正從南方快速逼近！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7More skinnies on the rooftops at 12 o'clock!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7十二點鐘方向的屋頂上又有民兵！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Rooftops on our left! Shift fire!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7左邊屋頂！轉移火力！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7東邊有 RPG！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7RPGs on the rooftops to the south!
^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Tangos moving in low from the southeast!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7敵人正從東南方的低處逼近！
^2幽靈：^7武裝皮卡正從南方過來！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We got another technical! Take it out!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7又有一輛武裝皮卡！摧毀它！

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7The market is not far from where you are, but I see many milita moving towards you.
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7市場離你們不遠，但我看到大批民兵正朝你們過去。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Let's go, let's go!  We've gotta push through these streets to the market!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7快！快！穿過這些街道，前往市場！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Heads up! Alley on the left!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7注意！左邊巷子！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Squad! Spread out and cut through the market! Move!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小隊！分散，穿過市場！快！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Contacts above us at 11 o'clock, firing blind!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7十一點鐘上方有敵人，正在盲射！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Tango coming out of the shack on the right!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7敵人正從右邊棚屋出來！

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7That may not be fast enough! I see more militia closing in on the market!
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7恐怕還不夠快！更多民兵正逼近市場！

entries.source:
You ran out of time.
Keep an eye on the clock.
entries.target:
時間已到。
留意計時器。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Pick up the pace! Let's go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7加快腳步！走！

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7It's too hot! We will not survive this landing!
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7火力太猛！這樣降落，我們活不了！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Nikolai, wave off, wave off! We'll meet you at the secondary LZ instead! Go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7尼古萊，取消降落！取消降落！改到第二降落區會合！快！

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Very well, I will meet you there! Good luck!
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7好，我會到那裡接你們！祝好運！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Come on! We've got to get to the rooftops, this way!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7快！我們得上屋頂！這邊！

entries.source: ^2Hunter 2-3: ^7Hunter 2-1 this is Hunter 2-3, thanks for the assist! We're leaving on Hunter Three's humvee, over!
entries.target: ^2獵人二三：^7獵人二一，這裡是獵人二三。謝謝支援！我們正搭獵人三號的悍馬撤離，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! Get over here and climb up to the rooftops!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！過來這裡，爬上屋頂！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! You can climb up over here!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！可以從這裡爬上來！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Tell me something I don't know! Just get ready to pick us up!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7說點我不知道的！準備接我們就對了！

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Ok, I will pick you up soon, keep going!
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7好，我很快就來接你們！繼續前進！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We can make it! Go go go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7能跳過去！快！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, we're circling the area but I can't see you! You've got to get to the rooftops!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，我們正在附近盤旋，但看不到你！你得上屋頂！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, we're running low on fuel! Where the hell are you?!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，我們快沒油了！你到底在哪？

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Run for it! Get to the rooftops!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7快跑！上屋頂！
^2麥克塔維什：^7小強，還磨蹭什麼？快！

entries.source: ^2MacTavish: ^7We've got to get out of here, Roach, come on!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什：^7小強，我們得離開這裡！快！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach! I see you! Jump down to the rooftops and meet us south of your position! Go!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強！看到你了！跳到下面屋頂，在你南邊與我們會合！快！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Bloody hell, they've locked it from the hard line. I'll have to run a bypass.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7該死，他們用實體線路鎖住了。得繞過它。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Keep moving forward! Don't turn back! Slow down and you're dead!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7繼續前進！別回頭！慢下來就沒命了！

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Gas is very low! I must leave in thirty seconds!
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7油快沒了！三十秒後我必須離開！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Left! Turn left and jump down!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7左邊！左轉，跳下去！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Nikolai! We got him! Get us outta here!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7尼古萊！接到他了！帶我們離開！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7The Russians ain't gonna let this massacre go unanswered. It's gonna get bloody.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7俄國人不會對這場屠殺善罷甘休。將會血流成河。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7All snipers this is MacTavish, standby to engage.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7所有狙擊手，我是麥克塔維什，準備交戰。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7所有狙擊手，可以交戰。
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7很適合你的臥底任務。

entries.source: ^2SecDef: ^7Whatever you need, General.  You've got a blank check.
entries.target: ^2國防部長：^7將軍，你需要什麼儘管開口。經費沒有上限。
^2幽靈：^7好，沿著那條隧道繼續走。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Bloody Yanks...I thought they were the good guys!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7該死的美國佬……我還以為他們是好人！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Ghost cut the chatter. Stay frosty.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7幽靈，少說廢話。保持警戒。

entries.source: ^2NORAD HQ: ^7All stations, be advised - satellite surveillance has been disabled. SOSUS and Pave Paws arrays are inoperative at this time.
entries.target: ^2北美防空司令部：^7各單位注意，衛星監控已中斷。SOSUS 聲納監視系統與鋪路爪雷達陣列目前無法運作。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7There's the patrol. Hold your fire until they're closer.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7巡邏隊到了。等他們再靠近一點才開火。

entries.source: Traitor. You have abandoned the mission.
^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7There's too many of 'em! Back up! Back up!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7他們太多了！後退！後退！

entries.source: ^2Hornet Two-One: ^7Two-One is in position for gun run.
entries.target: ^2大黃蜂二一：^7二一已就位，準備機砲掃射。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Copy Two-One, lasing target on the second floor!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7二一，收到。正在標定二樓目標！

entries.source: ^2Hornet Two-One: ^7Two-One copies, got a tally on six tangos, inbound hot.
entries.target: ^2大黃蜂二一：^7二一收到，看到六個敵人，準備攻擊。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7The entrance is up ahead, keep moving!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7入口就在前面，繼續前進！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Not good enough, Allen. You took too long and killed too many civilies. Go again.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7不夠好，艾倫。你花太久，又打死太多平民。再來。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7All right, I'm patched in. I'm tracking your progress on the security cameras.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7好，已接入系統。我會用監視器追蹤你們的進度。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Copy that! Do you have the location of Prisoner 627?
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到！找到六二七號囚犯的位置了嗎？

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Negative, but I've got a searchlight tracking hostiles on your floor. That should make your job easier.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7還沒，但已用探照燈追蹤你們樓層的敵人，應該會容易些。
^2幽靈：^7正在處理……這些設備太老舊了！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Ghost, you opened the wrong door!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7幽靈，你開錯門了！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Talk to me Ghost...these cells are deserted!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7幽靈，回報！這些牢房都是空的！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roger that! Squad, head for that armory down there! Move!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到！小隊，前往下面的軍械庫！快！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7有看到喜歡的嗎？

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Bad news mate. I'm tracking three, no, four hostile squads converging on your position!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7老兄，壞消息。三……不，四支敵方小隊正包圍你們！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I can hear them coming...let's go! We're too exposed!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7聽到他們來了……快！我們太暴露了！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Use it to to dispatch that chopper! I'll cover you! Go!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7用它擊落那架直升機！我掩護你！快！

entries.source: ^2MacTavish: ^7We've got one good UMP.  They've got a thousand.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什：^7我們只有一把能用的 UMP。他們有上千把。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach, pick up one of those riot shields!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，拿一面防暴盾！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Almost there! Routing through the auxiliary circuit...
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7快好了！正在改接輔助電路……
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7有客人來了！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7I'm working on it... The main circuit's dead! Standby!
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7正在處理……主電路壞了！稍候！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Use your riot shield to draw their fire!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7用防暴盾吸引他們的火力！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I'll draw their fire with the riot shield, you take 'em out!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我用防暴盾吸引火力，你來幹掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Ghost here. Recommend you bypass the lower floors by rappelling out that window.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7我是幽靈。建議從窗戶垂降，避開下方樓層。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到！小強，跟我來！
^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，跟緊我們！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Get C4 on those bodies ASAP. We don't have much time.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7儘快在屍體上安裝 C4，時間不多了。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7檢查牢房裡有沒有殘敵。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Shepherd, what the hell was that? Get the Navy to cease fire!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7謝菲爾德將軍，剛才到底怎麼回事？讓海軍停火！

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Bravo Six - they've agreed to stop firing for now. Keep going, I'll keep you posted. Out.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7B 六號，他們同意暫時停火。繼續前進，有消息會通知你們。通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Backup power is online. We're opening the gate at Junction A-12 – head down the stairs and into the service tunnels.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7備用電源已上線。正在打開 A-12 交會點的門，下樓進維修隧道。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roach - forget that door! Plant the breaching charge on the wall, we're taking a shortcut!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7小強，別管那道門！把破門炸藥裝在牆上，走捷徑！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7利用置物櫃掩護！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Cook your grenades to detonate behind them!
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7延遲投擲手榴彈，讓它在他們後面爆炸！

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7I'm detecting two heat signatures - one of them should be Prisoner 627.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7偵測到兩個熱源，其中一個應該是六二七號囚犯。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Breach the northwest wall and you should have enough time to kill the guard before he recovers.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7炸開西北側的牆，應該來得及在守衛回神前幹掉他。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Clear the first area. Go! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7清空第一區。快！快！快！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7有客人來了！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We've got to set up an ambush. Get to an elevated position and wait.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7得設好伏擊。到高處等待。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7C'mon, since when does Shepherd care about danger close?
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拜託，謝菲爾德將軍什麼時候在乎過友軍距離？
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7長官，這是你的。

entries.source: ^2Pave Low Pilot: ^7Bravo Six, there's too much smoke, I can't see you I can't see you -
entries.target: ^2鋪路低空直升機駕駛員：^7B 六號，煙太濃，看不到你們！看不到……

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Whatever you're gonna do Soap, do it fast!
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7肥皂，不管你要做什麼，快一點！

entries.source: ^2Pave Low Pilot: ^7Bravo Six, I see your flare. SPIE rig on the way.
entries.target: ^2鋪路低空直升機駕駛員：^7B 六號，看到信號彈了。正在放下 SPIE 吊掛繩索。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Team, this way! Let's go let's go!
^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1, all air support is already engaged.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，所有空中支援都已投入交戰。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Additional ground support is en route to your position but has encountered heavy resistance, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7額外地面支援正在趕往你們的位置，但遭到猛烈抵抗，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Be advised, we have encountered enemy armor and are proceeding on foot, over.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7注意，我們遭遇敵方裝甲車，正改以步行前進，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Hang right and stay behind it!
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7We're spotted! Ramirez - use your smoke grenades! Dunn, Morgan - cover him!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7我們被發現了！拉米雷茲，用煙霧彈！鄧恩、摩根，掩護他！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez - there's smoke grenades at that supply drop! Move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，空投補給有煙霧彈！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Team, get some smoke on that BTR! Move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，向那輛 BTR 扔煙霧彈！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez get more smoke grenades from the supply drop!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，去空投補給拿更多煙霧彈！
^2佛利中士：^7來襲！十二點鐘方向有卡車！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Team, don't engage that BTR - our objective is the crash site.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，別攻擊那輛 BTR。我們的目標是墜機地點。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Get back from that BTR!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！離那輛 BTR 遠一點！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7The crash site is on the north side of Nate's restaurant.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7墜機地點在奈特餐廳北側。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Nice work! That heli is down.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7幹得好！直升機被擊落了。

entries.source: ^2Pvt. Wells: ^7We moved him to the meat locker, it's practically bulletproof!
entries.target: ^2威爾斯二等兵：^7我們把他移進肉品冷藏室了，那裡幾乎能防彈！

entries.source: ^2Pvt. Wells: ^7He's still unconscious, you got a medic?
entries.target: ^2威爾斯二等兵：^7還昏迷著，你們有醫護兵嗎？

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7What about anti-tank weapons, air support?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7反戰車武器呢？空中支援呢？

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, use the ladder in the kitchen and get to the roof.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，從廚房的梯子上屋頂。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Heads up ladies, we got trucks to the south.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7各位小姐，注意！南邊有卡車。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, this is Hunter 2-1 Actual. Switch to thermal optics if you got 'em.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，這裡是獵人二一指揮官。有熱影像瞄準鏡就切換過去。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7We should just beat it out of him sir.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7長官，乾脆把他打到招供吧。
^2佛利中士：^7小隊，將火力轉向北方。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Tangos on the roof behind us!
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Contact! Hostiles on the roof! Inside our perimeter!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7接敵！屋頂有敵人！他們進了我們的防線！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad! Hostiles on the roof! Turn around!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊！屋頂有敵人！轉身！
^2佛利中士：^7看來俄軍吃夠苦頭了。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Corporal Dunn, give me a sitrep on Raptor, over.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7鄧恩下士，回報猛禽的狀況，完畢。
^2鄧恩下士：^7猛禽安全，狀況穩定。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Nice work team. Regroup over here.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，幹得好。到這裡會合。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Get the ... off the roof!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！快給我離開屋頂！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Get down off the roof now!

entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7二一 D，收到。請講！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Get over there, and kill that SOB!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！過去幹掉那混蛋！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Move! This is a timed course!
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Two-One-Delta, be advised, two BTRs coming in from the north.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7二一 D，注意，兩輛 BTR 正從北方過來。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Get down! One of the BTRs has a visual on you!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7趴下！一輛 BTR 看到你了！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Everyone get to your vehicles! We're moving out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7所有人上車！我們要出發了！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad! Take out that gunship before the convoy arrives! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊！在車隊抵達前擊落武裝直升機！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7All right the BTR's lost you! Go go go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7好，BTR 看不到你了！快！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez - I got you covered! Pick up the control rig!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲，我掩護你！拿起控制器！
^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！攻擊那些 BTR！現在！
^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，摧毀敵方裝甲車。
^2佛利中士：^7現在就摧毀那輛 BTR！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Take your team and secure the Burger Town! We're gonna move Raptor over there! This location has been compromised!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！帶隊控制漢堡鎮！我們要把猛禽移過去，這裡已經暴露！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Corporal Dunn, get on the roof of Burger Town and provide overwatch! Ramirez, regroup on me! We gotta move the VIP!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7鄧恩下士，到漢堡鎮屋頂提供掩護！拉米雷茲，與我會合！我們得轉移重要人物！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! Corporal Dunn's got the roof covered! We need you back here! Move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！鄧恩下士已守住屋頂！我們需要你回來！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, we need to move Raptor now! Clear that restaurant!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，現在就得轉移猛禽！肅清那間餐廳！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, be advised, we're gonna move Raptor from Nate's to the Burger Town as a group!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊注意，我們要一起把猛禽從奈特餐廳移到漢堡鎮！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, I've made it to the Burger Town meat locker. Raptor is inside and secure.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，我已到漢堡鎮冷藏室。猛禽在裡面，安全。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez, use the remote controlled Predator Missiles! We got incoming infantry! Keep them away from Burgertown!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，用遙控掠奪者飛彈！敵方步兵來了！別讓他們接近漢堡鎮！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez use your remote control rig and launch some Predator Missiles at the enemy armor!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲，用遙控器朝敵方裝甲車發射掠奪者飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1, be advised, fifteen-plus enemy foot-mobiles approaching north of your location, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，注意，十五名以上敵方步兵正從你們北邊逼近，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1, Goliath One has a visual on a hostile patrol coming from the southeast, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，巨人一號看到敵方巡邏隊正從東南方逼近，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1 this is Overlord Actual, we're seeing a large group of enemy reinforcements to your north, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，這裡是霸王指揮官。看到你們北邊有大批敵方援軍，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1, Hunter Four has a visual on a hostile group near the Nova gas station, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，獵人四號在諾瓦加油站附近看到一群敵人，完畢。
^2霸王：^7獵人二一，空對地飛彈已就緒。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez! There's some Stingers by the supply drop on the roof of Nate's!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲！奈特餐廳屋頂的空投補給旁有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Price, you been locked away too long. Better get your mind right, son.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7普萊斯，你被關太久了。小子，最好先把腦子理清楚。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Ten plus KIAs. Good hit. Good hit.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7敵人陣亡十名以上。命中，命中。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Five plus confirmed kills. Nice work. Hunter two one.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7確認擊斃五名以上。獵人二一，幹得好。
^2霸王：^7命中。敵人陣亡五名以上。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Good kills hunter two one. Good kills.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，打得漂亮，打得漂亮。
^2遊騎兵：^7有人剛摧毀我們的掠奪者！

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Get to an elevated position. We'll ambush them when they come to investigate.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7到高處，等他們來調查再伏擊。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1, relay from Goliath One: you got an enemy helicopter loaded for bear, approaching your area, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，轉達巨人一號：一架全副武裝的敵方直升機正接近你們，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, launch RPGs at the gunship! Take it out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，用 RPG 攻擊武裝直升機！擊落它！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Solid copy Overlord. Team! Take down that helicopter! Go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7收到，霸王。小隊！擊落直升機！快！

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1, be advised, enemy helo approaching your sector. CAP is unavailable at this time, good luck, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，注意，敵方直升機正接近你們。目前無法提供空中巡邏支援，祝好運，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Use 'em to take down that sonofabitch! Go!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7用它們幹掉那混蛋！快！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez! There's Stingers on the roof of Nate's restaurant!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲！奈特餐廳屋頂有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Use 'em to kill that helo! Go! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7用它們擊落直升機！快！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez! Check the roof of Nate's restaurant! I saw some Stingers up there!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲！檢查奈特餐廳屋頂！我看到上面有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ramirez! I saw a Stinger missile in that diner to the west!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拉米雷茲！西邊的小餐館有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7There's a Stinger missile in that stockpile to the west!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7西邊那堆補給裡有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7I saw a Stinger missile in the diner where we got the UAV control rig!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7拿無人機控制器的那間小餐館有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Team! I saw a couple Stingers on the roof of Nate's!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊！奈特餐廳屋頂有幾具刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Use 'em to kill that helo! Go! Go! Go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7用它們擊落直升機！快！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad! There's some Stingers by the supply drop on the roof of Nate's!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊！奈特餐廳屋頂的空投補給旁有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Team! I saw a Stinger missile in that diner to the west!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊！西邊的小餐館有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7There's a Stinger missile in that stockpile to the west!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7西邊那堆補給裡有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7It's inside the diner! I got ya covered! Move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7就在小餐館裡！我掩護你！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7No offense, but I see a lot of you guys firing from the hip and spraying bullets all over the range.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7別介意，但我看到你們很多人都在腰射，把子彈灑得滿靶場都是。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7I saw a Stinger missile in the diner where we got the Predator Drone control rig!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拿掠奪者無人機控制器的那間小餐館有刺針飛彈！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7The convoy's here! Everyone on me! We're getting the hell outta here! Let's go, let's go!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7車隊到了！所有人跟我來！我們要撤出這鬼地方！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Ramirez! The convoy is just to the south of Burger Town, get your ass over here! Move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7拉米雷茲！車隊就在漢堡鎮南邊！快給我過來！快！
^2霸王：^7霸王全部收到。幹得好，通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Squad, we still got 2,000 civvies in Arcadia! If you got family there it's your lucky day - we're gonna go save their lives!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7小隊，阿卡迪亞還有兩千名平民！家人在那裡的，今天走運了。我們要去救他們！

entries.source: ^2NORAD HQ: ^7Sierra Delta gimme a sitrep, over.
entries.target: ^2北美航太防衛司令部：^7S-D，報告狀況，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7In position. Let's take them out together. On your go.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7已就位，一起幹掉他們。等你的信號。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We'll take them both out...on your go.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7一起幹掉這兩個，等你的信號。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Two hostiles down in section One-Alpha. Moving up to section Two.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7一 A 區兩名敵人已倒下。正前往第二區。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Allen, what are you shooting at, there's nothing there! Cease fire!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7艾倫，你在射什麼？那裡根本沒人！停火！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Come on, Allen. Get with the program. Pick up that weapon and fire at the targets behind you
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7快點，艾倫，跟上進度。拿起武器，射擊你後面的靶子。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7各位，跟緊一點。

entries.source:
Clear the course.
Clear in 45 seconds.
Clear in 35 Seconds.
entries.target:
完成訓練。
四十五秒內完成。
三十五秒內完成。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Free to engage. Suppressed weapons only.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7可以交戰。只准使用裝有消音器的武器。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roger that. Team One moving to breach.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到。第一小隊正前往破門。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Get a frame charge on the door. We'll hit the room from both sides.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7在門上安裝框架炸藥，我們從兩側突入房間。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Check your targets. We've got civilians here.
AC-130 gunships, snowmobile races, and Vulcan miniguns with explosive ammo.  Something for everyone.
entries.target: AC-130 砲艇機、雪地摩托車競速，以及裝填爆炸彈藥的火神迷你砲。人人都有適合的挑戰。

entries.source: Race through the Favela marketplace defusing the explosives before its too late.
entries.target: 衝過貧民窟市場，趕在時間耗盡前拆除炸藥。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7二 E 區的人質已獲救。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7二 E 區的目標已安全。

entries.source: ^2TF-141 Soldier: ^7Roach, get moving topside, this area is secure.
entries.target: ^2一四一特遣隊隊員：^7小強，去上層，這區已安全。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Ok, move upstairs. Control - we're advancing to Deck Two.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7好，上樓。指揮中心，我們正前往第二層甲板。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Split up. We can flank through these hallways.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7分頭走，能從這些走廊包抄。

entries.source: ^2Sub Commander: ^7Enemy helo patroling the perimeter. Keep a low profile, Hotel Six.
entries.target: ^2潛艦指揮官：^7敵方直升機正在周邊巡邏。H 六號，保持隱蔽。

entries.source: Eliminate Ghillie Snipers, Elite Mercenaries and Juggernauts guarding the estate.
entries.target: 消滅守衛莊園的吉利服狙擊手、精銳傭兵和重裝兵。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7全部安全，前進。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我們暴露了。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我們被發現了。

entries.source: ^2Sub Commander: ^7Hotel Six, more hostages are at your position.
entries.target: ^2潛艦指揮官：^7H 六號，你們的位置還有人質。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Control - all Deck Two hostages secured.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7指揮中心，第二層甲板的所有人質已獲救。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Set up for plan B. Get some C4 on those bodies, go.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7準備 B 計畫，在屍體上裝 C4。快。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Copy that, we're working on it. Out.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到，正在處理。通話完畢。
^2幽靈：^7十二點鐘方向有攻擊直升機！找掩護！
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7散開，包抄他們。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Find some heavy ordinance to take down that bird.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7找重武器，把那架直升機打下來。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7That helo is pinning us down. Take it out with some rockets
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7直升機壓制了我們，用火箭把它打下來。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Take out that helo, use your heavy weapons.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7用重武器擊落直升機。
^2幽靈：^7敵方直升機墜落，打得好。

entries.source: ^2Sub Commander: ^7Hotel Six, hostages from lower decks are being extracted by Team 2. Proceed to the top deck ASAP to secure the rest, over.
entries.target: ^2潛艦指揮官：^7H 六號，第二小隊正在撤出下層人質。儘快前往頂層，營救其餘人質，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Roger that. Will call in for exfil at LZ Bravo.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到，會在 B 降落區呼叫撤離。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7CentCom needs us to take the top deck ASAP so they can send in the Marines. Move.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7中央司令部要求儘快控制頂層，才能派陸戰隊進來。前進。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7The clock's ticking. We need to get topside and secure any remaining hostages before we call in the Marines.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7時間不多了。得先到頂層營救剩餘人質，再呼叫陸戰隊。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Put some fire on those fuel storage tanks.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7向那些儲油罐開火。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7These guys have thermal optics. Stay clear of the smoke.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7他們有熱影像瞄準鏡，遠離煙霧。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Enemies are using thermal optics...Switching to thermal scope...
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7敵人使用熱影像瞄準鏡……正在切換熱影像瞄準鏡……

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Copy that. All teams check your fire - we don't know what's behind these doors.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7收到。各小隊小心開火，我們不知道門後有什麼。

entries.source: ^2Sub Commander: ^7Good job, Hotel Six. Marine reinforcements are inserting now to dismantle the SAM sites. Get your team ready for phase two of the operation. Out.
entries.target: ^2潛艦指揮官：^7H 六號，幹得好。陸戰隊援軍正進入現場，拆除地對空飛彈陣地。準備進行第二階段行動。通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Just another day at the office.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7又是平常的一天。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Khaled Al-Asad. Currently the second most powerful man in the Middle East. Word on the street is he's got the minerals to be top dog down there. Intel's keeping an eye on him.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7哈立德．阿薩德，目前中東第二有權勢的人。傳言他有膽量成為當地老大。情報部門正盯著他。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Riiight...what the hell kind of name is Soap eh? How'd a muppet like you pass Selection?
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7好吧……肥皂是什麼鬼名字？像你這樣的傻瓜，怎麼通過選拔的？

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Captain Price, Al-Asad just executed President Al-Fulani on national television.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7普萊斯上尉，阿薩德剛在全國電視直播中處決了富拉尼總統。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7The Americans have plans for Al-Asad, and it's too late to do anything for Al-Fulani. But in less than three hours, codename Nikolai will be executed in Russia.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7美國人自有對付阿薩德的計畫。富拉尼已經救不了，但不到三小時後，代號尼古萊的人就會在俄國被處決。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Nikolai is our informant in the Ultranationalist camp. He supplied the intel on the cargoship operation.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7尼古萊是我們安插在極端民族主義陣營的線人。貨輪行動的情報就是他提供的。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Nikolai's in hell right now. We're gonna walk him out...
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7尼古萊現在身陷地獄。我們要帶他出來……

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7We take care of our friends. Let's move.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7我們會照顧朋友。出發。

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7What do you want? Who are you? Special Forces?
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7你們想要什麼？你們是誰？特種部隊？

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ok, head upstairs and regroup with your team, or you can go back in and run the course again.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7好，上樓和隊伍會合。你也可以回去再跑一次。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7Nikolai - all you all right? Can you walk?
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7尼古萊，你還好嗎？能走嗎？

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Yes...and I can still fight. Thank you for getting me out of here.
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7可以……我還能戰鬥。謝謝你們救我出來。
^2尼古萊：^7美國人已經攻擊阿薩德了嗎？

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Private Allen, you'll be taking orders from me from now on. I'll brief you on the chopper. Let's go.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7艾倫一等兵，從現在起，你直接聽我的命令。我會在直升機上簡報。走吧。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Delta One X-Ray, we have a missile launch, I repeat we have a missile -
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7D 一 X，我們發現飛彈發射，重複，有飛彈——
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7艾倫一等兵，起來！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Hunter 2! Keep up the pressure on those RPG teams! If that bridgelayer gets hit, we're swimming, hooah?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7獵人二號！持續壓制那些 RPG 小組！架橋車要是被打中，我們就得游過去了，明白嗎？

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Russians are using them as SAM sites.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7俄軍把它們當成地對空飛彈陣地。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Drop some rounds on 'em across the river!

entries.target: ^2獵人二三：^7沒有，他們只是在看我們。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Up on the bridge, far side!

entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7他們在撤退，繼續打！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Hunter 2! Bridge complete, we're oscar mike! Move out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7獵人二號！橋架好了，出發！前進！

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Allen - good job on taking out the enemy armor. Now let's get over there and take that town.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7艾倫，敵軍裝甲車打得好。現在過去拿下那座城鎮。

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7Let's go, let's go! Get your ass back in the vehicle.
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7走，走！快給我回車上去。

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7Allen, get in your humvee, you're holding up the line!
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7艾倫，上你的悍馬！你擋住整條隊伍了！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Allen, move your ass, let's go!
Pummel your way through enemy riot shield ambushes.
entries.target: 突破敵方防暴盾部隊的伏擊。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7All Hunter 2 victors, keep an eye out for civvies, we're not cleared to engage unless they fire first.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7獵人二號各車組，留意平民。除非對方先開火，否則不得交戰。
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7誰去把那該死的電視關了。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7I got nothin' dude. This place is dead.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7沒看到任何東西，老兄。這地方死氣沉沉。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Overlord, Hunter 2-1. We're passing tunnel Harvey, cross street Elizabeth.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7霸王，這裡是獵人二一。我們正通過哈維隧道，交叉街道是伊莉莎白街。
^2霸王：^7收到，獵人二一。小心前進。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Alright, stay frosty you guys, this is the Wild West.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7大家保持警戒。這裡可像狂野西部。

entries.source: ^2SecDef: ^7General Shepherd, you warned us. We should've listened.
entries.target: ^2國防部長：^7謝菲爾德將軍，你警告過我們。我們早該聽你的。
^2獵人二三：^7十二點鐘方向的陽台有三名步行人員，可能是民兵。
^2鄧恩下士：^7我打賭他們在探我們的底。

entries.source: ^2Ranger: ^7Eh, but that don't mean we can shoot 'em.
entries.target: ^2遊騎兵：^7但這不表示我們可以開槍。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7All Hunter victors, this is Sergeant Foley. Prepare to engage, we're taking sniper fire from multiple directions.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7獵人各車組，這裡是佛利中士。準備交戰，我們正遭到多個方向的狙擊。
^2鄧恩下士：^7帶我們離開這裡！快開！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Slow down, we're getting strung out!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7慢一點！隊伍拉得太長了！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Solid copy Hunter 2-3! Hang tight! We're making our way back to you, over!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7獵人二三，收到！撐住！我們正回去找你們，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter 2-1, Overlord. What's going on out there, over?
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，這裡是霸王。那邊出了什麼事？完畢。
^2霸王：^7收到，二一。霸王通話完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Hunter 2-1 to Hunter 2-3, I have eyes on the school, over!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7獵人二一呼叫獵人二三，我看到學校了，完畢！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Get the hell away from those windows and secure the top floor! Move! Move!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7離那些窗戶遠一點，控制頂樓！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Targets, front of the school! Take 'em out!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7學校前方有目標！幹掉他們！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7They're falling back into the school!
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Hunter 2-3, Hunter 2-1, we're in the school. Heavy resistance.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7獵人二三，這裡是獵人二一。我們已進入學校，抵抗猛烈。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Yeah, I'm cutting through history class now.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7對，我正穿過歷史教室。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7I think I saw one run into that classroom.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7我好像看到一個人跑進那間教室。

entries.source: ^2Hunter 2-3: ^7We'll see you on the flipside Hunter 2-1, 2-3 out.
entries.target: ^2獵人二三：^7獵人二一，回頭見。二三通話完畢。
^2佛利中士：^7獵人二一指揮官呼叫霸王。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7The school is secure and hostiles are withdrawing from the area. We're just moppin' up now.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7學校已安全，敵人正在撤離這個區域。我們只剩掃蕩工作。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Get the wounded to the shock trauma unit! Use my helicopter!
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7把傷員送到創傷急救單位！用我的直升機！
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7順著彈殼追查。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One this is Overlord Actual, we're seeing a large group of enemy reinforcements to your north, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，這裡是霸王指揮官。看到你們北邊有大批敵方援軍，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One, be advised, fifteen-plus enemy foot-mobiles approaching north of your location, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，注意，十五名以上敵方步兵正從你們北邊逼近，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One, Hunter Four has a visual on a hostile group near the Nova gas station, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，獵人四號在諾瓦加油站附近看到一群敵人，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Strange.  I coulda sworn we ended this war yesterday.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7奇怪。我還以為昨天就已經結束這場戰爭了。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One, relay from Goliath Two, enemy reinforcements approaching from the west, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，轉達巨人二號：敵方援軍正從西方逼近，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One, fifteen-plus tangos approaching near the diner to the west, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，西邊小餐館附近有十五名以上敵人逼近，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One, Overlord. Estimate twenty enemy foot-mobiles approaching you from the southeast, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，這裡是霸王。估計有二十名敵方步兵從東南方逼近，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7Hunter Two-One, be advised, multiple enemy foot-mobiles have been sighted near the taco joint, over.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7獵人二一，注意，墨西哥捲餅店附近發現多名敵方步兵，完畢。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen, pick up some frag grenades from the table.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵，從桌上拿些破片手榴彈。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7But the sand and rocks here, stained with thousands of years of warfare...
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7但這裡的沙石，浸染著數千年的戰火……

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7We go forward like a breath exhaled from the Earth.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7我們前進，如同大地呼出的一口氣。

entries.source: ^2Air Traffic Controller: ^7I'm lookin' at fighter jets over I-95!  How the hell did they get through?
entries.target: ^2航空管制員：^7我看到戰鬥機飛過九十五號州際公路！他們到底怎麼闖進來的？

entries.source: Use sniper rifles, claymores and Predator Drones to hold off waves of enemies.
entries.target: 使用狙擊步槍、闊刀地雷和掠奪者無人機，抵擋一波波敵人。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7You don't end up hitting a damn thing and it makes you look like an ass.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7結果什麼也打不中，還讓自己看起來像個蠢蛋。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen, show 'em what I'm talking about.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵，示範給他們看。

entries.source: Predator Drones, favela gangs, sniper rifles and stealth.  These Ops are short and sweet.
entries.target: 掠奪者無人機、貧民窟幫派、狙擊步槍與潛行。這些行動短小精悍。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Turn around and fire at the targets.
^2Sgt. Foley: ^7From the hip, Private. Just like in the movies.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7腰射，二等兵。就像電影裡那樣。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Everyone pay attention. You must remember to change magazines when you run out of ammo.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7所有人注意。彈藥打完時，一定要記得換彈匣。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7You've got to pick your targets by aiming deliberately down your sights from a stable stance.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7穩住姿勢，仔細舉槍瞄準，選定目標。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen, aim down your sights before engaging the target.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵，先舉槍瞄準，再射擊目標。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Don't forget to aim down your sights, Private.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7別忘了舉槍瞄準，二等兵。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen, go prone and take out a few more targets.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵，趴下再打幾個靶子。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Aiming down your sights also works for switching quickly between targets.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7舉槍瞄準也能幫助你快速切換目標。
^2佛利中士：^7示範給他們看，二等兵。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7That was too slow. You need engage and release your aim quickly to snap to new targets
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7太慢了。你得快速舉槍、放下，再舉槍，才能迅速轉向新目標。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Too slow. Private Allen, you need to quickly pop in and out of aiming down your sights to snap to new targets.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7太慢了。艾倫一等兵，你得快速舉槍、放下，再舉槍，才能迅速轉向新目標。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen, you're doing it wrong. Quickly engage and release aiming down the sight to snap to new targets.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵，你做錯了。快速舉槍、放下，再舉槍，才能迅速轉向新目標。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Now that's how you do it. You want to take down your targets quickly and with control.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7這才是正確做法。你要快速、精準地擊倒目標。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Now if your target is behind light cover, remember that certain weapons can penetrate and hit your target.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7如果目標躲在薄弱的掩體後，記住，有些武器能射穿掩體擊中目標。
^2佛利中士：^7這位二等兵會做個示範。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private, hit the target through the wood panel.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7二等兵，射穿木板擊中靶子。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen, hit the target through the wood panel.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵，射穿木板擊中靶子。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private, throw a grenade and take out those targets.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7二等兵，扔顆手榴彈擊倒那些靶子。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private, let's go. Throw a grenade at the targets!
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7快點，二等兵。向靶子扔顆手榴彈！

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7That's not good enough, Private. You need to land the grenade closer to the target.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7不夠好，二等兵。你得把手榴彈扔得更靠近目標。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Note that frags tend to roll on sloped surfaces. So think twice before tossing one up hill.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7注意，破片手榴彈容易沿斜坡滾動。往坡上扔之前，先想清楚。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Let's go, Private. Pick up some of the frag grenades from the table
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7快，二等兵。從桌上拿些破片手榴彈。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Grab some frags from the table, Private
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7從桌上拿些破片手榴彈，二等兵。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Private Allen, you need to pick up some frags from the table to complete this demonstration
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7艾倫一等兵，你得從桌上拿些破片手榴彈，才能完成示範。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7All right, thanks for the help, Private Allen. Now get over to The Pit...General Shepherd wants to see you run the course.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7好，謝謝幫忙，艾倫一等兵。現在去「深坑」……謝菲爾德將軍想看看你跑訓練。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Hey Private. Welcome back to The Pit.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7嘿，二等兵。歡迎回到「深坑」。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7We'll have to take them all out then.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7那就得把他們全幹掉。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Go ahead and grab a pistol.
^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Do me a favor and try switching to your sidearm.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7幫個忙，試著換成手槍。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Alright, try switching to your rifle.
^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Good. Now switch to your sidearm again.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7很好。現在再換回手槍。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7See how fast that was? Remember... switching to your pistol is always faster than reloading.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7看到有多快了吧？記住……切換手槍永遠比重新裝填快。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Ok, grab any weapon you like and head on in. Timer starts as soon as the first target pops.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7好，挑把你喜歡的武器進去。第一個靶子出現時就開始計時。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Smile for the cameras and don't miss...Shepherd and the rest of the brass are scouting for a shooter for some special op.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7對鏡頭笑一個，別打偏……謝菲爾德將軍和其他高層正在物色特別行動的射手。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Aww you killed a civvie. Come on, Allen!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7你打死平民了。拜託，艾倫！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Aww you killed a civvie. Come on, Allen!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7你打死平民了。拜託，艾倫！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Enemies in the top floor windows!
^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7You left targets in the last area, just keep moving.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7上一區還有靶子沒打到，繼續前進。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7You need to use your knife, Allen.
^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7No bullets, Private, use your knife for that target.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7別開槍，二等兵，用刀攻擊那個靶子。
^2鄧恩下士：^7近戰攻擊那個靶子，二等兵。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7We thought we'd recovered the ACS before the Russians could crack it.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7我們以為趕在俄軍破解前，就已取回 ACS。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Stop firing from the hip! Aim down your sights!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7別再腰射了！舉槍瞄準！

entries.source: Blizzards, airports, estates and bridges.  Five challenging Ops.
entries.target: 暴風雪、機場、莊園與橋梁。五項高難度行動。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7You need to sprint, Private. Go back to the red circle and sprint to the end.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7你得衝刺，二等兵。回到紅圈，再衝到終點。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7You can't finish till you sprint, Allen. Go back to the red circle and sprint to the end.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7你得衝刺才能完成，艾倫。回到紅圈，再衝到終點。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Sounds like we gotta be in two places at once.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7聽起來我們得同時出現在兩個地方。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Keep moving forward! Go! Go! Go!
^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Move! Move! You're running out of time!
^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Now sprint to the exit! Move! Move! Move!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7現在衝向出口！快！快！快！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7That ain't gonna cut it, Allen. You took too long, killed too many civilians. Try again.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7這樣不行，艾倫。你花太久，又打死太多平民。再試一次。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Not good enough, Allen. You missed too many targets. Try it again.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7不夠好，艾倫。你漏掉太多靶子。再試一次。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Not good enough, Allen. You killed too many civilians. Try it again.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7不夠好，艾倫。你打死太多平民了。再試一次。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7That ain't good enough, Allen. You killed too many civvies. Get in there again.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7不行，艾倫。你打死太多平民了。回去重跑。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Alright, not bad. Looks like you're getting a little sloppy though.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7好，不錯。不過你的動作有點馬虎。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7That was good, man, that was very good. You've still got it.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7幹得好，老兄，真的很好。你的身手還在。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Okay now that was nice. Run like a true professional.
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7好，漂亮。跑得像個真正的專家。

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Just switch to your other weapon! It's faster than reloading!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7直接切換另一把武器！比重新裝填快！

entries.source: ^2Cpl. Dunn: ^7Very impressive, man! You made that course your bitch!
entries.target: ^2鄧恩下士：^7太厲害了，老兄！你把這套訓練徹底征服了！

entries.source: ^2Overlord: ^7All Hunter units, get to your victors. We're headed out.
entries.target: ^2霸王：^7所有獵人部隊，前往各自的車輛。我們要出發了。

entries.source: Too late. Press ^3[{+melee}]^7 when the hint appears to grab a dog.
entries.target: 太晚了。提示出現時按 ^3[{+melee}]^7 抓住軍犬。

entries.source: Press ^3[{+melee}]^7 when the hint appears to grab a dog.
entries.target: 提示出現時按 ^3[{+melee}]^7 抓住軍犬。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Nikolai, come in.  Do you have our location?
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7尼古萊，請回答。你知道我們的位置嗎？

entries.source: Press and hold ^3&&1^7 to pickup claymore
entries.target: 按住 ^3&&1^7 拾取闊刀地雷

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7I know a guy.  Let's find a payphone.  They still exist?
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我認識一個人。找部公共電話吧。現在還有這東西嗎？

entries.source: Evade enemy patrols and Ghillie Snipers near Chernobyl.
entries.target: 在車諾比附近，避開敵方巡邏隊和吉利服狙擊手。

entries.source: Rain death from above using an AC-130 gunship to protect your partner.
entries.target: 用 AC-130 砲艇機從空中傾瀉火力，保護搭檔。

entries.source:
Finish in 2 minutes.
Finish in 90 seconds.
Finish in 70 seconds.
entries.target:
兩分鐘內完成。
九十秒內完成。
七十秒內完成。

entries.source: Rack up a large enough body count.  Quick kills earn larger bonuses.
entries.target: 累積足夠的擊殺數。快速擊殺可獲得更多獎勵。

entries.source: Breach and clear two deadly rooms full of enemies and hostages to capture the oil rig.
entries.target: 破門清剿兩個滿是敵人與人質的危險房間，奪取鑽油平台。

entries.source: Use C4, grenade launchers, RPGs, sentry guns, semtex and more to destroy every vehicle on the bridge.
entries.target: 使用 C4、榴彈發射器、RPG、自動機槍、黏著手榴彈等武器，摧毀橋上每一輛車。

entries.source: Sabotage the remote airbase with your silenced weapons and heartbeat sensor.
entries.target: 使用消音武器與心跳感測器，破壞偏遠空軍基地。

entries.source: Battle Shadow Company and Juggernauts in the airplane graveyard.  Grab the intel and escape to the extraction point.
entries.target: 在飛機墳場對抗暗影連和重裝兵。取得情報，逃到撤離點。

entries.source: Clear all of the enemy targets as fast as possible. Shooting civilians will prevent you from getting 3 stars.
entries.target: 盡快擊倒所有敵方靶。射中平民就無法取得三顆星。

entries.source: Kill all ten Juggernauts using only explosives and a knife.  You'd be insane to even try this.
entries.target: 只用爆裂物和刀，擊殺十名重裝兵。敢嘗試就已經夠瘋狂了。

entries.source: Push through the invading forces on the bridge to reach the safe zone.
entries.target: 突破橋上的入侵部隊，抵達安全區。

entries.source: Sentry guns, Thermal sights, Rocket launchers and Claymores.  Defend yourself from five difficult waves of attackers.
entries.target: 使用自動機槍、熱影像瞄準鏡、火箭發射器和闊刀地雷，抵擋五波猛烈攻擊。
取得四十顆星即可解鎖。

entries.source:
30 Enemies, 6 Civilian casualties maximum.
40 Enemies and Dogs, 4 Civilian casualties.
50 Enemies and Dogs, 3 Civilian casualties.
entries.target:
三十名敵人，平民傷亡最多六人。
四十名敵人和軍犬，平民傷亡最多四人。
五十名敵人和軍犬，平民傷亡最多三人。

entries.source:
3 Waves of infantry, 1 Jeep and 1 Truck.
4 Waves of infantry, 2 Jeeps and 1 Truck.
5 Waves of infantry, 3 Jeeps and 2 Trucks.
entries.target:
三波步兵、一輛吉普車與一輛卡車。
四波步兵、兩輛吉普車與一輛卡車。
五波步兵、三輛吉普車與兩輛卡車。

entries.source: Press and hold &&1 to call elevator.
Press and hold &&1 to use elevator.
Press and hold &&1 to select floor.
^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Six-Two-Seven is the piece of meat Makarov wants, so let's cut him loose.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7六二七號就是馬卡洛夫想要的那塊肉。把他放出來吧。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7The healthy human mind doesn't wake up in the morning thinking this is its last day on Earth.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7正常人早上醒來，不會認為今天就是自己在人世的最後一天。
^2普萊斯：^7歷史是由勝利者書寫的。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7But I think that's a luxury.  Not a curse.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7但我認為，那是一種奢侈，不是詛咒。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Outgunned.  Outnumbered.  Out of our minds. On a suicide mission.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7火力不如人，人數不如人。我們瘋了，接下這趟自殺任務。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7Because out of all our vast array of nightmares, this is the one we choose for ourselves.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7因為在無數的噩夢中，這是我們自己選擇的一場。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7With vigor in our hearts and one goal in sight:
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7胸懷決心，眼前只有一個目標：

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7If he lives and we die, his truth becomes written -
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7如果他活著，而我們死了，他的說法就會被寫進歷史——
^2普萊斯：^7而我們的真相，將就此消失。

entries.source: ^2Price: ^7He's about to complete the greatest trick a liar ever played on history.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯：^7他即將完成騙子對歷史施展過最驚人的騙局。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7The rest of Task Force 141 brought in the ACS, Allen.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7艾倫，一四一特遣隊的其他人已經取回 ACS。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Two men took down an entire base.  I ask much more from you now.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7兩個人就摧毀了一整座基地。現在我要你做的，比這多得多。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7He doesn't flinch at torture, human trafficking, or genocide.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7酷刑、人口販運或種族滅絕，都無法讓他退縮。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7He's not loyal to a flag or a country or any set of ideals.  He trades blood for money.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7他不效忠任何旗幟、國家或理念。他靠鮮血換取金錢。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7It will cost you a piece of yourself.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7它會讓你失去一部分的自己。
^2佛利中士：^7是，長官。部隊交由你指揮。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7Just point it out on the map, Sir. They won't take it.
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7長官，在地圖上指給我們看就好。他們休想拿下那裡。

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Da.  Inbound, Price.  But I am not the only one.
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7是的，普萊斯。我正在趕來，但不只我一個人。

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7You've got Shepherd's men on one side, Makarov's on the other.
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7你們一邊是謝菲爾德將軍的人，另一邊是馬卡洛夫的人。

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Or let them take each other out.
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7或是讓他們自相殘殺。

entries.source: ^2Nikolai: ^7Either way, I'll see you on the other side my friend.
entries.target: ^2尼古萊：^7不管怎樣，朋友，我們到另一邊見。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Makarov's no prize. He's a whore. A mad-dog killer for the highest bidder.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7馬卡洛夫算不上什麼戰利品。他是個唯利是圖的混蛋，誰出價最高，他就替誰殺人。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Just remember your new identity. It'll keep you alive.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7記住你的新身分，那會保住你的命。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Welcome to the 141.  Best handpicked group of warriors on the planet.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7歡迎加入一四一特遣隊。這是世上最精銳、千挑萬選的戰士。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7They're on a mission recovering a downed ACS module behind enemy lines.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7他們正在敵後執行任務，回收一個墜落的 ACS 模組。
^2艾倫一等兵：^7他們已經上陣了？

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7The more things change, the more they stay the same.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7世事越是改變，越是一成不變。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7General Shepherd you're online with Captain Price.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7謝菲爾德將軍，你已與普萊斯上尉連線。
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7上尉，你總算從鬼門關回來了。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7"Out of the frying pan" is more like it.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7我看更像是「才出虎口」。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7This world looks more like hell than the one I just left.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7這個世界比我剛離開的地方更像地獄。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Then Makarov turned the U.S. into his scapegoat.  Next thing you know there's flames everywhere.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7馬卡洛夫把美國當成了代罪羔羊。轉眼間，到處都陷入戰火。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Shepherd, are you willing to do what is necessary to win?
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7謝菲爾德將軍，為了勝利，你願意採取必要的手段嗎？

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7We got ourselves a pretty big fire. Gonna need a huge bang.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7我們遇上了一場大火，得來一場大爆炸才行。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7No time, Sir.  We need to end this war today.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7沒時間了，長官。我們今天就得結束這場戰爭。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7I'm not asking you, Price.  This is an order!  You're to...
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7普萊斯，我不是在徵詢你的意見，這是命令！你必須……

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Looks like we lost our connection.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7看來我們斷線了。

entries.source: ^2SecDef: ^7Gentlemen, the missile's vector puts it en route to the East Coast.  We will lose the White House.
entries.target: ^2國防部長：^7各位，飛彈的航向指向東岸。我們將失去白宮。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7We've rebuilt it before, we'll rebuild it again.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7我們以前重建過，這次也能再重建。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7When they speak of this moment, we will not be the ones who stood guard while America died.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7當人們談起這一刻，不會說我們只是眼睜睜地守著美國走向滅亡。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7One man is responsible for all this. Makarov must be brought to light.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7這一切都是一個人造成的。我們必須讓馬卡洛夫現形。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Despite what the world may say, we are not savages, we don't kill civilians. We use precision.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7不管世人怎麼說，我們不是野蠻人。我們不殺平民，我們採取精準行動。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7There's an evil man hiding in these shadows and we're gonna bring him into the light.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7有個惡人躲在陰影裡，我們要讓他見光。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Once his face is revealed, we will write history, gentlemen.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7各位，一旦揭露他的真面目，我們就能書寫歷史。

entries.source: ^2Captain Price: ^7Granted. Soap and I will take the boneyard in Afghanistan.
entries.target: ^2普萊斯上尉：^7准許。肥皂和我會前往阿富汗的飛機墳場。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Very well. We will cut off all avenues of escape.  This ends now.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7很好。我們會切斷所有逃跑路線。現在就做個了斷。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7I can't get anyone on the horn.
^2Ghost: ^7And they're killing a thousand Americans for every dead civilian in Moscow.  Looks like we're all outta friends.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7莫斯科每死一名平民，他們就殺死上千名美國人。看來我們已經沒有朋友了。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7It's all we got.  If this con's the bait to catch that psychopath, let's hang him from a tree.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7我們只有這條線索。如果這個囚犯能當誘餌釣出那個瘋子，就把他掛到樹上吧。

entries.source: ^2Ghost: ^7The Russians ain't gonna let this massacre go unanswered. It's gonna get bloody.
entries.target: ^2幽靈：^7俄國人不會對這場屠殺善罷甘休。接下來一定腥風血雨。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7No one's gonna say a word when the Russians club every American they can reach.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7俄軍痛打每一個能逮到的美國人，也不會有人吭聲。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Makarov was one move ahead.  Now he's left thousands of bodies at the feet of an American.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7馬卡洛夫搶先一步。如今他把數千具屍體，丟到了一個美國人的腳邊。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7We're the only ones who know it was Makarov's op.  Our credibility died with Allen.  We need proof.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7只有我們知道那是馬卡洛夫的行動。艾倫死了，我們也失去了公信力。我們需要證據。
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7亞歷杭德羅．羅哈斯。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7You know him as Alex the Red.  He supplied the assault.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7你們知道他的外號，「紅色亞歷克斯」。這次襲擊的武器是他提供的。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7One bullet to unleash the fury of a whole nation.  Which means...
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7一顆子彈，點燃了整個國家的怒火。也就是說……
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7他是找到馬卡洛夫的關鍵。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Sixth Fleet's mopping up.  Time to move in.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7第六艦隊正在掃蕩，是時候進去了。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Long history, this building.  Not much of it pretty.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7這棟建築歷史悠久，卻沒多少美好的往事。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Started out as a castle.  With an actual dungeon.  Built to withstand any siege.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7它最初是一座城堡，附有真正的地牢，足以抵擋任何圍攻。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Building survived every brutal winter.  The occupants... they weren't so lucky.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7建築熬過了每一個酷寒的冬天。住在裡面的人……就沒那麼幸運了。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7But I suppose it's all a day at the races: you back the losing horse, and this is where you end up.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7不過我想，這就像賭馬。你押錯了馬，最後就落到這裡。

entries.source: ^2NORAD HQ: ^7Sand Bravo, we're reading 70 bogeys in your sector, please verify.
entries.target: ^2北美防空司令部：^7沙地 B，我們在你們區域偵測到七十個不明空中目標，請確認。

entries.source: ^2Nome AFB: ^7Very funny, Station.  That's a big negative, over.
entries.target: ^2諾姆空軍基地：^7真好笑，指揮中心。這裡什麼都沒有，完畢。

entries.source: ^2NORAD HQ: ^7Zulu X-Ray 6.  Signs in your sector of some 100 bogeys, please advise.
entries.target: ^2北美防空司令部：^7Z X 六號，你們區域似乎有約一百個不明空中目標，請回報。

entries.source: ^2NORAD HQ: ^7Standby!  Attempting to contact the nearest unit in that sector.
entries.target: ^2北美防空司令部：^7稍候！正在聯絡該區最近的部隊。

entries.source: ^2Sgt. Foley: ^7I read you.  This is First Battalion, 75th Ranger Regiment, Sergeant Foley, acting commander of Hunter Two-One. Do you copy over?
entries.target: ^2佛利中士：^7收到。這裡是第七十五遊騎兵團第一營，佛利中士，獵人二一的代理指揮官。收到嗎？完畢。

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7Seems we're headed the wrong direction, Sir.  Shouldn't we be coming back to the fight?
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7長官，我們好像走錯方向了。不是該回去參戰嗎？

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Plenty of fight to go around, MacTavish.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7麥克塔維什，有的是仗可以打。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Glad you made it outta South America.  You're meeting up with the 6th Fleet.  Leadin' the counter-strike.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7很高興你們逃出南美洲。你們將與第六艦隊會合，率領反擊行動。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Prisoner Six-Two-Seven.  We believe that's who Makarov's got the mad-on for.  But we can't get to him.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7六二七號囚犯。我們相信他就是馬卡洛夫恨之入骨的人，但現在無法接近他。
^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7鑽油平台，長官？

entries.source: ^2Captain MacTavish: ^7They're defending it, so it means we want it.  Especially if it gets us to Six-Two-Seven.
entries.target: ^2麥克塔維什上尉：^7他們在防守，就表示那裡值得拿下。尤其是能讓我們找到六二七號的話。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7We are the most powerful military force in the history of man.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7我們是人類歷史上最強大的軍隊。
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7每一場戰爭，都與我們有關。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Learning to use the tools of modern warfare is the difference between the prospering of your people, and utter destruction.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7是否懂得運用現代戰爭的工具，將決定你的人民繁榮昌盛，還是徹底毀滅。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7We can't give you freedom.  But we can give you the know-how to acquire it.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7我們不能直接給你自由，但可以教你如何爭取自由。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7And that, my friends, is worth more than a whole army base of steel.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7朋友們，這比整座軍事基地的鋼鐵武器都更有價值。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7This is a time for heroes.  A time for legends.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7這是英雄的時代，也是傳奇的時代。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7We fought and bled alongside the Russians.  We shoulda known they'd hate us for it.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7我們曾與俄國人並肩作戰，一起流血。早該知道，他們會因此恨我們。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7History is written by the victor. And here I am, thinking we'd won.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7歷史是由勝利者書寫的。而我竟以為，是我們贏了。
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7地點、理由、目標，都在改變。
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7昨天的敵人，成了今天的新兵。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7Train them to fight alongside you, and pray they don't eventually decide to hate you for it too.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7訓練他們與你並肩作戰，再祈禱他們最後不會也因此恨你。
^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7又是同樣的鳥事，只是換了一天。

entries.source: ^2Shepherd: ^7You know what I'm looking for, Sergeant Foley.  Keep your eyes open.
entries.target: ^2謝菲爾德將軍：^7佛利中士，你知道我在找什麼樣的人。眼睛放亮點。

放開 ^3[{+speed_throw}]^7 停止舉槍瞄準。

entries.source:
Hit the targets while firing from the hip.
Press ^3[{+toggleads_throw}]^7 to stop aiming down your sight.
entries.target:
以腰射擊中靶子。
按 ^3[{+toggleads_throw}]^7 停止舉槍瞄準。

entries.source: Press and hold ^3[{+melee_breath}]^7 to steady your breathing.
entries.target: 按住 ^3[{+melee_breath}]^7 屏息穩定準星。

entries.source: Press and hold ^3[{+breath_sprint}]^7 to steady your breathing.
entries.target: 按住 ^3[{+breath_sprint}]^7 屏息穩定準星。

entries.source: Press and hold ^3[{+breath_binoculars}]^7 to steady your breathing.
entries.target: 按住 ^3[{+breath_binoculars}]^7 屏息穩定準星。

entries.source: Press ^3[{+sprint}]^7 while moving forward to sprint.
Press and hold ^3[{+prone}]^7 to go prone.
Press and hold down ^3[{+stance}]^7 to go prone.
Press ^3[{+stance}]^7 to crouch to fire more accurately.
entries.target: 按 ^3[{+stance}]^7 蹲下，提高射擊準度。

entries.source: Press ^3[{gocrouch}]^7 to crouch to fire more accurately.
entries.target: 按 ^3[{gocrouch}]^7 蹲下，提高射擊準度。

entries.source: Look up the ladder and move forward to climb it.
entries.target: 看向梯子上方並前進，即可攀爬。

entries.source: You must aim above your target with grenades.
entries.target: 投擲手榴彈時須瞄準目標上方。

entries.source: Press and hold ^3[{+movedown}]^7 to crouch to fire more accurately.
entries.target: 按住 ^3[{+movedown}]^7 蹲下，提高射擊準度。

entries.source: You don't have to hold ^3[{+breath_sprint}]^7 to continue sprinting.
Press ^3[{+breath_sprint}]^7 while moving forward to sprint.
Press ^3[{togglecrouch}]^7 to crouch to fire more accurately.
entries.target: 按 ^3[{togglecrouch}]^7 蹲下，提高射擊準度。

entries.source: Click ^3[{+breath_sprint}]^7 while moving forward to sprint.
You don't have to hold ^3[{+sprint}]^7 to continue sprinting.
Touch the obstacle and press ^3[{+gostand}]^7 to mantle over it.
entries.target: 靠近障礙物，按 ^3[{+gostand}]^7 翻越。

entries.source:
Release and pull ^3[{+speed}]^7 to automatically
switch to a nearby target.
entries.target:
放開再按 ^3[{+speed}]^7，
自動切換至附近目標。

entries.source:
Release and pull ^3[{+speed_throw}]^7 to automatically
switch to a nearby target.
entries.target:
放開再按 ^3[{+speed_throw}]^7，
自動切換至附近目標。

entries.source:
Release then press and hold ^3[{+speed}]^7 to
quickly switch to a nearby target.
entries.target:
放開再按住 ^3[{+speed}]^7，
快速切換至附近目標。

entries.source:
Release then press and hold ^3[{+speed_throw}]^7 to
quickly switch to a nearby target.
entries.target:
放開再按住 ^3[{+speed_throw}]^7，
快速切換至附近目標。

entries.source: Press ^3[{weapnext}]^7 to switch to your sidearm.
Press ^3[{weapnext}]^7 to switch to your primary weapon.
Press ^3[{weaponslot primaryb}]^7 to switch to your sidearm.
Melee the watermelon with your knife.
Approach the rifle with the grenade launcher attachment and press and hold ^3[{+activate}]^7.
entries.target: 靠近附榴彈發射器的步槍，按住 ^3[{+activate}]^7。

entries.source: Enter station number 1 and aim down your sights.
Approach the rifle with the grenade launcher attachment and press and hold ^3[{+activate}]^7.
entries.target: 靠近附榴彈發射器的步槍，按住 ^3[{+activate}]^7。

entries.source: Press ^3[{+actionslot 3}]^7 to switch to the grenade launcher attachment.
entries.target: 按 ^3[{+actionslot 3}]^7 切換榴彈發射器。

entries.source: Pull and release ^3[{+attack}]^7 to fire a 40mm grenade.
entries.target: 按下再放開 ^3[{+attack}]^7 發射 40 公釐榴彈。

entries.source: Approach the explosive charges and press and hold ^3[{+activate}]^7 to pick them up.
entries.target: 靠近炸藥，按住 ^3[{+activate}]^7 拾取。

entries.source: Approach the glowing explosive marker and press ^3[{+activate}]^7 to plant the C4.
entries.target: 靠近發光的爆破標記，按 ^3[{+activate}]^7 安放 C4。

entries.source: Approach the glowing explosive marker and press ^3[{+activate}]^7 to plant the C4.
entries.target: 靠近發光的爆破標記，按 ^3[{+activate}]^7 安放 C4。

entries.source: Press and hold ^3&&1^7 to pick up the C4 explosive.
entries.target: 按住 ^3&&1^7 拾取 C4 炸藥。

entries.source: You now have a C4 icon on your screen.
entries.target: 畫面上現在有 C4 圖示。

entries.source:
Firing from the hip is never as
accurate as aiming down your sight.
entries.target:
腰射的準度
永遠不及舉槍瞄準。

entries.source:
Notice that your display changes to show
you what inventory item you have equipped.
entries.target:
注意介面會變化，
顯示目前裝備的物品。

entries.source:
Notice that your crosshair expands as you fire.
The bigger the crosshairs, the less accurate you are.
entries.target:
開火時準星會擴大。
準星越大，準度越低。

entries.source: Press and hold ^3&&1^7 to slide down the rope.
You don't have enough flashes to finish.
Use your Objective Indicator to find the firing range.
entries.target: 循任務指示器找到靶場。

entries.source:
When planting C4 is your objective, you will see a glowing
marker in the world that indicates where to plant it.
entries.target:
若任務要求安放 C4，
場景中會出現發光標記，指示安放位置。

entries.source: You must aim above your target with grenade launchers.
entries.target: 發射榴彈時須瞄準目標上方。

entries.source: Notice you now have an icon of a grenade launcher on your display.
entries.target: 注意畫面現在有榴彈發射器圖示。

entries.source: Go outside and report to Sgt. Newcastle.
entries.target: 到外面向紐卡索中士報到。

entries.source: Pick up the rifle with the grenade launcher attachment.
entries.target: 拾取附榴彈發射器的步槍。

entries.source: Use your objective indicator to locate Captain Price.
entries.target: 循任務指示器找到普萊斯上尉。

entries.source: Fire at the wall with the number one on it.
Equip the MP5 and pick up 4 flashbangs.
entries.target: 裝備 MP5，拾取四顆閃光彈。

entries.source: Return to the safety pit and equip the grenade launcher.
entries.target: 返回安全坑，裝備榴彈發射器。

entries.source: Plant the C4 explosive at the glowing spot.
Fire your grenade launcher into windows five, six and seven.
entries.target: 向五、六、七號窗戶發射榴彈。

entries.source: Shoot the target through the wood.
&&1 invites you to join their party.
Go to ^2www.infinityward.com/nat^7 to OPEN your router's NAT.
entries.target: 前往 ^2www.infinityward.com/nat^7，將路由器 NAT 類型設為開放。

entries.source: Reverse your controls for looking up and down?
entries.target: 是否反轉上下視角操作？
保留目前的視角操作設定？

entries.source: Pick up a pistol from the table.
Pick up the weapon from the table.
Shoot as many valid targets as you can in the fastest possible time.
entries.target: 以最快速度擊中最多有效目標。

entries.source: Use your objective indicator to locate The Pit.
Shoot three targets while aiming down your sights.
entries.target: 舉槍瞄準，射擊三個靶子。

entries.source: Shoot targets while firing from the hip.
Switch to your rifle and then back to your pistol.
Throw a grenade toward the targets.
Shoot a target through the wood.
Shoot each target as quickly as possible.

Go back to the red circle
and sprint to the exit.
entries.target:
回到紅圈，
再衝向出口。

entries.source: Weapon use in unauthorized areas will not be tolerated.
entries.target: 不得在非指定區域使用武器。

entries.source: Turn around to face the firing range targets.
